name: Abumi Zaku
description: Abumi Zaku is one of the three sound genin sent to the chuunin exams. He was surgically altered with hollow tubes in his arms, allowing him to create waves of compressed air.

skills.name: Air Cutter
skills.description: Zaku fires a blast of supersonic air at one enemy, dealing 25 damage to them. The following turn, Zaku can use 'Extreme Air Cutter'.

skills.name: Wall of Air
skills.description: Zaku alters his air wave to protect one ally for 1 turn. The first harmful skill used on that ally will be countered. If successful, Zaku will instantly apply 'Air Cutter' on the countered enemy. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Extreme Air Cutter
skills.description: Zaku boosts his air waves to a frightening level and deals 45 damage to all enemies. Afterwards, Zaku gains 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Airwave Deflection
skills.description: This skill makes Abumi Zaku invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Aburame Shino
description: A Genin from Team 8, Shino is the successor of the Aburame clan, and a very reserved and tactical fighter. Using the bugs that live inside his body, Shino is able to leech the chakra off his enemies, or protect his entire team.

skills.name: Chakra Leach
skills.description: Shino directs his chakra draining bugs to one enemy, stealing 20 health and 1 taijutsu or genjutsu chakra from them.

skills.name: Female Bug
skills.description: Shino directs one of his female bugs to attach itself. For 3 turns, 'Chakra Leach' will steal 5 additional health from one enemy. During this time, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will deal 5 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. This skill cannot be used on an enemy already affected by it.

skills.name: Bug Wall
skills.description: Shino calls millions of bugs to create a wall protecting himself and his allies and granting them 25 points of permanent destructible defense.

skills.name: Bug Clone
skills.description: This skill makes Aburame Shino invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Aburame Shino (S)
description: Still as mysterious and secretive as ever, Shino has improved greatly over the years, learning and practicing with his loyal bugs. With his new found mastery, Shino can disable enemies even harder while slowly waiting for his bugs to erupt from their bodies and destroy them.

skills.name: Insect Swarm
skills.description: Shino sends out wave of his insect army at one enemy, dealing 15 affliction damage to them for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, that enemy will be invulnerable to all friendly skills each turn and during this time this skill will be replaced by 'Insect Consumption'.

skills.name: Insect Barricade
skills.description: The following turn, the first new harmful skill used on himself or one ally will be countered, 'Parasitic Giant Beetle Infestation' will be placed on the countered enemy and then activated. If this skill does not counter an enemy, Shino will gain 1 Bloodline chakra. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Parasitic Giant Beetle Infestation
skills.description: Shino infects one enemy with a small bug. 3 turns after this skill has been used, the bug bursts out, dealing 30 affliction damage to them and activating all other copies of this skill on that enemy. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Insect Cocoon
skills.description: This skill makes Aburame Shino (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Insect Consumption
skills.description: Shino commands his insects to drain the chakra of one enemy affected by 'Insect Swarm' stealing 1 random chakra from them and increasing the damage that enemy receives from 'Insect Swarm' by 5 that turn.

name: Aburame Torune (S)
description: A member of the Aburame clan, and a member of Anbu Root, Torune can almost be said to have no personality of his own, other than his undying loyalty to Danzo. Unlike other members of his clan, Torune employs a unique type of bug that lets him outright destroy both flesh and chakra.

skills.name: Armor of Venom
skills.description: Torune applies one 'Venom Beetle' to one enemy and gains 15 destructible defense. During this time, Torune can use this skill again for 1 random chakra to apply a 'Venom Beetle' to one enemy. The enemy that destroys this destructible defense will have a 'Venom Beetle' applied to them.

skills.name: Jar of Poison
skills.description: Torune applies one 'Venom Beetle' to each enemy and gains 35 destructible defense. During this time, Torune can use this skill again for 2 random chakra to apply a 'Venom Beetle' to each enemy. The enemy that destroys this destructible defense will have a 'Venom Beetle' applied to them.

skills.name: Venom Explosion
skills.description: Torune targets any enemy affected by at least one 'Venom Beetle', removing 1 random chakra from them for each 'Venom Beetle' on them.

skills.name: Super Leap
skills.description: This skill makes Aburame Torune (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Venom Beetle
skills.description: This skill deals 5 affliction damage permanently.

name: Akadou Yoroi
description: Part of the three man team of Kabuto during the Chuunin Exams working as spies, Yoroi has a special ability that allows him to absorb his opponents energy.

skills.name: Chakra and Life Absorption
skills.description: Yoroi endows his attacks. The following 3 turns, 'Draining Assault' and 'Energy Drain' may be used.

skills.name: Energy Drain
skills.description: Yoroi touches one enemy, stealing 20 health from them for 1 turn and lowering their non-affliction damage by 5 until that enemy uses a new damage skill. During 'Draining Assault', this skill will steal 1 bloodline chakra. Requires 'Chakra and Life Absorption' to be used.

skills.name: Draining Assault
skills.description: Yoroi charges at one enemy with multiple energy drains, stealing 12 health from them for 3 turns and stealing 1 bloodline or ninjutsu chakra each turn. During this time, 'Energy Drain' will be improved. Requires 'Chakra and Life Absorption' to be used.

skills.name: Chakra Block
skills.description: This skill makes Akadou Yoroi invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Akatsuchi (S)
description: Akatsuchi (S) is a shinobi of the Hidden Rock Village. Akatsuchi is a powerful shinobi who uses brute strength and earth style jutsus in combat.

unlock.detail: The Rock of the Rock Village

skills.name: High Speed Assault
skills.description: Using High Speed Assault Akatsuchi deals 25 damage to 1 enemy. The following 3 turns, this skill will cost 1 additional random chakra and will deal 15 additional damage.

skills.name: Golem
skills.description: Akatsuchi uses Golem on all enemies dealing 15 damage to them. The following 3 turns, this skill will cost 1 additional random chakra and will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Golem Chakra Devour
skills.description: Akatsuchi's golem devours one enemy's chakra, dealing 10 piercing damage and stealing 1 random chakra from them. The following 2 turns, Akatsuchi's skills will cost 1 less random chakra. This skill will cost 1 less random chakra for each stack of 'Golem' and 'High Speed Assault' active on Akatsuchi.

skills.name: Akatsuchi Retreat
skills.description: This skill makes Akatsuchi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Akimichi Chouji
description: A Genin from Team 10, Chouji is a member of the Akimichi clan, a large eater, and a close friend to his allies. While innately strong, Chouji is able to sacrifice his own life using special pills from his clan to become insanely powerful.

skills.name: Partial Double Size
skills.description: Chouji doubles the size of his arms and attacks one enemy, dealing 20 damage to them.

skills.name: Meat Tank
skills.description: Chouji transforms into a meat tank, becoming invulnerable for 2 turns*. If targetable, one enemy will be dealt 10 damage for 2 turns.

skills.name: Akimichi Pills
skills.description: Chouji eats a pill, taking 15 affliction damage. 'Partial Double Size' will deal 20 additional damage and 'Meat Tank' will deal 10 additional damage permanently. Each use of this skill will deal 5 more affliction damage and will cost 2 additional random chakra. Chouji can only eat three pills.

skills.name: Effortless Block
skills.description: This skill makes Akimichi Chouji invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive: Butterfly Mode
skills.description: When Chouji eats the three pills, he will activate the Butterfly Mode, gaining 75% unpierceable damage reduction permanently and gaining 1 random chakra every turn.

name: Akimichi Chouji (S)
description: After nearly three years, Chouji has grown into a reliable ninja and is now a chuunin. His appetite has grown and so has his body, but now he is truly mastering the Akimichi clan techniques.

skills.name: Mega Palm Thrusts
skills.description: Expanding his arms for more inertia, Chouji deals 30 damage to one enemy and increase the cost of their harmful skills by 1 random chakra for 1 turn.

skills.name: Spiked Meat Tank
skills.description: If used on an enemy: That enemy will be dealt 25 damage and Chouji becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.  If used on himself or an ally: For 1 turn, all non-mental skills used on that ally will be countered and any countered enemy will be dealt 10 piercing damage*. This counter is Invisible and has a cooldown of 2.

skills.name: Expansion Technique
skills.description: Chouji grows gigantic, gaining 45 destructible defense for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, 'Mega Palm Thrusts' will target all enemies and 'Spiked Meat Tank' will target all enemies or will target all allies if used on an ally.

skills.name: Chouji Leap
skills.description: This skill makes Akimichi Chouji (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Akimichi Chouza (S)
description: Akimichi Chouza (S) is the leader of the Akimichi clan and the father of Chouji. He is a jounin and he is skilled in all of his clan's secret techniques.

skills.name: Chain Bind
skills.description: Chouza slows down an enemy, dealing 10 damage to them and lowering all physical and chakra damage they deal by 10 for 1 turn. During this time, Chouza's team will also gain 10 destructible defense.

skills.name: Jounin Meat Tank
skills.description: Chouza begins rolling, dealing 15 damage to all enemies for 2 turns. During this time, his team will gain 15 destructible defense each turn.

skills.name: Expansion Smash
skills.description: If used on an enemy, for 1 turn, the next non-mental harmful skill they use will be countered. If used on an ally, for 1 turn, the next non-mental harmful skill used on them will be countered. The countered enemy will receive 20 damage. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Chouza Block
skills.description: This skill makes Akimichi Chouza (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Animal Path Pein (S)
description: Animal Path Pein (S) is one of the six paths of Pein. This Path is able to summon a variety of different beasts for different purposes.

skills.name: Cerberus Hydra
skills.description: Animal Path Pein summons a giant multiple headed dog, dealing 20 damage to all enemies. For 2 turns, any enemy that uses a skill will be dealt 15 piercing damage.

skills.name: Drill Bird
skills.description: Animal Path Pein summons a giant drill-beaked bird, dealing 20 damage to one enemy and 20 damage to another random enemy for 2 turns. The following turn, 'Cerberus Hydra' will cost 1 ninjutsu and 1 random chakra instead.

skills.name: Invisible Chameleon
skills.description: Animal Path Pein summons his chameleon, protecting himself or an ally. For 4 turns, that ally will ignore stun effects and gains 50% damage reduction. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Panda Defense
skills.description: This skill can be used on himself or an ally, making himself or that ally invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Ao (S)
description: Ao (S) is a hunter-nin of the Hidden Mist Village and a skilled sensor. Ao is a veteran shinobi who has been in many battles, one of his spoils of war is the byakugan he possesses.

skills.name: Stolen Byakugan
skills.description: Ao uses his Byakugan on an enemy. For 3 turns, any new invisible skill used by that enemy will be visible and each time they use a new skill they will take 50% more damage from Ranged skills for 1 turn. This skill is invisible and cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Sensing Barrier
skills.description: Ao uses his sensing barrier on an enemy, making them unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable and dealing 20 damage to them for 1 turn. The following turn, that enemy will receive an additional 5 damage from 'Sensing Barrier'.

skills.name: Byakugan Seal
skills.description: For 1 turn, the first non mental skill used on Ao (S) will be countered. This skill is invisible the first time it is used and may only be used once. After the following 2 turns, this skill will be re-applied. During this time, if 'Sensing Barrier' is used this skill will be instantly re-applied.

skills.name: Reactionary Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Ao (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Asura Path Pein (S)
description: Asura Path Pein (S) is one of the six paths of Pein. His body style is similar to a puppet filled with hidden weapons.

skills.name: Chakra Burst
skills.description: Asura prevents one enemy from becoming invulnerable or reducing damage, then deals 20 damage for 1 turn. During this time, any enemy that uses a new skill on him will take 10 damage. This skill will be replaced permanently.

skills.name: Cluster Bombs
skills.description: Asura Path bombs all enemies, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a new harmful physical or chakra skill will be dealt 10 piercing damage.

skills.name: Heat Seeker
skills.description: Asura Path uses Heat Seeker on one enemy. After 3 turns, that enemy will take 25 piercing damage. This skill is invisible until triggered. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Rinnegan Evasion
skills.description: This skill makes Asura Path Pein (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Crown Shockwave
skills.description: Asura Path deals 20 damage to all enemies. The following turn, they will be dealt 5 affliction damage. This skill becomes 'Chakra Burst' after being used.

name: Atsui (S)
description: A skilled shinobi from the Hidden Cloud and a member of the First Division of the Allied Shinobi Forces, Atsui specializes in Fire Release and swordsmanship. With his fiery personality and aggressive fighting style, he combines blazing sword techniques with powerful flames to overwhelm his enemies.

unlock.detail: The Hot Blade in the Cloud

skills.name: Blazing Sword Stance
skills.description: By channeling his Fire Release chakra into his blade, Atsui will deal 10 affliction damage* to any enemy who uses a new non-mental skill on him for 4 turns. During this time, if he is targeted by a new harmful skill, the active cooldowns of 'Blazing Sword Slash' and 'Raging Inferno Sea' will be reset.

skills.name: Blazing Sword Slash
skills.description: With his sword engulfed in flames, Atsui delivers a blazing slash, dealing 25 piercing damage to one enemy and making them unable to target anyone else but Atsui for 1 turn. If this enemy's health drops to 60 or below, they will take 5 affliction damage* the following 2 turns.

skills.name: Raging Inferno Sea
skills.description: Atsui unleashes a massive wave of flames, dealing 20 affliction damage to all enemies. Any enemy whose health drops to 60 or below will take 5 affliction damage the following 2 turns.

skills.name: Protective Swordplay
skills.description: This skill makes Atsui invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Baki
description: Baki is the Jounin team leader of Gaara, Temari, and Kankuro. A mysterious and perhaps devious but loyal man, he specializes in wind element jutsu.

skills.name: Sudden Strike
skills.description: A simple, blindingly fast attack leaving an illusionary trail to throw off enemies. Baki does 20 piercing damage to one enemy. If that enemy's health drops to 5 or less, they will be instantly killed.

skills.name: Wind Blade
skills.description: Baki conjures a maelstrom of blade-like wind and does 40 piercing damage to one enemy. If that enemy's health drops to 10 or less, they will be instantly killed.

skills.name: Flak Jacket
skills.description: Baki puts on a specialized flak jacket from the sand village on himself, or one ally granting that character 50 destructible defense for 4 turns. During this time, that character will ignore all harmful effects except damage until this defense is destroyed.

skills.name: Baki Teleportation
skills.description: This skill makes Baki invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Chiyo (S)
description: The grandmother of Sasori(s) and elder ninja of the Sand Village, Chiyo is a well known and accomplished puppet master and builder.

skills.name: White Secret Attack Rampage
skills.description: Chiyo directs her puppets to devastate the battlefield, dealing 20 damage to a random enemy for 1 turn. The following turn, a second random enemy will also be dealt 20 damage. The second target is invisible. The next use of 'Sanbou Kyuukai' will deal 5 aditional damage. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Sanbou Kyuukai
skills.description: This skill deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. Also for 1 turn, that enemy will receive 5 additional damage from all sources. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Ally Puppetry
skills.description: Chiyo controls one ally for 3 turns. Each turn, that ally will nullify the first physical or chakra skill used on them. During this time, their non-affliction skills will deal 25% more damage. The following 2 turns, this skill will be replaced.

skills.name: Chakra Shield
skills.description: This skill makes Chiyo (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: One's Own Life Reincarnation
skills.description: Chiyo selects one ally, giving them all of her current remaining health. Afterwards, Chiyo will instantly die. The chosen ally gains 1 random chakra for the rest of the game. This skill can also be used on dead allies.

name: Chojuro (S)
description: Chojuro (S) confidence is building as the war rages one. The longer it lasts the stronger Chojuro (S) becomes.

skills.name: Hiramekarei Strider
skills.description: Using Hiramekarei Strider, Chojuro destroys all enemies' destructible defense and damage reduction and then deals 10 piercing damage to them.The following 2 turns, this skill will deal 10 additional damage and can only be used on a single target.

skills.name: Hiramekarei Hammer
skills.description: Chojuro (S) creates a hammer of chakra to attack one enemy, dealing 40 piercing damage to them. If that enemy has any destructible defense or damage reduction, this skill will apply 'Hiramekarei Strider' on them before dealing damage.

skills.name: Hiramekarei Kenjutsu
skills.description: For 1 turn, all enemy non-chakra skills used on Chojuro will be countered. Any countered enemy will permanently take 10 additional damage from Chojuro's skills.

skills.name: Hiramekarei Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Chojuro (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Cursed Seal Juugo (S)
description: Cursed Seal Juugo (S) is fully transformed and no longer recognizable. Becoming a psychotic lunatic Juugo is able to maintain absurd amounts of chakra making him nearly impossible to defeat.

skills.name: Psychotic Break
skills.description: Juugo loses his mind and assaults one enemy, stealing 10 health from them for 3 turns. During this time, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, Jugoo's skills will be improved and will cost random chakra for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chakra Cannons
skills.description: Juugo uses his jet booster-like appendages to charge chakra and blast a powerful chakra blast, dealing 45 damage to one enemy. While improved, this skill will cost 2 random chakra.

skills.name: Body Absorption
skills.description: Juugo absorbs one enemy's body, stealing 15 health from them and making that enemy unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable for 2 turns. For 1 turn, Juugo will ignore all harmful effects except damage. While improved, this skill will cost 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Juugo Block
skills.description: This skill makes Cursed Seal Juugo (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Cursed Seal Mizuki
description: Touji Mizuki is now a missing nin that has been corrupted by his own dark ambitions and the will of Orochimaru.

skills.name: Curse Seal: Tiger
skills.description: By drinking a curse seal potion, Mizuki transforms into a wild tiger. The following 3 turns, Mizuki will gain 35 points of destructible defense and during this time, 'Curse Seal: Tiger Punch' will be >improved< and 'Puppets Genjutsu' will be replaced by its alternate version.

skills.name: Curse Seal: Tiger Punch
skills.description: Mizuki fiercely punches one enemy, dealing 30 damage to them. For 2 turns, that enemy's skills will deal 15 less non-affliction damage. During 'Curse Seal: Tiger', this skill is improved and will deal 45 damage instead. This skill does not stack.

skills.name: Puppets Genjutsu
skills.description: Mizuki puts an enemy under a genjutsu. For 2 turns, that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable, and their skills will deal 5 less damage and will cost 1 additional random chakra. During this time, if that enemy does not use a new skill, they will take 10 damage.

skills.name: Evil Intentions
skills.description: This skill makes Cursed Seal Mizuki invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Curse Seal: Tiger Bomb
skills.description: Mizuki charges like a bomb, dealing 45 damage to one enemy and becoming invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Cursed Seal Sasuke
description: When Sasuke releases the full power of his cursed seal his body and chakra become a twisted vision of his inner self and his strength is amplified greatly.

skills.name: Corrupt Chidori
skills.description: Using a cursed seal chakra corrupted Chidori Sasuke does 45 piercing damage to one enemy and for 2 turns, will reduce their non-affliction damage by 20.

skills.name: Katon: Goukakyuu no Jutsu
skills.description: Sasuke launches a giant fireball, dealing 20 affliction damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, If that enemy uses a skill they will take 10 affliction damage. During 'Cursed Seal', this skill will be improved and will also deal an additional 10 damage.

skills.name: Cursed Seal
skills.description: Sasuke taps into the power of cursed seal, becoming invulnerable for 1 turn and taking 20 affliction damage, which cannot kill him. The following turn, 'Corrupt Chidori' will cost 1 random chakra, 'Katon: Goukakyuu no Jutsu' will have no cost, and this skill will be replaced by 'Dark Void'.

skills.name: Sharingan Evasion
skills.description: This skill makes Cursed Seal Sasuke invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dark Void
skills.description: Expunging the corrupt chakra, Sasuke engulfs one enemy, stunning them for 2 turns, and making them invulnerable to all skills. When this skill ends, that enemy will receive 55 damage. This skill will end if Sasuke dies.

name: Darui (S)
description: Darui (S) is a jounin of the Hidden Cloud Village and the right hand of the Yondaime Raikage. Despite his appearance Darui (S) is a formidable shinobi.

unlock.detail: The Dull Genius of the Cloud

skills.name: Laser Circus
skills.description: Darui creates several beams and shoots his opponents, stunning one enemy for 1 turn. Afterwards, all other enemies take 15 piercing damage.

skills.name: Electric Water Encampment Wall
skills.description: Darui targets all enemies for 1 turn. Any enemy that uses a new skill will take 5 affliction damage. The following turn, all enemies affected by this skill will receive 5 additional damage from 'Laser Circus' and 'Black Panther Lightning'. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Black Panther Lightning
skills.description: Darui generates a black panther lightning from his body and releases it at one enemy, dealing 35 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, that enemy's skills will have 2 additional cooldown. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Cleaver Sword Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Darui (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Deidara (S)
description: An akatsuki former rock ninja partner and apprentice of Sasori. Deidara is quite eccentric when it comes to art. His skill with clay allows him to create explosive sculptures, whether large, medium or small.

skills.name: Clay Molds
skills.description: For 3 turns, Deidara gains 5 permanent destructible defense and activates "C2" first turn. Second turn he activates "C3". Third turn he activates "C4". Afterwards, this skill is restarted and Deidara gains 1 random chakra.

skills.name: C3 - Giant Doll
skills.description: Deidara deals 15 piercing damage to all enemies. During "C2", this skill deals 5 additional damage. During "C3", this skill deals 10 additional damage and stuns one random enemy's harmful skills for 1 turn. During "C4", this skill stuns all enemies' harmful skills for 1 turn. Requires 'Clay Mold'.

skills.name: C2 - Clay Centipede
skills.description: Deidara deals 10 damage to one enemy for 2 turns. The target's draining chakra effects will not be applied. If used during "C2", this skill lasts 3 turns. If used during "C3", Deidara becomes invulnerable to non-mental skills for 1 turn. During "C4", this skill lasts 1 turn and deals 30 piercing damage. Requires 'Clay Mold'.

skills.name: Aerial Retreat
skills.description: This skill makes Deidara (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Demon Brothers
description: A duo of Mist Nin who work for Zabuza, the Demon Brothers specialize in assassinating their targets with their shuriken chain.

skills.name: Chain Wrap
skills.description: Demon Brothers wrap one enemy in their chain. The following 3 turns, if Demon Brothers uses a new harmful skill on that enemy, their non-mental skills will be stunned for 1 turn. During this time, Demon Brothers becomes invulnerable to mental and affliction skills, and this skill is replaced by 'Chain Shred'.

skills.name: Bladed Gauntlet
skills.description: Demon Brothers uses their gauntlets shredding, gaining 10 permanent destructible defense and dealing 30 damage to one enemy. This skill will deal an additional 5 damage to the enemy affected by 'Chain Wrap'.

skills.name: Puddle Illusion
skills.description: The Demon Brothers hide in water, gaining 20 points of destructible defense and 1 taijutsu chakra.

skills.name: Demon Brothers Vanish
skills.description: This skill makes Demon Brothers invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chain Shred
skills.description: Demon Brothers rip apart one enemy affected by 'Chain Wrap', dealing 45 piercing damage to them.

name: Deva Path Pein (S)
description: Deva Path Pein (S) is one of the six paths of Pein. This path is able to use itself as the epicenter of magnetism to attract or repel all objects. This path holds the most power and is the main force in battle for Pein.

skills.name: Chakra Rod
skills.description: Deva Path Pein (S) targets one enemy and uses Chakra Rod. When that enemy uses a new skill they will be dealt 15 piercing damage and Deva will steal 1 bloodline or ninjutsu chakra from them. This skill is invisible until triggered. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Violent Water Wave
skills.description: Deva Path Pein (S) uses Violent Water Wave on all enemies. For 1 turn all enemies chakra or ranged skills will cost 1 additional random chakra. Deva Path Pein (S) gains 50% damage reduction during this skill. This skill becomes 'Chibaku Tensei' for 2 turns.

skills.name: Universal Pull
skills.description: Deva Path Pein (S) uses Universal Pull on one enemy for 1 turn. If that enemy uses a new harmful physical or chakra skill they will be countered, will take 20 damage and will deal 10 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. This skill is invisible and becomes 'Shinra Tensei' for 2 turns.

skills.name: Rinnegan Pressure
skills.description: This skill makes Deva Path Pein (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shinra Tensei
skills.description: Deva Path Pein (S) uses 'Shinra Tensei' to deal 30 damage to all enemies. For 1 turn Deva Path Pein (S) will become invulnerable. This skill becomes 'Universal Pull' when used.

skills.name: Chibaku Tensei
skills.description: Using his ultimate jutsu Deva Path Pein (S) deals 30 damage to all enemies. For 1 turn damage dealt by the enemy team will be reduced by 5. This skill cannot be countered and becomes 'Violent Water Wave' when used.

name: Dodai (S)
description: Dodai (S) is a skilled sensor shinobi and a lava release user as well. His intelligence is his most powerful asset and he will need it to survive this war.

skills.name: Rubber Wall
skills.description: Dodai creates a rubber wall that protects his team. For 3 turns, Dodai and his allies will gain 10 points of unpierceable damage reduction and ignore stun effects. During this time, they are immune to affliction damage.

skills.name: Communication Telepathy
skills.description: Dodai communicates directly with one enemy through telepathy, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, that enemy's stunning skills will be stunned for 1 turn. This skill will fully stun an enemy marked by 'Rubber Ball and Rope'.

skills.name: Rubber Ball and Rope
skills.description: Dodai traps one enemy inside a rubber ball and restrains them with a rope, dealing 35 damage to them. For 4 turns, that enemy will be marked. Afterwards, a random member of Dodai's team will become invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Lava Release Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Dodai (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Drunken Lee
description: Rock Lee has accidentally drunk too much Alcohol and has awakened his natural Drunken Fist Technique which has given him amazing speed and unpredictability.

skills.name: Unpredictable Assault
skills.description: Using his drunken master abilities, Lee deals 20 damage to one enemy that cannot be countered. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, Lee will instantly heal 10 health. Permanently, Lee will deal 5 additional damage. This effect stacks.

skills.name: Drunken Fist
skills.description: Lee charges at an enemy and hits them with a knockout blow, dealing 30 damage to that enemy, and for 1 turn, their skills will deal 100% less damage.

skills.name: Drunken Counter
skills.description: Lee targets himself or an ally. For 1 turn, the first harmful physical skill used on that ally will be countered. If successful, the countered enemy will have 'Unpredictable Assault' used on them. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Drunken Leap
skills.description: This skill makes Drunken Lee invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Ameyuri (S)
description: Edo Tensei Ameyuri (S) has been summoned from the dead to participate in the fourth ninja war. She wields the dual sharpest swords ever made.

skills.name: Silent Dual Sword Rampage
skills.description: Imbuing her swords with lightning, Ameyuri deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill will deal 10 additional damage if that enemy has their cooldowns increased or paralyzed. For 2 turns, that enemy's cooldowns will be paralyzed. This effect doesn't stack.

skills.name: Lightning Rain
skills.description: Ameyuri sends bolts of lightning to electrocute her targets, dealing 35 piercing damage to one enemy and 15 to all others. For 1 turn, all enemies will have their skills cooldown increased by 1. This skill deals 10 additional damage to enemies with their cooldowns paralyzed.

skills.name: Lightning Flow Trap
skills.description: Ameyuri surrounds each of her enemies with lightning. For 1 turn, all enemies will have their cooldowns increased by 1, and any enemy that does not use a new skill will receive 10 additional damage from Ameyuri's skills for 1 turn. This skill will permanently last 1 additional turn.

skills.name: Ameyuri Block
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Ameyuri (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Chiyo (S)
description: Edo Tensei Chiyo (S) has been summoned back from the afterlife. She may not like it but she will do her best to help her opponents out with information while she is forced to fight.

skills.name: White Secret Technique Ten Puppets
skills.description: Chiyo assaults her enemies using the ten puppets, stunning one enemy's physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. Afterwards, one random enemy will be dealt 20 damage for 2 turns.

skills.name: Possum
skills.description: Chiyo plays possum on one enemy and targets them. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will be countered. If successful, that enemy will be dealt 20 damage and will have their physical skills stunned for 1 turn. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: White Secret Art Illusion
skills.description: Edo Tensei Chiyo (S) targets one enemy, dealing 25 damage to them. For 1 turn, Edo Tensei Chiyo (S) will ignore all harmful skills.

skills.name: Chiyo Evade
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Chiyo (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Chukichi (S)
description: Reanimated during the Fourth Shinobi World War, Chukichi was a renowned sensor from the Hidden Mist, capable of detecting even the faintest chakra signatures. Combining his exceptional sensory abilities with frost-based concealment and silent assassination techniques, he became a deadly threat on the battlefield.

skills.name: Frozen Veil
skills.description: By surrounding himself with a veil of frost, Chukichi conceals his presence from his enemies. For the rest of the game, each turn he will become invulnerable to a random main class of skills for 1 turn. This skill can be used while active to make Chukichi immortal for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chakra Tracing
skills.description: Using his exceptional sensory abilities, Chukichi detects the chakra signatures of his enemies, increasing the cost of their skills by 1 random chakra for 1 turn. Any invisible skills active on them will be revealed.

skills.name: Soundless Execution
skills.description: Taking advantage of his concealed presence, Chukichi silently approaches his enemy and delivers a deadly strike, dealing 35 piercing damage to an enemy. The active cooldown of 'Chakra Tracing' will be reduced by 1 turn. This skill ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Swift Withdrawal
skills.description: This skill makes Chukichi invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Deidara (S)
description: Edo Tensei Deidara (S) has been revived and is immediately sent out to battle. Fighting on the front lines is nothing new to this old soul.

skills.name: Katsu!
skills.description: Deidara detonates all his bombs creating a great explosion, first becoming invulnerable for 1 turn and after dealing 5 piercing damage to all enemies. Afterwards, all stacks from Deidara's skills will be removed. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Bat Bombs
skills.description: Deidara deals 10 affliction damage to all enemies. Permanently, 'Katsu!' will deal 5 additional damage to them. For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a new skill will receive 15 additional damage instead from 'Katsu!'. The following turn, 'Jellyfish Explosives' will deal 5 additional damage.

skills.name: Jellyfish Explosives
skills.description: Deidara deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy. Permanently, 'Katsu!' will deal 10 additional damage to that enemy. For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a new skill will permanently receive 10 additional damage from 'Katsu!'. The following turn, 'Bat Bombs' will deal 5 additional damage.

skills.name: Chakra Clay Trap
skills.description: Deidara creates a trap to one enemy. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill they will be countered and will take 10 piercing damage. Permanently, the countered enemy will receive 10 additional damage from 'Katsu!'. The skill is invisible.

name: Edo Tensei Fuguki (S)
description: Reanimated by Kabuto during the Fourth Shinobi World War as one of the Seven Swordsmen of the Mist, Fuguki used to wield the Shark-Skin Blade, Samehada. A merciless man of few morals, Fuguki uniquely fights using his magnificent mane of red hair as a weapon, dynamically manipulating it to dominate his enemies.

skills.name: Hair Needle Senbon
skills.description: ET Fuguki deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a new skill on ET Fuguki or his allies will gain a stack of 'Hair Spikes'; This skill may only grant 1 stack to an enemy per turn.

skills.name: Hardened Spikes
skills.description: ET Fuguki instantly applies a stack of 'Hair Spikes' to the enemy team, and his team gains 15 points of destructible defense for 2 turns. During this time, any enemy that destroys this destructible defense will gain a stack of 'Hair Spikes'.

skills.name: Ranged Supression
skills.description: For 3 turns, one enemy will be dealt 5 piercing damage, granting them a stack of 'Hair Spikes' each turn, and the other enemies will be dealt 5 piercing damage every turn. During this time, any enemy that uses a new harmful skill will gain a stack of 'Hair Spikes'. This skill ends if Fuguki dies.

skills.name: Spiked Hair Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Fuguki (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hair Spikes
skills.description: An enemy affected by this skill will be dealt 2 piercing damage every turn for the rest of the game. During this time, that enemy will receive 5 additional damage from 'Hair Needle Senbon'. This skill stacks.

name: Edo Tensei Fuu (S)
description: Reanimated by Kabuto during the Fourth Shinobi World War, Fuu has had the Seven-Tails, Choumei, sealed back inside her. Having been made into one of Tobi's new Six Paths of Pain along with the other fallen jinchuuriki, Fuu is under his full control, skillfully utilizing the Seven-Tails' various insect abilities.

skills.name: Majestic Sting
skills.description: Fuu deals 15 damage to one enemy. The following turn, that enemy will receive 10 additional damage from Fuu's skills.

skills.name: Nanabi: Flying Assault
skills.description: Fuu becomes invulnerable for 1 turn and deals 30 damage to one enemy ignoring invulnerability.

skills.name: Scale Powder Blinding Attack
skills.description: Fuu deals 10 piercing damage to one enemy and makes them unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable for 1 turn. The following turn, that enemy will take another 10 damage and will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Fuu: Rinnegan Awareness
skills.description: This skill may be used to cast the last skill used by Fuu, costing random chakra and dealing 5 additional damage. Afterwards, the original version of the casted skill will be unable to be used by Fuu for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Ginkaku (S)
description: Edo Tensei Ginkaku (S) is one half of the legendary gold and silver brothers of the Hidden Cloud Village. They were the most notorious criminals in the history of the Hidden Cloud.

skills.name: Shichiseiken Slash
skills.description: Ginkaku deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. For this turn, any new stun effects used on that enemy will last 1 additional turn.

skills.name: Silence is Golden
skills.description: Ginkaku politely approaches an enemy, dealing 10 piercing damage to that enemy and stunning their skills for 1 turn. During this time, that enemy will become invulnerable to helpful skills and will receive 5 additional melee damage.

skills.name: Benihisago
skills.description: Ginkaku targets one enemy, selecting one random skill from that enemy for 3 turns. The next time that enemy uses the selected skill, they will be countered and Shichiseiken Slash will deal 5 additional damage to the countered enemy permanently. The selected skill is invisible.

skills.name: Shichiseiken Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Ginkaku (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Haku (S)
description: Edo Tensei Haku (S) is not sure why he is among the living again but his dream of protecting Zabuza pushes him to go all out.

skills.name: Silent Piercing Murder
skills.description: Haku deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. The following turn, that enemy will take 10 piercing damage. For 1 turn, they will lose 1 bloodline or ninjutsu chakra.

skills.name: Cristal Ice Mirrors Execution
skills.description: Haku deals 20 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, if this enemy uses a new harmful non-mental skill, that skill will be reflected onto another random enemy. If no skill is reflected, Haku will steal 1 bloodline chakra from that enemy.

skills.name: Low Temperature Enhancement
skills.description: Haku grants himself 15 destructible defense for 2 turns. The following 2 turns, he will deal 5 additional damage and gain 1 random chakra each turn.

skills.name: ET Haku Block
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Haku (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Hanzo (S)
description: Edo Tensei Hanzo (S) has been summoned back from the dead in the middle of a battlefield and he is not happy about it. Edo Hanzo (S) will engage anyone that crosses his path as he did when he was alive.

skills.name: Poison Sickle
skills.description: Hanzo deals 10 physical damage and 10 affliction damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they take 10 damage.

skills.name: Salamander Swallow
skills.description: Hanzo targets one enemy for 1 turn. The next harmful non-mental skill used by that enemy will have its non-damage effects nullified and the duration of the skill reduced by 1 turn. If triggered, the target takes 20 affliction damage. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Venom Sac
skills.description: For 1 turn, Hanzo gains 50% unpierceable damage reduction and ignores affliction damage. During this time, any enemy that uses a new skill on him will be *dealt 5 affliction damage for 3 turns. This skill is invisible until first triggered.

skills.name: Ibuse Guard
skills.description: This skill makes Hanzo invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive: Contaminated Battlefield
skills.description: At the start of the game, the battlefield becomes Toxic for all characters until Hanzo dies. While Toxic is active: Healing effects and destructible defense will be ignored by all characters. Any character that becomes invulnerable takes 3 permanent affliction damage. This passive cannot be ignored

name: Edo Tensei Itachi (S)
description: One of the five past Akatsuki members reanimated by Kabuto during the Fourth Shinobi World War, Itachi sees this as an opportunity to pursue his true goals and set things right with Naruto and Sasuke. Freeing himself from Kabuto's shackles, Itachi unleashes the full power of the Uchiha with his deathless body.

skills.name: Phoenix Flower Shuriken
skills.description: Itachi unleashes a volley of fire-infused shuriken, dealing 10 affliction damage to all enemies. For 1 turn, if they use a new harmful skill, they will have 'Phoenix Flower Shuriken' re-applied on them.

skills.name: Demonic Illusion: Mirage Crow
skills.description: For 2 turns, one enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable and will take 15 damage each turn. During this time, Itachi will become invulnerable to that enemy's skills.

skills.name: Passive: Edo Tensei Sharingan
skills.description: Each turn, this skill will randomly switch between 'Izanami', 'Itachi Mangekyou Sharingan', and 'Itachi Kotoamatsukami'. Each of these skills can only be used once per game. This passive is invisible.

skills.name: Itachi Block
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Itachi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Edo Tensei Mangekyou Sharingan
skills.description: This skill can only be used once to apply both 'Amaterasu' and 'Tsukuyomi' on an enemy; This skill ends when Itachi killed. Amaterasu: Deals 20 affliction damage instantly, and 5 affliction permanently. Tsukuyomi: Fully stuns the enemy's skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Edo Tensei Kotoamatsukami
skills.description: This skill can only be used once to target Itachi or an ally permanently. The next time the marked target's health drops to 5 or less, they will instantly heal to 40 health, and then heal 5 health for the following 3 turns. This skill is invisible until triggered.

skills.name: Izanami
skills.description: This skill can only be used once to target an enemy permanently. The next time that enemy uses a new skill, they will be countered and this skill will end. If successful, the countered skill will be stunned for 3 turns; This duration is increased by the skill's current cooldown. This skill is invisible until triggered.

name: Edo Tensei Jinin (S)
description: Edo Tensei Jinin (S) is a former member of the seven swordsman of the mist. Using his sword Kabutowari he will demonstrate the power of the previous generation on the battttle.

skills.name: Silent Killing Axe
skills.description: ET Jinin deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and marks them for 2 turns. While marked, they will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable. If the target is marked by 'Silent Killing Hammer', it's duration is extended by 1 turn.

skills.name: Silent Killing Hammer
skills.description: ET Jinin deals 20 damage to one enemy, stuns their non-mental skills and markes them for 1 turn. While marked, they will receive 5 additional non-affliction damage. If the target is marked by 'Silent Killing Axe', it's duration is extended by 1 turn.

skills.name: Axe & Hammer Smash
skills.description: ET Jinin deals 30 damage to one enemy. Before dealing damage, if they are marked by 'Silent Killing Axe', this will destroy destructible defense. If marked by 'Silent Killing Hammer', this will convert any damage reduction into additional non-affliction damage received instead. If marked by both, this deals an additional 10 damage and stuns them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Skilled Evasion
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Jinin (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Jinpachi (S)
description: Edo Tensei Jinpachi (S) is one of the previous Seven Swordsmen of the Mist and a particularly cruel individual.

skills.name: Explosive Tag Primer
skills.description: ET Jinpachi gains 10 permanent destructible defense. The next use of 'Silent Explosion' will deal 15 chakra piercing damage* to the target. If an enemy destroys the defense of this skill, they will take 15 piercing damage* and this skill will end.

skills.name: Silent Explosion
skills.description: Jinpachi deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and reduces their non-affliction damage by 5 for 1 turn. If 'Explosive Tag Primer' is used on the last turn, this skill will cost 1 additional random chakra for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shibuki Explosion Chain
skills.description: ET Jinpachi gains 10 permanent destructible defense. The next use of 'Silent Explosion' will deal 10 permanent affliction damage* to the target. If an enemy destroys the defense of this skill, they will take 10 affliction damage* permanently and this skill will end.

skills.name: Shibuki Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Jinpachi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Jiroubou (S)
description: Reanimated by Kabuto during the Fourth Shinobi World War along with his Sound Four teammates, Jiroubou is back on the battlefield, and is out for blood. With immense brute force through his mastery of the Cursed Seal, as well as his Earth Release and chakra absorption techniques, Jiroubou is a threat to anyone.

skills.name: Flying Strike
skills.description: Jiroubou strikes an enemy, dealing 25 damage to them and giving them 1 stack of 'Dark Chakra Unseal'.

skills.name: Boulder Throw
skills.description: Jiroubou throws a giant rock at the enemy team, dealing 10 damage to them and giving them 1 stack of 'Dark Chakra Unseal'. Afterwards, Jiroubou gains 10 points of permanent destructible defense.

skills.name: Hostage Kidnapping
skills.description: For 2 turns, Jiroubou kidnaps an enemy, making them ignore all helpful effects, and this skill will be replaced by 'Hostage Drain'. This skill will consume all stacks of 'Dark Chakra Unseal' from that enemy to last 1 additional turn per stack consumed.

skills.name: Jiroubou Bare Hands Block
skills.description: This skill makes Jiroubou invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hostage Drain
skills.description: Jiroubou targets an enemy affected by 'Hostage Kidnapping', stealing 10 health and 1 bloodline or genjutsu chakra from them, and granting them 1 stack of 'Dark Chakra Unseal'.

skills.name: Dark Chakra Unseal
skills.description: Enemies affected by 'Dark Chakra Unseal' will receive 5 additional damage from Jiroubou's skills.

name: Edo Tensei Kakuzu (S)
description: Resurrected through the Edo Tensei, Kakuzu returns to the battlefield with his forbidden technique. Commanding multiple elemental hearts, he overwhelms his enemies with powerful ninjutsu while exploiting their life force to sustain his relentless assault.

skills.name: Jiongu: Deadly Embrace
skills.description: Kakuzu extends his black threads to wrap around an enemy's neck, dealing 25 damage to them and stunning their physical and mental skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Heart Manifestation Assault
skills.description: Using his Jiongu offensively, Kakuzu sacrifices one of his Jiongu hearts, dealing 60 damage to one enemy and stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. This skill can only be used as long as Kakuzu has any Jiongu Heart left.

skills.name: Heart Extraction
skills.description: Kakuzu tears into an enemy to replenish his collection of hearts, stealing 15 health from that enemy and also any damage reduction effect they currently have on them.

skills.name: Jiongu: Thread Evasion
skills.description: This skill makes Kakuzu invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive: Jiongu Heart Collection
skills.description: Through his Jiongu, Kakuzu starts the game with 4 additional hearts. Everytime his health reaches 0, his health will be set to 15. This can only happen 4 times in the game, one for each Jiongu Heart Kakuzu has. This skill's stacks refers to the amount of hearts lost.

name: Edo Tensei Kidoumaru (S)
description: Reanimated by Kabuto during the Fourth Shinobi World War along with his Sound Four teammates, Kidoumaru is happy to be back in action and wreaking havoc once again. Terrorizing the battlefield with his many spider-based jutsu, enhanced by his Cursed Seal, Kidoumaru is a menace to all who cross his path.

skills.name: The Spider's Web
skills.description: Kidoumaru enables his skills and targets all enemies permanently. Every time they use a new harmful skill, they will gain 1 'Web Stack'. This skill ignores invulnerability and will be replaced by 'Sticky Golden Arrow'.

skills.name: Sticky Gold Kunai
skills.description: Kidoumaru deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their non-mental skills for 1 turn. Afterwards, all enemies will be dealt 5 piercing damage for each 'Web Stack' they have.

skills.name: Giant Spider Web
skills.description: Kidoumaru traps all enemies in a giant web, granting them 1 additional 'Web Stack' and then making them deal 10 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Curse Mark Third Eye
skills.description: Kidoumaru activates his Curse Mark, becoming invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sticky Golden Arrow
skills.description: Using the Sticky Golden Arrow, Kidoumaru destroys all destructible defense one enemy has and deals 25 piercing damage to them, consuming all 'Web Stacks' they have to deal 10 additional damage per stack.

name: Edo Tensei Kimimaro (S)
description: Edo Tensei Kimimaro was resurrected by Kabuto as an unfeeling weapon of war, his loyalty and discipline preserved even beyond death. He wields the Shikotsumyaku Kekkei Genkai to turn his own skeleton into blades and armor, growing stronger the longer he remains unbroken. Every strike hardens his defenses, and every moment of restraint builds toward an inevitable, bone-shattering end.

skills.name: Bone Rush
skills.description: Kimimaro rushes one enemy, dealing 25 damage to them and gaining 1 stack of 'Bone Spikes'. This skill will deal 10 additional damage for every 3 stacks of 'Bone Spikes'.

skills.name: Skeleton Splinters
skills.description: Kimimaro unleashes sharpened bone shards at all enemies, dealing 15 piercing damage to them and gaining 1 stack of 'Bone Spikes'. This skill will deal 5 additional damage for every 3 stacks of 'Bone Spikes'.

skills.name: Dead Man's Skewer
skills.description: Kimimaro impales his opponents, dealing 50 piercing damage to one enemy and 15 piercing damage to all other enemies. This skill cannot be countered and requires at least 5 stacks of 'Bone Spikes' to be used.

skills.name: Shikotsumyaku Guard
skills.description: Kimimaro reinforces his body with his Shikotsumyaku, gaining 20 permanent destructible defense. For the next 2 turns, whenever an enemy uses a new non-mental skill on Kimimaro, he will gain 1 stack of 'Bone Spikes'.

skills.name: Bone Spikes
skills.description: Kimimaro forms sharp bone spikes around his body. Whenever an enemy uses a new non-mental skill on him, they will take 3 piercing damage*. This skill stacks and cannot be removed.

name: Edo Tensei Kinkaku (S)
description: Edo Tensei Kinkaku (S) is one half of the Gold and Silver brothers, said to have been swallowed by Kyuubi and gaining its' Chakra, Kinkaku uses his chakra and legendary tools to fight.

skills.name: Bashousen: Assault
skills.description: Kinaku assaults an enemy with his treasured tool, dealing 25 affliction damage to them. For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a new non-mental skill on Kinkaku will take 10 affliction damage.

skills.name: Bashosen: Coil of Fire
skills.description: Kinkaku uses his treasured tool to generate a wave of flames, dealing 15 affliction damage to all enemies permanently. During this time, they will have the cooldown of their skills increased by 2 turns. This skill will end on an enemy when they use any new skill.

skills.name: Koukinjou Counter
skills.description: Kinkaku targets an enemy for 1 turn. If that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will be countered and dealt 35 damage. If successful, that enemy will also receive 10 additional damage from 'Bashousen: Assault' for 1 turn. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Koukinjou Block
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Kinkaku (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Kuriarare (S)
description: Edo Tensei Kuriarare (S) was a member of the Seven Swordsmen of the Mist and a member of the Hidden Mist Village's Anbu. During his life he committed countless atrocities and he is happy to be back from death to engage his newfound opponents.

unlock.detail: The Anbu of the Mists Past

skills.name: Spider Sewing
skills.description: Kuriarare applies 1 stack of 'Wire String' on all enemies. For 1 turn, any enemy affected by this skill will deal 5 less non-affliction damage. If used on enemies with 3 or more stacks of 'Wire String', they will deal 10 less non-affliction damage instead for 1 turn.

skills.name: Silent Stiching
skills.description: Kuriarare deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. Afterwards, all other enemies will have 1 stack of 'Wire String' applied on them. If the main target has 3 or more stacks of 'Wire String', they will be instantly killed if they health drops to 15 or less.

skills.name: Wire Crucifixion
skills.description: Kuriarare cuts through one enemy trapped in his wire strings, dealing 15 affliction damage to them and stunning their non-mental skills. If used on an enemy with 3 or more stacks of 'Wire String', they will be fully stunned instead.

skills.name: Senbon Block
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Kuriarare (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Wire String
skills.description: Enemies marked by 'Wire String' will permanently receive 5 additional damage from Kuriarare's skills.

name: Edo Tensei Mangetsu (S)
description: Reanimated by Kabuto during the Fourth Shinobi World War as one of the Seven Swordsmen of the Mist, Mangetsu was widely feared as the 'Second Coming of the Demon'. The older brother of Suigetsu, Mangetsu primarily used the Twin Sword, Hiramekarei, though he was famously a master of all seven blades.

unlock.detail: The Second Coming of the Demon

skills.name: Hydrification Technique
skills.description: ET Mangetsu steals 20 health points from one enemy. For 1 turn, a random skill class will be chosen, and ET Mangetsu will ignore all enemy skills of that class, or none if no class is chosen.

skills.name: Impure World Regeneration
skills.description: When this skill is used, ET Mangetsu will heal 2 health every turn for the rest of the game. This skill stacks and may only be used 5 times.

skills.name: Mist Sword Summoning
skills.description: Mangetsu randomly summons one of the Seven Swords, granting 'Hydrification Technique' a random unique effect every turn. Hiramekarei: Steals 10 additional health. / Kubikiribocho: Grants 10 permanent destructible defense. / Sameheada: Steals 1 random chakra from the target. / Nuibari: Stuns non-mental skills for 1 turn. / Shibuki: Deals 5 permanent affliction damage. / Kabutowari: Destroys destructible defense and deals 15 piercing damage. / Kiba: Deals 20 affliction damage to all other enemies.

skills.name: Mangetsu Block
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Mangetsu (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Muu (S)
description: Muu, the Second Tsuchikage, was revived against his will to fight. He is a skilled spy, capable of infiltrating the battlefield undetected, in addition to his Kekkei Touta, the atomic detachment, capable of turning enemies into dust in a matter of moments.

skills.name: Fission
skills.description: ET Muu grant himself or one ally 50% of unpierceable damage reduction points for 1 turn. During this turn, any enemy that uses a new skill on that ally will receive 5 additional damage from non-affliction skills permanently. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Atomic Detachment
skills.description: ET Muu deals 20 damage to one enemy and an additional 15 piercing damage the first turn and 10 piercing damage the following turn. During this time, that enemy's skills will cost 1 additional random chakra. This skill ends if that enemy uses a new skill.

skills.name: Chameleon Covering
skills.description: ET Muu makes himself or one ally ignore all harmful effects except damage for 1 turn. If the protected character receive a new harmful skill, 'Atomic Detachment will cost 2 random chakra for 1 turn. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Sensorial Awareness
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Muu (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Nagato (S)
description: Edo Tensei Nagato (S) has been summoned to do battle. He is fully aware of the fact that he is being controlled again as he was while he was living.

skills.name: Human Path
skills.description: Nagato draws out the lifeforce of an enemy, stealing 15 health and dealing 20 damage. That enemy's harmful skills will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Preta Path
skills.description: Nagato drains an enemy's energy, dealing 10 affliction damage and removing 1 taijutsu or ninjutsu chakra from their chakra pool. While improved by 'Animal Path', this skill will steal health and chakra instead.

skills.name: Animal Path
skills.description: Nagato summons various animals and creatures, dealing 15 damage to all enemies for 2 turns. During this time, any enemy that uses a new skill on Edo Tensei Nagato will be *dealt 10 piercing damage. For 1 turn, 'Human Path' will deal piercing damage, while 'Preta Path' will steal health and chakra.

skills.name: Naraka Path
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Nagato (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Pakura (S)
description: Edo Tensei Pakura (S) was a revered shinobi of the Hidden Sand in the past. So much so that she was revived against her will to participate in the fourth shinobi world war.

unlock.detail: The Kind Kunoichi of the Past

skills.name: Scorch Release
skills.description: Pakura deals 20 affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their healing skills for 1 turn. During this time, they will ignore healing effects.

skills.name: Searing Combat
skills.description: Pakura deals 5 affliction damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, all enemies that use a new harmful skill will take 5 affliction damage and 'Scorch Release' will deal 10 additional damage on them.

skills.name: Steaming Murder
skills.description: Pakura deals 35 affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their helpful skills for 1 turn. If they are affected by 'Scorch Release', this will stun for 1 additional turn. If affected by 'Searing Combat', this will deal 5 additional damage. The following turn, Pakura's skills will cost random chakras instead.

skills.name: Experienced Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Pakura (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Rasa (S)
description: Edo Tensei Rasa (S), the former Fourth Kazekage, has been summoned to participate in the war. Even after returning from death, he will prioritize his village above all else.

skills.name: Magnet Release
skills.description: Rasa manipulates his gold dust, fortifying himself. For 4 turns, he will gain 5 points of damage reduction and ignore enemy affliction damage. During this time, 'Gold Dust Waterfall' will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Gold Dust Waterfall
skills.description: Rasa engulfs one enemy in a massive waterfall of gold dust, dealing 40 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, that enemy will ignore helpful effects.

skills.name: Gold Dust Shield
skills.description: Rasa raises a massive shield of gold dust to protect his team. For 2 turns, they will gain 10 points of damage reduction and be immune to affliction damage. If targetable, all enemies will take 10 damage for 2 turns.

skills.name: Gold Dust Manipulation
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Rasa (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Roshi (S)
description: Reanimated by Kabuto during the Fourth Shinobi World War, Roshi has had the Four-Tails, Son Goku, sealed back inside him. Having been made into one of Tobi's new Six Paths of Pain along with the other fallen jinchuuriki, Roshi is under his full control, spewing the Four-Tails' lava at anyone who might get in his way.

skills.name: Multiple Scorching Rocks
skills.description: Roshi deals 30 affliction damage to one enemy and 10 affliction damage to a random different enemy. 'Passive: Fiery Body' deals 1 additional damage permanently (stacks).

skills.name: Lava Armor
skills.description: Roshi gains 15 unpierceable defense and deals 10 affliction damage to any enemy that uses a new non-mental skill on him for 4 turns. 'Passive: Fiery Body' deals 1 additional damage permanently (stacks).

skills.name: Magma Field
skills.description: For 3 turns, Roshi will automatically trigger 'Passive: Fiery Body' at the end of every turn. The following 3 turns, the enemy team will remove/steal 1 less chakra with their skills. During this time, 'Multiple Scorching Rocks' will cost 1 less random energy. 'Passive: Fiery Body' deals 1 additional damage permanently (stacks).

skills.name: Roshi Partial-Tailed Beast Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Roshi invulnerable for 1 turn. 'Passive: Fiery Body' deals 1 additional damage permanently (stacks).

skills.name: Passive: Fiery Body
skills.description: Every time Roshi uses a new skill, he deals 1 affliction damage to the enemy team, ignoring invulnerability.

name: Edo Tensei Sakon (S)
description: Reanimated by Kabuto during the Fourth Shinobi World War along with their Sound Four teammates, Sakon and Ukon relish being on the battlefield once again. Dynamically splitting and merging their bodies through the use of their Cursed Seal, the twins fight as a powerful unit, showing no mercy to anyone.

skills.name: Enhanced Gatling Punch
skills.description: Sakon rapidly punches one enemy, dealing 20 damage and 15 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, that enemy will deal 15 less non-affliction damage. The following turn, 'Parasite Demon' will be improved and fully stun the target instead.

skills.name: Parasite Demon
skills.description: Sakon enters an enemy's body, dealing 20 affliction damage to them and stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. This skill cannot be used on the same target next turn. The following turn, 'Enhanced Gatling Punch' will deal 5 additional damage.

skills.name: Summoning: Triple Rashoman
skills.description: Sakon summons the walls of Triple Rashoman, removing all harmful skills from himself and gaining 15 points of destructible defense for every skill he has used in the game. This skill will increase its current cooldown by 1 for every 15 destructible defense granted. These stacks reset when used.

skills.name: Sakon: Chakra Unseal
skills.description: This skill makes Sakon invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Sasori (S)
description: Edo Tensei Sasori (S) has been resurrected in the ageless body that he had always wanted during his life. He is sent out to the battlefield in Akatsuki's ambush squad.

skills.name: Chakra Threads
skills.description: Sasori manipulates his puppets, gaining 10 points of destructible defense for 3 turns. During this time, 'Puppet Manipulation' deals 5 additional damage and 'Chakra Threads: Puppet Trap' will reflect all harmful skills instead.

skills.name: Puppet Manipulation
skills.description: Edo Tensei Sasori deals 15 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy will deal 10 less non-affliction damage. If the health of that enemy drops to 35 or below, their physical and chakra skills will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chakra Threads: Puppet Trap
skills.description: Edo Tensei Sasori targets one ally for 1 turn. The first harmful skill used on that ally will be reflected upon the enemy. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Falling Guard
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Sasori (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Tayuya (S)
description: Edo Tensei Tayuya was resurrected by Kabuto as a cruel battlefield conductor, her malice and arrogance undimmed by death. She uses her cursed flute to summon demonic warriors and unravel enemies through sound-based genjutsu and mental pressure. As the fight drags on, her control tightens, turning chaos into a carefully orchestrated nightmare.

skills.name: Demonic Melody
skills.description: Tayuya deals 5 affliction damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, if they use a new harmful damaging skill, Tayuya will steal 5 health from them. The following 3 turns, 'Doki Ghost' will be improved.

skills.name: Doki Ghost
skills.description: Tayuya summons her doki ghosts, dealing 20 affliction damage to one enemy. While improved, this skill will steal 20 health and 1 ninjutsu or bloodline chakra instead.

skills.name: Summoning: Doki Demons
skills.description: For 1 turn, the first harmful damaging skill used on her or an ally will be countered. If successful, the countered enemy will be dealt 5 damage and will have their harmful skills stunned for 1 turn. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Tayuya: Chakra Unseal
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Tayuya (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Edo Tensei Yagura (S)
description: Resurrected through Edo Tensei, Yagura retains perfect control over the Three-Tails' power. His Water Mirror techniques allow him to capture, store, and return enemy techniques with deadly precision, turning an opponent’s own strength against them while remaining nearly untouchable.

skills.name: Water Mirror
skills.description: Yagura targets an enemy for 3 turns. If that enemy uses a new harmful skill, that skill will be permanently stored by 'Water Mirror' and they will deal 5 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. This skill is invisible, ignores invulnerability, and cannot be used on the same target.

skills.name: Hook Staff Tilt
skills.description: Yagura casts a random skill stored by 'Water Mirror' on an enemy. The stored skill is removed. This skill may only be used if 'Water Mirror' has at least one skill stored.

skills.name: Mirror Image
skills.description: Yagura uses Mirror Image on an enemy, dealing 30 damage to them. For 1 turn, they will deal 5 less non-affliction damage and a random harmful skill from that enemy will be stored by 'Water Mirror'. The following turn, 'Hook Staff Tilt' will cast 2 random skills stored by 'Water Mirror' at once.

skills.name: Yagura Partial Tailed Beast Mode
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Yagura (S) invulnerable for 1 turn. The following turn, 'Hook Staff Tilt' will be improved and cost 1 random chakra instead.

skills.name: Reflective Mirror
skills.description: This skill will be activated every time Yagura uses 'Hook Staff Tilt' or 'Mirror Image'. For 1 turn, Yagura will ignore the first harmful physical or chakra skill used on him. If successfully triggered, the ignored skill will be stored by 'Water Mirror'. This skill will be disabled for 2 turns when activated.

name: Edo Tensei Yota (S)
description: A young child from a nomadic clan, Yota died at an early age, but was revived through Edo Tensei by Orochimaru and kept alive for years as a test subject. A curious, naïve, and sensitive boy, Yota can manipulate the weather around himself, and is deployed by Kabuto to fight in the Fourth Shinobi World War.

skills.name: Weather Manipulation Rain: Water Wave
skills.description: Yota cries, and a sudden wave crashes down on a random enemy, dealing 15 damage to them, and after targets 0 random enemies, dealing 15 damage to each one of them. This skill will target 1 additional random enemy for each 'Rain Stack' that Yota has. Afterwards, Yota gains 1 'Rain Stack'.

skills.name: Weather Manipulation Rain: Water Spheres
skills.description: Yota gains 15 points of damage reduction* and deals 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns. Each turn, Yota cries and gains 1 'Rain Stack'. During this time, If Yota is stunned, he will cry even more, gaining 1 additional 'Rain Stack' and healing 10 health.

skills.name: Wather Manipulation Lightning
skills.description: Yota sends a devastating lightning strike to obliterate all enemies, dealing 10 affliction damage to them for each 'Rain Stack' Yota currently has.

skills.name: Yota is happy don't bother him
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Yota (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Rain Stack
skills.description: Each time Yota cries, he intensifies the rain on the battlefield, gaining 1 Rain Stack and enhancing her skills.

name: Edo Tensei Yugito (S)
description: Reanimated by Kabuto during the Fourth Shinobi World War, Yugito has had the Two-Tails, Matatabi, sealed back inside her. Having been made into one of Tobi's new Six Paths of Pain along with the other fallen jinchuuriki, Yugito is under his full control, fighting her foes using the Two-Tails' fiery feline powers.

skills.name: Cat Claws
skills.description: Yugito deals 15 damage to one enemy and stuns their non-mental skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Fiery Mouse Hairball
skills.description: Yugito deals 15 damage to one enemy and removes 1 taijutsu chakra from them.

skills.name: Nibi: Rage Punch
skills.description: Yugito destroys all destructible defense of one enemy, deals 15 piercing damage to them and kills them if their health drops to 10 or less.

skills.name: Yugito: Rinnegan Awareness
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Yugito (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive: Nibi Awakening
skills.description: Every time Yugito uses a new harmful skill, she gains 10 additional damage, stacking until she stops using new harmful skills. If Yugito passes 2 turns without using a new harmful skill, her skills will cost 1 random chakra for 1 turn. The bonus damage may only stack up to a maximum of 30.

name: Edo Tensei Zabuza (S)
description: Edo Tensei Zabuza (S) has been summoned from the dead against his will. His unique abilities will surely be put to use on the battlefield. Pics by: Pain_Alagoano

skills.name: Demon Shroud
skills.description: Zabuza emantes shroud putting pressure in the battlefield. For 1 turn, all enemies will have the cost of their harmful skills increased by 1 random chakra. Afterwards, any enemy affected by this skill will receive 5 additional damage from Zabuza's skills permanently. This effect stacks.

skills.name: Executioner Strike
skills.description: Zabuza executes one enemy dealing 20 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, that enemy's skills will have 1 additional cooldown.

skills.name: Executioner Blade Absorption
skills.description: Zabuza steals 10 health from one enemy and for 1 turn, that enemy's harmful skills will cost 1 additional bloodline chakra.

skills.name: Demon Insight
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Zabuza (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: ET Nidaime Mizukage (S)
description: Edo Tensei Nidaime Mizukage (S) has been resurrected against his will to do battle. He does not want to hurt anyone but he is interested in the potential of the new generation. He will test their limits with his own skill.

skills.name: Major Summoning: Giant Clam
skills.description: Gengetsu summons a huge clam that exudes illsory mist, granting his team 30 points of destructible defense for 3 turns. Each turn, a random member of his team becoms a mirage, nullyfing the first harmful skill used on them for 1 turn; The target is invisible. This skill ends if Gengetsu is killed.

skills.name: Hozuki Water Gun
skills.description: Gengetsu fires a drop of water like a bullet at one enemy, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. If that enemy's health drops to 10 or less, they will be killed. During 'Major Summoning: Giant Clam', this skill will deal 5 additional damage and wll kill enemy if they health drop 15 or less.

skills.name: Steam Imp
skills.description: For 1 turn, Gengetsu makes his team ignore all stun effects. If targetable, all enemies will be dealt 10 affliction damage. During 'Major Summoning: Giant Clam', this skill will last 1 additional turn.

skills.name: Genjutsu Defense
skills.description: This skill makes ET Nidaime Mizukage (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Mirage
skills.description: While 'Major Summoning: Giant Clam' is active, this skill will be applied to a random member of Gengetsu's team. For 1 turn, the target will ignore the first harmful skill used on them. This skill is invisible.

name: ET Sandaime Raikage (S)
description: Edo Tensei Sandaime Raikage (S) is not pleased to be back among the living and forced to do battle. He does however have faith that the new generation of shinobi can defeat him and his peers.

skills.name: Four Finger Nukite
skills.description: Sandaime Raikage uses Four Finger Nukite on one enemy dealing 25 damage. Sandaime Raikage gains 5 points of damage reduction permanently when this skill is used. This skill becomes 'Three Finger Nukite' permanently when used.

skills.name: Lightning Release Shockwave
skills.description: Using Lightning Release Shockwave Edo Tensei Sandaime Raikage (S) targets one enemy dealing 30 damage. One random enemy will be dealt 30 damage that ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: One Finger Nukite Spear
skills.description: Edo Tensei Sandaime Raikage (S) uses One Finger Nukite Spear on one enemy dealing 50 piercing damage. This skill cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Immense Speed
skills.description: This skill makes ET Sandaime Raikage (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Three Finger Nukite
skills.description: Using Three Finger Nukite, Sandaime Raikage gains 15 points of damage reduction permanently. 'One Finger Nukite Spear' can be used permanently. After that, 'four finger nukite' can only be used on the enemy; this skill cannot be removed.

name: ET Susanoo Itachi (S)
description: Having been reanimated once more, Itachi now manifests the full power of his Susanoo in battle. Shielded by the Yata Mirror and wielding the sealing Totsuka Blade, he becomes a relentless force that blends absolute defense with lethal precision.

skills.name: Skeletal Blade
skills.description: Using his Susanoo's skeletal blade, Itachi deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. Permanently, that enemy will receive 5 additional damage from harmful skills.

skills.name: Interrupting Slice
skills.description: Itachi deals 15 piercing damage to one enemy. Permanently, that enemy will deal 5 less non-affliction damage.

skills.name: Totsuka Blade Sealing
skills.description: Itachi seals one enemy with his Susanoo's legendary blade, dealing 35 affliction damage to them, removing 1 bloodline or genjutsu chakra and stunning their harmful skills for 1 turn. This skill cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Edo Tensei Susanoo
skills.description: For 3 turns, if Itachi's health drops to 35 or less, Itachi's Susanoo will evolve to the next stage, improving his skills for the following 3 turns. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Yasaka Magatama' and Itachi's skills will steal health instead. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Yasaka Magatama
skills.description: Itachi unleashes his strongest long-range technique, dealing 40 piercing damage to all enemies. This skill cannot be countered.

name: Female Animal Path Pein (S)
description: One of Nagato's Six Paths of Pain, the Female Animal Path is a relentless and tactical combatant who overwhelms her enemies through the summoning of massive, destructive creatures. Calm and emotionless, she specializes in battlefield control, using her summons to pressure multiple opponents at once while remaining difficult to pin down.

skills.name: Animal Path Summoning
skills.description: Female Animal Path summons all pre-selected animals to the battlefield. For each animal summoned, Female Animal Path gains 5 destructible defense. Animals, when summoned, cannot be pre-selected for the following 3 turns. This skill will cost 1 additional random chakra for each pre-selected animal. This skill ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Rampaging Buffalo
skills.description: Pre-selects this animal for the next use of 'Animal Path Summoning'. When active, deals 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, any enemy that does not use a new skill will take another 10 damage. This skill will be replaced by 'Stampeding Rhino'.

skills.name: Venomous Centipede
skills.description: Pre-selects this animal for the next use of 'Animal Path Summoning'. When active, Female Animal Path grants her team 15 points of destructible defense and any enemy that destroys it will take 5 affliction damage* for 3 turns.

skills.name: Giant Crab
skills.description: Pre-selects this animal for the next use of 'Animal Path Summoning'. When active, Female Animal Path and her allies become invulnerable to non-affliction skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Stampeding Rhino
skills.description: Pre-selects this animal for the next use of 'Animal Path Summoning'. For 3 turns, each turn a random enemy will take 20 damage and will have their non-mental skills stunned for 1 turn. This skill will be replaced by 'Rampaging Buffalo' after use.

name: Four Tail Kyuubi Naruto (S)
description: After completely giving into his anger and manifesting a fourth tail, Naruto ceases to be himself. In this state, Naruto's own body is completely overtaken by a deep, dense Nine-Tails chakra cloak, and at the cost of huge internal damage, Naruto becomes a mindless monster; a being of pure rage and destruction.

skills.name: Four Tails Transformation
