skills.description: Naruto gains 15 points of damage reduction and 20 points of destructible defense permanently. During this time, he cannot be stunned. Each turn Naruto uses a new harmful skill, he loses 10 health that cannot kill him. This skill will be replaced by 'Kyuubi Chakra Gather'.

skills.name: Shockwave Smash
skills.description: Naruto smashes the ground, generating a violent shockwave and dealing 15 piercing damage to all enemies. The following turn, 'Four Tailed Beast Bomb' will cost 1 less random chakra. Requires 'Four Tails Transformation'.

skills.name: Four Tailed Beast Bomb
skills.description: Naruto releases a massive tailed beast bomb, dealing 50 piercing damage to one enemy. The following turn, 'Shockwave Smash' will deal 5 additional damage. Requires 'Four Tails Transformation'.

skills.name: Kyuubi Chakra Skin
skills.description: This skill makes Four Tail Kyuubi Naruto (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Kyuubi Chakra Gather
skills.description: Naruto concentrates an immense amount of chakra in his mouth, gaining 10 permanent destructible defense and permanently increasing 'Four Tailed Beast Bomb' damage by 5. This skill will end when Naruto uses his next new harmful skill. This skill may only stack 3 times.

name: Fukasaku and Shima (S)
description: Fukasaku and Shima (S) are known as the two great sage toads of Mount Myoboku. They taught both Jiraiya and Naruto sage jutsu and are each skilled in elemental techniques as well as genjutsu techniques.

skills.name: Frog Song
skills.description: Fukasaku and Shima (S) use their pattened genjustu to use Frog Song. They target 1 enemy and deal 15 affliction damage for 2 turns. During Toad Confrontation Singing this skill will cost 1 random chakra instead.

skills.name: Sand Dust
skills.description: This skill makes Fukasaku and Shima's team invulnerable to non-mental skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Toad Confrontation Singing
skills.description: Fukasaku and Shima targets all enemies, dealing 15 damage to them for 2 turns. For 1 turn, if they use a new harmful non-mental skill, they will have their harmful non-mental skills stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Frogs Tag Team
skills.description: This skill makes Fukasaku and Shima (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Fuuton Naruto (S)
description: During his training under Kakashi and Yamato, Naruto discovers his affinity for Wind Release. By using shadow clones to accelerate his progress, he learns to combine wind-nature chakra with the Rasengan and creates the devastating Rasenshuuriken.

skills.name: Fuuton: Rasengan
skills.description: Using the wind-style version of the Rasengan, Naruto deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy. During 'Mass Shadow Clones', this skill will apply once 'Wind Destruction' on all enemies.

skills.name: Fuuton: Rasenshuuriken
skills.description: Using his recently created clones, Naruto hurls an even more powerful Rasengan at one enemy, dealing 40 piercing damage to them. During 'Mass Shadow Clones', this skill will apply twice 'Wind Destruction' on all enemies.

skills.name: Mass Shadow Clones
skills.description: Naruto gains 5 clones, granting himself 10% unpierceable damage reduction for each clone. If a new non-affliction damage skill is used on Naruto, he will lose 1 clone. During this time, Naruto improves his skills and loses 2 clones whenever he uses one of them. This skill cannot be used while active.

skills.name: Kyuubi Insight
skills.description: This skill makes Fuuton Naruto invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Wind Destruction
skills.description: For 1 turn, all enemies will deal 5 less non-affliction damage. The following turn, they will take 10 piercing damage.

name: Gaara of the Desert
description: A Jinchuuriki from the Village of Sand, Gaara is an unstable ninja with the Shukaku, the one-tailed beast. With the Shukaku, and his own abilities, Gaara can manipulate the sand in his gourd to crush the enemy, or defend himself.

skills.name: Desert Graveyard
skills.description: Gaara crushes one enemy with sand, dealing 50 affliction damage to them and removing all 'Desert Coffin' stacks from them. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Desert Coffin
skills.description: Gaara surrounds one enemy with a pile of sand, stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn. Permanently, that enemy will receive 25 additional damage from 'Desert Graveyard'. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Third Eye
skills.description: For 2 turns, if a new harmful skill is used on Gaara or his allies, the following will happen: physical/chakra - skill costs reduced by 1 random chakra for 1 turn; affliction - heal 10 health and ignore affliction damage for 1 turn; mental - invulnerability for 1 turn. This skill ends after being triggered and is invisible.

skills.name: Sand Shield
skills.description: This skill makes Gaara of the Desert invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Gaara Rehabilitated
description: After his fateful encounter with Naruto, Gaara has left behind his murderous ways. He has become even more skilled with using sand since Naruto last saw him too.

skills.name: Sand Mastery
skills.description: Using sand to both defend and attack, Gaara gains 5 permanent destructible defense. Permanently, Gaara's skills will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Desert Imperial Funeral
skills.description: Gaara deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable and their skills will cost 1 additional random chakra. If that enemy is affected by 'Quicksand Waterfall', their skills will cost 2 additional random chakra instead.

skills.name: Quicksand Waterfall
skills.description: Gaara creates massive waves of sand. For 4 turns, Gaara and his allies gain 10 destructible defense and all enemies take 10 damage*. During this time, if Gaara or an ally receives new non-affliction damage, they will gain 5 destructible defense the following turn.

skills.name: Shield of Shukaku
skills.description: Gaara uses the ultimately hard absolute defense, creating a protective shield in front of his team and granting them 20 points of destructible defense for 3 turns.

name: Gekko Hayate
description: Gekko Hayate is a jounin and one of the instructors of the chuunin exams in Konoha. He is an intelligent Shinobi that distances himself from an enemy to use illusionary techniques.

skills.name: Crescent Moon Slash
skills.description: Hayate jumps on an enemy from above, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. Permanently, 'Dance of the Crescent Moon' will deal 10 additional damage when this skill is used. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Dance of the Crescent Moon
skills.description: Using both his sword and genjutsu, Hayate becomes invulnerable for 1 turn and deals 35 damage to one enemy.

skills.name: Eavesdrop
skills.description: For 1 turn, the first harmful skill used on Hayate will be countered. This skill is invisible the first turn. If successful, 'Dance of the Crescent Moon' will permanently deal 10 additional damage when this skill is used. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Determined Retreat
skills.description: This skill makes Gekko Hayate invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Guren (S)
description: One of Orochimaru's highest-ranking subordinates, Guren is a sadistic, proud, and ambitious woman, and is utterly devoted to Orochimaru, considered one of his most promising potential vessels. Possessing the Crystal Release kekkei genkai, Guren is able to create crystals for a wide range of combat purposes.

skills.name: Crystal Dragon
skills.description: Guren sends a massive crystal dragon towards one enemy, dealing 35 damage to them and stunning their skills for 1 turn. The following turn, that enemy will receive 10 additional damage from 'Crystal Barrage'. This skill will be replaced by 'Crystal Barrage' permanently.

skills.name: Crystal Prison
skills.description: Guren encases an enemy in a crystal prison. For 1 turn, that enemy will become invulnerable to helpful skills. The following turn, this skill will be replaced 'Crystal Break'.

skills.name: Crystal Clone
skills.description: Guren forms a crystal clone. For 1 turn, the first harmful skill used against her will be countered, and the countered enemy will take 20 piercing damage*. This skill is invisible and ends when triggered.

skills.name: Crystal Formation: Arrow of Light
skills.description: This skill makes Guren (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Crystal Barrage
skills.description: Guren unleashes a barrage of crystal spikes, dealing 25 damage to all enemis. After this skill is used, it will be replaced by 'Crystal Dragon'.

skills.name: Crystal Break
skills.description: Guren crushes the enemy affected by 'Crystal Prison', dealing 30 piercing damage to them.

name: Hachibi Bee (S)
description: Having fully bonded with and gained control of the Eight-Tails, Gyuuki, and thus having become what is known as a perfect jinchuuriki, Killer Bee is able to use its abilities to their fullest extent. Using the Eight-Tails' protective chakra to gradually become much stronger, Bee can run a rampage on the battlefield.

skills.name: Hachibi Chakra Bones
skills.description: Hachibi Bee enables his skills and gains 1 Hachibe Stack. At 1 Hachibi Stack, he gains 5 points of unpierceable damage reduction. At 2 Hachibi Stacks, he gains 30% unpierceable damage reduction. At 3 Hachibi Stacks, he gains 50% unpierceable damage reduction and heals 5 health.

skills.name: Lariat
skills.description: Bee decapitates an enemy, healing 10 health and dealing 30 damage to that enemy. At 2 Hachibi Stacks, this skill will instead deal 40 damage to one enemy and stuns the harmful skills of all other enemies for 1 turn; At 3 Hachibi Stacks, deals 65 piercing damage to one enemy ignoring invulnerability.

skills.name: Hachibi Tailed Beast Bomb
skills.description: Bee fires a concentrated energy bomb, healing 10 health and then dealing 20 damage to all enemies; At 2 Hachibi Stacks, this skill will instead deal 20 affliction damage to all enemies for 2 turns (Action classed); At 3 Hachibi Stacks, this skill will instead deal 40 damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Hachibi Tails Block
skills.description: This skill makes Hachibi Bee (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Haku
description: The sole survivor of the Yuki clan, and the subordinate of Zabuza; Haku, despite being young, holds enough potential strength to surpass almost any ninja. Using his ice based bloodline, and his intelligence, Haku can attack and defend nearly simultaneously.

skills.name: Flying Water Needles of Death
skills.description: Haku flings a number of water based needles, dealing 35 damage to one enemy. While improved by 'Demonic Ice Mirrors', this skill will deal 45 damage to that enemy.

skills.name: Acupuncture
skills.description: Haku hits the acupuncture points of one enemy, stunning their skills for 1 turn. While improved by 'Demonic Ice Mirrors', this skill will stun for 2 turns instead. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Demonic Ice Mirrors
skills.description: Haku creates numerous mirrors, dealing 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, 'Flying Water Needles of Death' and 'Acupuncture' will be improved. During this time, Haku gains 30 points of destructible defense and ignores stun effects.

skills.name: Mirror Transfer
skills.description: This skill makes Haku invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Hanzo of the Salamander (S)
description: The legendary long-time leader of the Hidden Rain Village, Hanzo is a complicated man: unscrupulous and power-hungry, but at his core still seemingly a genuine believer in the ideal of universal peace. Having had a venom sac implanted in him as a child, Hanzo fights using poison and is deadly and ruthless in battle.

skills.name: Dance of the Sickle
skills.description: For 2 turns, Hanzo deals 15 affliction damage to one enemy. During this time, they are linked to Hanzo, and 50% of all non-affliction damage he takes is transferred to the target as affliction damage*.

skills.name: Antidote
skills.description: Hanzo may use the antidote on himself or an ally, healing 15 health and making the target ignore affliction damage for 1 turn. During 'Summoning: Ibuse', this skill will also heal Ibuse for 15 health.

skills.name: Summoning: Ibuse
skills.description: Hanzo summons Ibuse with 30 health. 50% of all non-affliction damage dealt to Hanzo is split with Ibuse. While Ibuse is alive, all enemies will be dealt 5 affliction damage every turn. When this skill ends or Ibuse is killed, Hanzo will activate 'Explosive Tag Wrap' on all enemies.

skills.name: Hanzo Body Flicker Jutsu
skills.description: This skill makes Hanzo of the Salamander (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Explosive Tag Wrap
skills.description: This skill is activated when Ibuse is killed. All enemies will take 15 affliction damage, and 5 additional affliction damage for every 2 turns Ibuse stayed alive.

name: Haruno Sakura
description: A Genin from Team 7, Sakura is very intelligent, but self conscious about herself. Having just recently received training from Tsunade, Sakura is now able to deliver powerful punches and heal her own allies.

skills.name: KO Punch
skills.description: Sakura punches one enemy with all her strength, dealing 20 damage to them and stunning their physical and mental skills for 1 turn. During 'Inner Sakura', this skill will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Cure
skills.description: Using basic healing techniques, Sakura heals herself or an ally for 20 health. During 'Inner Sakura', this skill will heal 10 additional health.

skills.name: Inner Sakura
skills.description: Sakura's inner self surfaces and urges her on. For 4 turns, Sakura will gain 10 points of damage reduction and will ignore non-damage effects. During this time, Sakura's skills will be improved.

skills.name: Sakura Replacement Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Haruno Sakura invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Haruno Sakura (S)
description: With her extensive training under Tsunade, the Godaime, for the last two and a half years, Sakura(s)'s healing and combat abilities have both greatly improved.

skills.name: Chakra Enhanced Punch
skills.description: Enhancing her attack with finely controlled chakra, Sakura destroys the destructible defense of one enemy and deals 25 piercing damage to them. This skill will be replaced by 'Blossom's Fury'.

skills.name: Trained Healing
skills.description: Using her trained healing skills, Sakura heals an ally for 20 health for 2 turns. Each turn, that ally will have all affliction skills removed from them.

skills.name: Self Heal
skills.description: Sakura targets herself permanently, healing 20 health instantly the first time she is damaged by a skill. This skill is invisible and ends when triggered.

skills.name: Insightful Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Haruno Sakura (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Blossom's Fury
skills.description: Sakura releases a ground breaking punch, destroying the destructible defense of all enemies and dealing 35 piercing damage to one enemy and 20 piercing damage to all others. This skill cannot be reflected and returns to 'Chakra Enhanced Punch' once it's used.

name: Hatake Kakashi
description: Kakashi is the sensei of Naruto, Sakura, and Sasuke. With his Sharingan he is able to turn his foes skills back upon themselves and can cause severe damage with his Raikiri and Nin-Dogs skills.

skills.name: Raikiri
skills.description: An attack so strong it is said to cut lightning. This skill deals 35 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Summoning: Ninja Dogs
skills.description: Kakashi summons ninja dogs which bite an enemy. That enemy will have their non-mental skills stunned for 1 turn. For 1 turn, that enemy will be receive 5 additional damage from chakra skills.

skills.name: Kakashi Sharingan
skills.description: Kakashi activates his copying sharingan. For 5 turns, Kakashi will every turn imitate a jutsu from a random enemy, copying a random harmful skill from that enemy, while changing the cost of the copied skill to random chakras.

skills.name: Clever Hiding
skills.description: This skill makes Hatake Kakashi invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Hatake Kakashi (S)
description: Kakashi(s) has used the last couple years to improve upon his sharingan, giving him access to a new deadly but costly ability.

skills.name: Lightning Beast Fang
skills.description: Kakashi forms his raikiri into a lightning dog, dealing 25 piercing damage to one enemy and stunning their skills for 1 turn. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Finishing Raikiri'.

skills.name: Kakashi Kamui
skills.description: If used on an enemy, they will receive 45 piercing damage and for 1 turn the cost of their skills will be increased by 2 random. If used on an ally, all harmful effects on them will be removed and they will become invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Team Tactics
skills.description: For 3 turns, Kakashi and his team will have will have the cooldown of their skills reduced by 1 for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, 'Kakashi Kamui' will be improved and will cost 1 bloodline and 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Bunshin Stand-in
skills.description: This skill makes Hatake Kakashi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Finishing Raikiri
skills.description: Kakashi moves to finish off an enemy, dealing 40 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill will deal an additional 10 damage to that enemy if they are stunned or if 'Lightning Beast Fang' was used on them the previous turn.

name: Hebi Sasuke (S)
description: After breaking ties with Orochimaru, Sasuke forms Hebi and begins his hunt for Itachi. With greater control over the Cursed Seal and his lightning-nature chakra, Sasuke combines sudden Chidori attacks, automatic defenses, and the overwhelming power of Kirin.

skills.name: Chidori Surprise Attack
skills.description: Sasuke catches one enemy off guard with Chidori, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. The following 3 turns, Sasuke's skills will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Cursed Seal: Automatic Protection
skills.description: For 1 turn, the first harmful skill used on Sasuke will be countered. If successful, the countered enemy will take 10 piercing damage and Sasuke will gain 10 points of destructible defense. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Kirin
skills.description: Harnessing natural lightning from the storm clouds above, Sasuke guides a massive thunderbolt onto one enemy, dealing 35 piercing damage to them. If that enemy's health drops to 15 or lower, they will be instantly killed. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Sasuke Kunai Parry
skills.description: This skill makes Hebi Sasuke (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Hidan (S)
description: Hidan(s) is a member of Akatsuki and a worshiper of the obscure god Jashin. He is apparently immortal and has perhaps the foulest mouth of the entire criminal organization.

skills.name: Reaping Scythe
skills.description: Hidan (S) attacks one enemy with his scythe dealing 20 damage to them, ignoring stun for 1 turn and gains 10 permanent destructible defense. 'Curse of Jashin' may be used on the targeted enemy the following turn. This skill cannot be used on an enemy affected by 'Curse of Jashin'.

skills.name: Curse of Jashin
skills.description: Hidan curses an enemy. For 2 turns, all harmful skills used on Hidan will be reflected upon the cursed enemy. During this time, 'Impale' may be used. This skill ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Impale
skills.description: Hidan (S) impales himself with a large metal spike dealing 40 piercing damage to one enemy currently the target of 'Curse of Jashin' and removes 1 bloodline or ninjutsu chakra from them. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Immortality
skills.description: This skill makes Hidan (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Hiruko Sasori (S)
description: Hiruko is a puppet used by the Akatsuki shinobi, Sasori. Serving as a 'puppet armor', it allowed Sasori to hide inside of it. Hiruko is a human puppet made from the corpse of a renowned shinobi - this puppet is also Sasori's favorite.

skills.name: Poisonous Tail Stab
skills.description: Deals 15 affliction damage to one enemy and applies 'Venom Stack'. This skill will cost 1 random chakra for 1 turn after being used. If the target already has a 'Venom Stack', deals 5 additional damage per stack and applies a 'Venom Stack' to all other enemies.

skills.name: Sand Clone Trap
skills.description: For 1 turn, the first harmful skill used on Hiruko Sasori or an ally will be countered. This enemy will takes 10 affliction damage* and gains 1 'Venom Stack'. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Puppet Reveal
skills.description: Sasori activates 'Puppet Reveal'. The next time his health reaches 50 or less, he will gain 20 points of destructible defense for 3 turns. During this time, 'Sand Clone Trap' and 'Puppet Reveal' will be replaced. This skill is invisible and can only be used once.

skills.name: Tail Deflection
skills.description: This skill makes Hiruko Sasori (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Eight Waves of Needles
skills.description: Applies 2 'Needle Marks' to all enemies for 2 turns. When an enemy with 'Needle Marks' receives damage from Hiruko or his allies, removes 1 mark to deal 10 affliction damage.

skills.name: Prosthetic Arm Senbon
skills.description: Consumes all 'Needle Marks' on all enemies: for each mark removed, that enemy takes 15 affliction damage; if at least 5 marks are consumed in total, Sasori becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Poison Stack
skills.description: Venom Stack: The following turn, this enemy receives 5 affliction damage for 2 turns.

name: Hoshigaki Kisame
description: Formerly one of the Seven Swordsmen of the Mist Village, Kisame is an S-Rank missing nin. He is Itachi's partner and a member of a mysterious organization. Designed with Redxmaverick.

skills.name: Samehada Slash
skills.description: Using his sword, Samehada, Kisame slashes one enemy who takes 20 damage and stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Samehada Shred
skills.description: Kisame unwraps Samehada and shreds one enemy. For 2 turns, that enemy takes 20 damage and 1 random chakra is stolen from their pool.

skills.name: Water Shark Projectile
skills.description: Using a stream of compressed water, Kisame deals 20 damage to one enemy and stuns their chakra and affliction skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Samehada Scale Block
skills.description: This skill makes Hoshigaki Kisame invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Hoshigaki Kisame (S)
description: Hoshigake Kisame (S) is the partner of Uchiha Itachi in Akatsuki. He is an expert swordsman and missing nin from the Hidden Mist Village.

skills.name: Hungry Sharks
skills.description: Kisame summons one hungry shark for each enemy alive, dealing 5 affliction damage to all of them permanently. Each turn, the first enemy to use a new harmful skill will be marked, causing all other hungry sharks to attack only the marked enemy next turn. This skill cannot be removed; Ends if Kisame dies.

skills.name: Shark Bomb
skills.description: Kisame blasts an enemy with his shark bomb, dealing 30 damage and removing 1 bloodline or ninjutsu from them. For this turn, that enemy will receive 5 additional damage from 'Hungry Sharks'.

skills.name: Samehada Guard
skills.description: Samehada protects Kisame with his spikes. For 1 turn, the first enemy to use a new non-mental skill on Kisame will be countered. If sucessfully, Kisame deal 15 piercing damage and remove 1 random chakra from that enemy. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Water Isolation
skills.description: This skill makes Hoshigaki Kisame (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Hozuki Suigetsu (S)
description: Hozuki Suigetsu (S) is a native of Kirigakure who was once a captive of Orochimaru. He is a dangerous individual with unique abilities and now follows Uchiha Sasuke.

skills.name: Muscle Expansion
skills.description: Suigetsu attacks with his sword, dealing 20 damage to one enemy and gaining 10 permanent destructible defense and 5 points of destructible defense for 1 turn. Afterwards, the next use of 'Hydro Taijutsu' will deal 5 additional damage; This effect stacks.

skills.name: Hydro Taijutsu
skills.description: Suigetsu launches an extreme taijutsu attack, dealing 40 piercing damage to one enemy and gaining 15 permanent destructible defense and 10 points of destructible defense for 1 turn.

skills.name: Rehydration
skills.description: Suigetsu replenishes his body with water. For 3 turns, he will gain 1 random chakra each turn and grant 10 points of destructible defense to himself.

skills.name: Zanbato Deflection
skills.description: This skill makes Hozuki Suigetsu (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Human Path Pein (S)
description: Human Path Pein (S) is one of the six paths of Pein. This path is a mind reader and gathers intel for the other paths.

skills.name: Mind Invasion
skills.description: Human Path deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their harmful skills for 1 turn. The following turn, this skill becomes 'Soul Steal'.

skills.name: Brain Plunder
skills.description: Human Path steals 10 HP from one enemy, makes them unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable for 1 turn, and reveals their invisible skills for 3 turns. Next turn, if Human uses a new harmful skill, that enemy will have their helpful skills stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sneak Attack
skills.description: Human Path Pein (S) launches a sneak attack dealing 25 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Rinnegan Awareness
skills.description: This skill makes Human Path Pein (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Soul Steal
skills.description: Human Path rips the soul of an enemy affected by 'Mind Invasion', stealing 20 HP from them and dealing 15 affliction damage. If that enemy's health drops to 5 or less health, they will be instantly killed. This skill ignores invulnerability.

name: Hyuuga Hanabi
description: The younger sister of Hinata, Hanabi is a Hyuuga clan member from the main branch family who trains endlessly to prove her worth. While young, Hanabi's skills surpass her elder sister's, and although unable to utilize her byakugan yet and lacking in physical strength, Hanabi makes up for it with her tenacity and speed.

skills.name: Hanabi Gentle Fist
skills.description: Hanabi deals 20 damage to one enemy for 1 turn, and 10 damage the following turn. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new non-chakra skill, they will lose 1 non-genjutsu chakra.

skills.name: Hanabi Kaiten
skills.description: Hanabi spins at one enemy, dealing 20 damage to them for 1 turn, and 10 damage the following turn. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new non-physical skill, their skills will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Unyielding Tenacity
skills.description: Hanabi fights to the bitter end. For 2 turns, Hanabi will be unable to be killed and will ignore all stun effects. During this time, 'Hanabi Gentle Fist' and 'Hanabi Kaiten' will cost 1 random chakra and Hanabi will deal 5 additional damage.

skills.name: Byakugan Insight
skills.description: This skill makes Hyuuga Hanabi invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Hyuuga Hiashi (S)
description: Head of the Hyuuga clan, and father to both Hinata and Hanabi, Hiashi is a strict, but caring man who would do anything for his clan. In battle, there is no equal when it comes to mastering the Hyuuga clan abilitie

skills.name: Master Gentle Fist
skills.description: Hiashi slams one enemy with his fists, dealing 25 damage to them and removing 1 random chakra from them. The following turn, one other random enemy will receive 20 damage and lose 1 taijutsu or ninjutsu chakra. The target of this skill is invisible.

skills.name: Master Revolving Heaven
skills.description: Hiashi spins, becoming invulnerable for 2 turns, dealing 15 damage to one enemy and 10 to all others each turn.

skills.name: Eight Trigrams Vacuum Wall Palm
skills.description: Hiashi gets ready to blast an enemy's attack back. The next turn, the first enemy to use a new harmful skill on one ally or himself will have that skill reflected back to one random enemy.

skills.name: Hiashi Byakugan
skills.description: This skill makes Hyuuga Hiashi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Hyuuga Hinata
description: A Genin from Team 8, Hinata is the next in line in the Hyuuga clan, but she is shy and very withdrawn. Using the trademark Byakugan of the Hyuuga, Hinata is able to delicately target an enemy's Chakra Points while defending the team.

skills.name: Hinata Gentle Fist
skills.description: Using the Hyuuga Clan's style of taijutsu, Hinata deals 15 damage to one enemy. During 'Byakugan', this skill will remove 1 taijutsu or ninjutsu chakra from them. Permanently, that enemy will receive 10 additional damage from Hinata's skills.

skills.name: Eight Trigrams 64 Palms Protection
skills.description: Hinata deals 10 piercing damage to all enemies for 2 turns, and all allies, including her, will gain 10 points of unpierceable damage reduction for 2 turns. During 'Byakugan', this skill will be improved and deal 5 additional damage.

skills.name: Byakugan
skills.description: Hinata activates her Byakugan and gains 5 points of damage reduction for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, 'Byakugan' will reveal any invisible skills used by the enemy team. While active, Hinata's skills will be improved. This skill cannot be countered and it ends if Hinata dies.

skills.name: Hinata Block
skills.description: This skill makes Hyuuga Hinata invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Hyuuga Hinata (S)
description: Hinata(s) has taken the lessons she learned during the chuunin exam, and Naruto's words of support to heart in the last couple years. She has matured greatly as a ninja, the heir to the Hyuuga clan, and as a woman.

skills.name: Gentle Step Twin Lions Fist
skills.description: Hinata creates two chakra lions and attacks an enemy, dealing 30 piercing damage to them and removing 1 taijutsu or ninjutsu chakra from them. The following turn, 'Pressure Point Closure' will stun for 1 turn.

skills.name: Eight Trigrams Thirty Two Palms
skills.description: Hinata uses a lesser form of eight trigram sixty four palms, dealing 30 piercing damage to one enemy and stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn. The following turn, 'Pressure Point Closure' will remove 1 taijutsu or ninjutsu chakra.

skills.name: Pressure Point Closure
skills.description: Hinata closes an enemy's pressure point, dealing 20 damage to them.

skills.name: Byakugan Sight
skills.description: This skill makes Hyuuga Hinata (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Hyuuga Neji
description: A member of team Gai; Neji is the most talented member of the Hyuuga clan in both mind and body. Neji can use the most powerful techniques of his clan, shutting down an enemy's chakra or defending with an absolute defense.

skills.name: Neji Gentle Fist
skills.description: Using the Hyuuga clan's special form of taijutsu, Neji deals 25 damage to one enemy for 2 turns. Each turn, their non-harmful skills will cost 1 additional random chakra. The following turn, 'Eight Trigram Sixty-Four Palms' will cost 1 taijutsu and 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Eight Trigram Heavenly Spin
skills.description: Neji becomes invulnerable for 1 turn while dealing 15 damage to all enemies. The following turn, 'Eight Trigram Sixty-Four Palms' will cost 1 bloodline and 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Eight Trigram Sixty-Four Palms
skills.description: Neji closes all of one enemy's chakra nodes, dealing 40 damage to them and removing 1 random chakra from them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Neji Byakugan
skills.description: This skill makes Hyuuga Neji invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Hyuuga Neji (S)
description: The only one of the original genins to make it to the level of jounin, Neji(s) has greatly increased his ability with both byakugan and gentle fist taijutsu.

skills.name: Eight Trigams Sky Palm
skills.description: Neji deals 20 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses any new skill, they will lose 1 non-taijutsu chakra.

skills.name: Mountain Crusher Palm
skills.description: Neji destroys all destructible defense of one enemy and deals 30 damage to them, and then removes them 1 taijutsu and 1 genjutsu chakra. For 2 turns, 'Eight Trigams Sky Palm' will deal 10 additional damage to that enemy.

skills.name: Reactive Rotation
skills.description: Neji target himself or one ally for 1 turn. The first harmful non-mental skill used on the protected character will be countered, and for 3 turns will take 10 additional damage from Neji's skills. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Neji Insight
skills.description: This skill makes Hyuuga Neji (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Inuzuka Kiba
description: A Genin from Team 8, Kiba is a member of the Inuzuka clan, and is both short-tempered and impulsive. Using his dog, Akamaru, Kiba is capable of powerful taijutsu or fusing with Akamaru to become a deadly double headed dog.

skills.name: Garouga
skills.description: Kiba deals 30 damage to one enemy. During 'Double Headed Wolf', this skill is improved and will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Double Headed Wolf
skills.description: Kiba and Akamaru turn into a giant beast and attack all enemies, dealing 15 damage to them for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, 'Garouga' is improved and will cost 1 less random chakra. During this time, Kiba gains 10 points of unpierceable damage reduction.

skills.name: Dynamic Air Marking
skills.description: Akamaru sprays urine on one enemy who cannot reduce damage or become invulnerable for 3 turns. During this time, 'Double Headed Wolf' and 'Garouga' will deal 10 additional damage to them. This skill may not be used on an enemy already affected by it.

skills.name: Smoke Bomb
skills.description: This skill makes Inuzuka Kiba invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Inuzuka Kiba (S)
description: After two years, Kiba finally becomes a chuunin. Now with Akamaru grown up, they become an unbeatable fighting unit, taking the Inuzuka clan's techniques to the next level. Now both have more precision for massive attacks, and an even sharper sense of smell.

skills.name: Man Beast Clone
skills.description: Kiba grant himself and one ally 5 damage reduction. If Kiba use a new harmful skill, that ally gains 10 destructible defense for 1 turn. If that ally uses a  new harmful skill , Kiba gains 5 additional damage for 1 turn; Doesn't stack. Becomes 'Enhanced Garouga', cannot be removed.

skills.name: Piercing Fang
skills.description: Kiba deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Kiba will ignore stun effects and his other skills will cost 1 random chakra less.

skills.name: Fang Over Fang
skills.description: Kiba deals 20 damage to all enemies this turn. For 2 turns, Kiba will deal 5 more damage on them.

skills.name: Hide in the Shade
skills.description: This skill makes Inuzuka Kiba (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Enhanced Garouga
skills.description: Kiba deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns all other enemies Harmful for 1 turn.

name: Inuzuka Tsume (S)
description: A Konoha jounin, a member of the Inuzuka clan, and the mother of Kiba, Tsume, much like her son, is a wild and impatient woman with an often odd sense of humor. Like other members of her clan, Tsume fights one with her companion, Kuromaru, while allowing her wild instincts to take over.

skills.name: Summon: Kuromaru
skills.description: Tsume calls Kuromaru to aid her. The following 4 turns, she will gain 50% points of damage reduction. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Fierce Bite' and any enemy that uses a new harmful non-affliction skill on Tsume will receive 10 damage.

skills.name: Passing Fang
skills.description: Tsume spins, dealing 15 piercing damage to one enemy for 2 turns. All stun skills that enemy uses will also be decreased by 2 turns. If 'Summon: Kuromaru' is active, this skill will deal 5 additional damage.

skills.name: Flashbang
skills.description: Tsume covers herself and her allies, making them invulnerable to all non-affliction skills for 1 turn. Tsume only carries 3 of these grenades with her at all times, so this skill can only be used three times in a game.

skills.name: Man-Beast Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Inuzuka Tsume (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Fierce Bite
skills.description: Kuromaru jumps at one enemy dealing 25 damage which ignores invulnerability. If that enemy dies this turn, then for 2 turns Tsume will have her damage increased by 10, will ignore all stun effects and cannot be killed.

name: Itachi Body Double (S)
description: By using one of Pein's techniques a Sand Nin spy for Akatsuki is changed to look like Itachi. The body double is controlled by Itachi but only has a third of his chakra.

skills.name: Finger Genjutsu
skills.description: Itachi affects one enemy with Finger Genjutsu for 1 turn. If the affected enemy uses any skill on Itachi Body Double (S) or his allies that skill will be countered and that enemy will take 10 damage and Itachi Body Double (S) will gain 1 genjutsu chakra. The target of this skill is invisible.

skills.name: Genjutsu Reversal
skills.description: For 2 turns, the first harmful skill used on Itachi Body Double (S) each turn will be reflected back onto the enemy who used it. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Goukakyuu no Jutsu
skills.description: Itachi Body Double (S) creates a large fireball that scorches the battlefield, dealing 20 affliction damage to one enemy. The following turn, all enemies will take 10 affliction damage.*

skills.name: Illusionary Raven Bunshin
skills.description: This skill makes Itachi Body Double (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Ittan (S)
description: A chuunin of the Hidden Rock Village, Ittan is a member of the Surprise Attack Division of the Shinobi Alliance. A tough and serious man who is extremely calm during battle, Ittan is proficient with Earth Release jutsu, his specialty being ones which dynamically manipulate the terrain into battle-ready formations.

skills.name: Battlefield Trenches
skills.description: For 2 turns, all enemies will receive 5 additional non-affliction damage and deal 5 less non-affliction damage.

skills.name: Moving Earth Core
skills.description: Ittan deals 30 damage to one enemy and 5 damage to all other enemies. For 1 turn, the main target will deal 10 less non-affliction damage.

skills.name: Earth Dome
skills.description: Ittan targets one ally and himself, making both invulnerable to non-mental skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Trench Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Ittan invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Izumo and Kotetsu (S)
description: Part of the Nijuu Shoutai, Izumo and Kotetsu are almost always found together and work together excellently as a combat team.

skills.name: Mace Crush
skills.description: Kotetsu summons a giant mace and slams it against one enemy, dealing 30 damage to them. This skill will deal 10 more damage if the enemy has been stunned by the 'Starch Syrup Capturing Field'.

skills.name: Starch Syrup Capturing Field
skills.description: Izumo Spits out a field of sticky skyrup making it harder for the enemy team to move around. For 2 turns, any enemy that uses a new non-mental skill will have that specif class of skill stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Devastate
skills.description: Izumo moves to hit an enemy from the left. For the next 3 turns, if 'Annihilate' is used on that target, they will take 65 damage.

skills.name: Tag Team
skills.description: Izumo swap, exchanging his health points for Kotetsu's. If Izumo or Kotetsu is killed during this time, the other will take permanent control. During this period, 'Devastate' will be replaced by 'Annihilate'. This skill can be used again to exchange health points. This skill cannot be ignored or removed.

skills.name: Annihilate
skills.description: Kotetsu moves to hit an enemy from the right. For the next 3 turns, if 'Devastate' is used on that target, they will take 65 damage.

name: Jiraiya
description: Jiraiya is one of the Legendary Sannin. With his various frog-based jutsus he is able to both hinder and damage all of his opponents.

skills.name: Great Fireball Technique
skills.description: Jiraiya spits a giant fireball at all enemies, dealing 20 affliction damage to one enemy and 10 affliction damage to all other enemies.

skills.name: Summoning: Toad Mouth Bind
skills.description: Jiraiya summons the stomach of a giant toad, placing all characters within it. For 2 turns, enemies will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable and during this time if Jiraiya or one of his allies is damaged with a non-affliction skill, they will become invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Major Summoning: Gamabunta
skills.description: Jiraiya summons Gamabunta in the battlefield, dealing 25 affliction damage to all enemies. For the rest of the game, the enemy team will receive an additional 5 damage from affliction skills and this skill will be replaced by 'Toad Oil Flame Bullet'.

skills.name: Spiked Buddha
skills.description: This skill makes Jiraiya invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Toad Oil Flame Bullet
skills.description: Gamabunta spits even more oil at the enemy team, followed by Jiraiya spitting fire at them, dealing 15 affliction damage to all enemies for 2 turns.

name: Jiraiya (S)
description: Jiraiya (S) is one of the legendary Sannin that were trained by the third Hokage. Also known as the toad sage, he has been Uzumaki Naruto's teacher for the past few years.

skills.name: Toad Oil Projectile
skills.description: Jiraiya spits a very dense oil at all enemies, dealing 10 affliction damage to them. Permanently, all enemies will receive 10 additional damage from 'Katon Endan'. Enemies marked by 'Wild Lion Mane' will have their action and control skills ended. This skill is replaced by 'Katon Endan' after being used.

skills.name: Jiraya's Rasengan
skills.description: Jiraya hits an opponent with his Rasengan, dealing 35 damage to them. For 1 turn, that enemy will deal 10 less non-affliction damage. If Used on an enemy marked by 'Wild Lion Mane', that enemy will take 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Wild Lion Mane
skills.description: Jiraiya will protect himself or an ally for 2 turns. If an enemy uses a new skill on that ally, they will take 10 piercing damage and will deal 15 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Summoning Gamaken
skills.description: This skill makes Jiraiya invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Katon Endan
skills.description: Jiraiya emits a jet of fire from his mouth, dealing 20 affliction damage to one enemy. This skill is replaced by 'Toad Oil Projectile' after being used.

name: Jiroubou
description: Jiroubou is the largest member of the Sound four. His fighting style involves powerful physical attacks in combination with manipulation of earth.

skills.name: Nirvana Fist Style
skills.description: Jiroubou deals 35 damage to one enemy. The following turn, 'Earth Seal Mud Cannonball' will deal 5 additional damage.

skills.name: Earth Seal Mud Cannonball
skills.description: Jiroubou deals 15 damage to all enemies. The following turn, 'Nirvana Fist Style' will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Dungeon Chamber of Nothingness
skills.description: Jiroubou captures the enemy team in a prison of earth, stealing 2 random chakra from their pool. Jiroubou and all allies become invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Earth Wall Land Flip
skills.description: This skill makes Jiroubou invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Juugo (S)
description: One of Orochimaru's many test subjects, Juugo is the genetic source of the Cursed Seal. A reclusive man who is normally calm and gentle, Juugo suffers from murderous psychotic episodes, and now follows Sasuke as a member of Team Taka, as after the death of Kimimaro, only he can calm his killer impulses.

skills.name: Compression Blast
skills.description: Juugo absorbs natural energy and expels it in a highly compressed and violent blast, dealing 35 damage to one enemy and stunning their physical and chakra skills. During 'Killer Impulse', this skill will cost 2 random chakra instead.

skills.name: Killer Impulse
skills.description: For 3 turns, Juugo gains 75% damage reduction. During this time, 3 random enemies will receive 25 piercing damage each turn. While active, 'Compression Blast' will cost 2 random chakra instead. The target enemies are invisible. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Fusion
skills.description: Juugo targets one ally, healing 25 health and granting 10 permanent destructible defense to them. Each time Juugo uses this skill, the cooldown of Juugo's skills will be increased by 1.

skills.name: Isolation
skills.description: This skill makes Juugo (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Kakuzu (S)
description: A missing-nin of mysterious talents and a member of Akatsuki, Kakuzu(s) is certainly older than he appears. He seems to only be concerned with money and the bounties which provide him with it.

skills.name: Fuuton Atsugai
skills.description: Fuuton Atsugai deals 30 damage to one enemy and stuns their non-affliction skills for 1 turn. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Katon Zukokku'.

skills.name: Raiton Gian
skills.description: Raiton Gian deals 35 damage to one enemy and for 1 turn that enemy skills will cost 1 additional random chakra. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Inferno Gust'.

skills.name: Heart Steal
skills.description: Using his tendrils, Kakuzu rips the heart out of one enemy and makes it his own. Kakuzu instantly kills that enemy and heals 35 health. This skill can only be used on an enemy at or below 35 health. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Iron Skin Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Kakuzu (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Katon Zukokku
skills.description: Katon Zukokku deals 15 affliction damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Inferno Gust
skills.description: Inferno Gust deal 40 damage to one enemy and 15 to all other enemies.

name: Kankuro
description: The brother of Gaara, and a master puppeeter, Kankuro is one of the three sand siblings. With his puppets, Kankuro is able to use the varied abilities hidden inside them to attack his enemies, or even protect himself.

skills.name: Black Secret Machine One Shot
skills.description: Kankuro uses two of his puppets to stab one enemy, dealing 30 piercing damage to them. During 'Puppet Preparation', this skill will deal an additional 5 damage.

skills.name: Poison Bomb
skills.description: One of Kankuro's puppets creates a cloud of smoke, dealing 10 affliction damage to all enemies. During 'Puppet Preparation', this skill will last 1 additional turn.

skills.name: Puppet Preparation
skills.description: Kankuro prepares his puppets for combat, gaining 10 points of destructible defense permanently. The following 3 turns, Kankuro's skills will be improved.

skills.name: Puppet Replacement Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Kankuro invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Kankuro (S)
description: In the last couple years Kankuro(s) has become a Jounin and has created a new puppet. He is now able to harness three puppets at once and is a more versatile combatant.

skills.name: Kuroari Trap
skills.description: Kankuro traps one enemy for 1 turn. If that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will be countered and receive 15 additional damage from 'Karasu Knives'. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Karasu Knives
skills.description: Kankuro assaults one enemy with poisoned knives, dealing 25 damage to them and that enemy will take 10 affliction damage the following turn*. For 1 turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Karasu: Finishing Knive'.

skills.name: Sanshouo Shield
skills.description: Kankuro uses Sanshouo to block enemy attacks. For 3 turns, Kankuro and his allies gain 5 points of damage reduction and are immune to affliction damage. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Salamander Puppet'. This skill ends if Kankuro dies.

skills.name: Puppet Distraction
skills.description: This skill makes Kankuro (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Karasu: Finishing Knive
skills.description: This skill deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy.

skills.name: Salamander Puppet
skills.description: Kankuro protects himself or an ally for 1 turn, that ally will gain 20 points of unpierceable damage reduction.

name: Karatachi Yagura
description: The Fourth Mizukage of the Hidden Mist Village, Yagura is also the jinchuuriki host of the Three-Tailed Beast, Isobu. A tragic character manipulated by "Uchiha Madara" throughout his infamously bloody reign, Yagura uses the Three-Tails' unique mist and coral-based abilities in battle to efficiently hinder his enemies.

skills.name: Isobu: Tailed Beast Bomb
skills.description: Yagura heals 5 health and deals 20 damage to one enemy. This skill  deals 10 additional damage  for every 15 extra health it heals.

skills.name: Bloodshed
skills.description: Yagura deals 10 piercing damage to all enemies. For 2 turns, if an enemy does not use a new skill, their skills will have 1 additional cooldown for 1 turn, otherwise, 'Isobu: Tailed Beast Bomb' will heal 5 additional health permanently. This skill stacks and cannot be countered.

skills.name: Isobu Transformation
skills.description: For 1 turn, Yagura will ignore stun effects and 'Bloodshed' will cost 1 random chakra. Permanently, everytime Yagura uses a new skill, he will ignore all stun effects for 1 turn. During this time, this skill can be used to make 'Bloodshed'  cost 1 random chakra for 1 turn. This skill cannot be removed.

skills.name: Isobu: Chakra Skin
skills.description: This skill makes Yagura invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Karin (S)
description: Karin is a former subordinate of Orochimaru who oversaw one of his secret laboratories. She is a skilled sensor and master of chakra control who now follows Uchiha Sasuke.

skills.name: Minds Eye of Kagura
skills.description: Karin predicts one enemy. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill they will be countered and their harmful skills will be stunned for 1 turn; If that enemy uses a helpful skill, the cost of their skills will increase by 1 random chakra for 2 turns. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Raging Punch
skills.description: Karin deals 30 damage to one enemy. For 2 turns, that enemy will be unable to use their stun skills (this is a stun effect); Does not stack. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Chakra Transfer
skills.description: Karin allows one ally to bite her, transferring her chakra to them. That ally will be healed for 35 health and Karin will take 5 affliction damage*.

skills.name: Precipitous Retreat
skills.description: This skill makes Karin (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Kazekage Gaara (S)
description: After a few short years and much soul-searching, Gaara(s) has risen to be his village's Kazekage. Rather than destroying others he now protects those he cares about to prove his existence.

skills.name: Desert Missile
skills.description: Using thin ropes of sand Kazekage Gaara hunts down one enemy dealing 10 piercing damage to them. New skills used by the target of this skill will deal 15 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn.

skills.name: Desert Prison
skills.description: Kazekage Gaara entraps and crushes one enemy in a giant maw of sand stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn and dealing 10 piercing damage to them.

skills.name: Sand Summoning
skills.description: Gaara and his allies will gain 5 permanent destructible defense every 3 turns, for the rest of the game. Permanently, 'Desert Missile' will deal 15 additional damage and 'Desert Prison' will deal 20 additional damage. This skill can only be used twice.

skills.name: Sand Sphere
skills.description: This skill makes Kazekage Gaara (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Kidoumaru
description: Kidoumaru has spider-like skills. He has 6 arms and has the ability to create weapons and traps with a strange golden web-like liquid.

skills.name: Golden Arrow
skills.description: Kidoumaru fires a special arrow made of enzymes from his mouth at one enemy dealing 50 piercing damage.

skills.name: Summoning: Kyodaigumo
skills.description: Kidoumaru summons Kyodaigumo, dealing 10 damage to all enemies for 5 turns. The following 5 turns, Kidoumaru will gain 10 permanent destructible defense each turn and any new skill an enemy uses will have its cooldown increased by 1.

skills.name: Spider Web
skills.description: Kidoumaru uses spider web on himself or an ally. For 1 turn, the first enemy to use a new harmful damage skill on that ally will be countered, and will deal 15 less non-affliction damage for 2 turns. If successful, 'Spider Web' current cooldown will be increased by 1.

skills.name: Golden Armor
skills.description: This skill makes Kidoumaru invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Killer Bee (S)
description: Killer Bee (S) is the jinchuriki from Kumogakure. Bee (S) is referred to as the hero of Kumogakure and possess immense physical strength as well as being an expert swordsmen.

skills.name: Kenjutsu
skills.description: Bee creates an offensive defense using his seven swords. For 4 turns, if an enemy uses a new non-mental skill on Bee, they will take 10 piercing damage. During this time, 'Buzz Saw' will deal 20 additional damage, and this skill is replaced by 'Final Kenjutsu'.

skills.name: Buzz Saw
skills.description: Using his seven swords, Bee deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. During 'Kenjutsu', this skill will deal 20 additional damage.

skills.name: Chakra Stream
skills.description: Bee protects himself or an ally. For 1 turn, the first enemy that uses a new skill on the protected ally will be countered and will take 15 piercing damage. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Strong Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Killer Bee (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Final Kenjutsu
skills.description: Bee executes an enemy with a final attack, dealing 35 piercing damage to them. If that enemy's health drops to 5 or less, they will be instantly killed. This skill ignores invulnerability and can only be used on an enemy that took damage from Killer Bee's other skills on the last turn.

name: Kimimaro
description: A member of the Sound Five, Kimimaro was the leader, and the strongest of the team before his illness. Kimimaro's bloodline grants him unstoppable offensive power, however, his illness is slowly killing him, giving him precious little time.

skills.name: Dance of the Camellia
skills.description: Kimimaro uses his superior taijutsu and arm bones as a sword dealing 30 damage to one enemy. This skill cannot be countered or reflected. Afterwards, Kimimaro will receive 5 affliction damage.*

skills.name: Dance of the Clematis
skills.description: Kimimaro attacks one enemy with an extremely hard and sharp bone spear, dealing 45 damage to them and stunning them for 1 turn. This skill cannot be countered or reflected. Afterwards, Kimimaro will receive 10 affliction damage.

skills.name: Dance of the Seedling Fern
skills.description: Kimimaro creates a forest of sharp bones, dealing 35 piercing damage to all enemies and making their physical and chakra skills deal 15 less damage. This skill cannot be countered or reflected. Afterwards, Kimimaro will receive 15 affliction damage for 2 turns.*

skills.name: Bone Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Kimimaro invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Kinuta Dosu
description: Perhaps the strongest of the three sound genin, Kinuta Dosu uses his implanted Melody Arm to amplify sound waves and increase the power of his taijutsu.

skills.name: Resonating Echo Drill
skills.description: Dosu attacks with his drill, dealing 20 damage to one enemy, who will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable for 2 turns. The following 2 turns, that enemy will receive 10 additional damage from 'Sound Manipulation'.

skills.name: Sound Manipulation
skills.description: Dosu manipulates the sound to directly disorient one enemy, dealing 10 damage to them and stunning their skills for 1 turn. The following turn, 'Resonating Echo Drill' will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Melody Arm Tuning
skills.description: Dosu fine-tunes his Melody Arm to produce debilitating sound vibrations. The following 5 turns, 'Resonating Echo Drill' will deal 20 additional damage and 'Sound Manipulation' will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Dosu Hide
skills.description: This skill makes Kinuta Dosu invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Kisame Body Double (S)
description: By using one of Pein's techniques a Sand Nin spy for Akatsuki is changed to look like Kisame. The body double is controlled by Kisame but only has a third of his chakra.

skills.name: Five Man-Eating Sharks
skills.description: Kisame summons five sharks of water, dealing 25 damage to one enemy for 2 turns. During this time, that enemy will deal 10 less non-affliction damage. During 'Explosive Water Shock Wave', this skill will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Water Prison Technique
skills.description: Using a bubble of water, Kisame deals 15 affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their non-mental skills for 1 turn. During this time, that enemy will become invulnerable to helpful skills. During 'Explosive Water Shock Wave', this skill will cost 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Explosive Water Shock Wave
skills.description: Kisame fills the battlefield with water. For 4 turns, Kisame and his allies will lose 1 less chakra from chakra removal or stealing effects used on them and all enemies that use a new skill will have the cooldown of that skill increased by 1 turn.

skills.name: Kisame Water Clone
skills.description: This skill makes Kisame Body Double (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Kitsuchi (S)
description: A jounin of the Hidden Rock Village, Kitsuchi is the father of Kurotsuchi and the Commander of the Second Division of the Allied Shinobi Forces. A calm and disciplined but proud man, Kitsuchi fights aggressively on the front lines, leaving no stone unturned with his various Earth Release techniques.

skills.name: Granite Fist
skills.description: Kitsuchi targets one enemy, dealing 20 damage to them. For 1 turn, the non-damage effects of any new skill this enemy uses will be nullified.

skills.name: Earth Rising Excavation Jutsu
skills.description: Kitsuchi deals 10 damage to all enemies. For 1 turn, Kitsuchi and his allies gain 10 points of unpierceable damage reduction and ignore stun effects.

skills.name: Earth Sandwich Jutsu
skills.description: Kitsuchi crushes one enemy between two massive walls of earth, dealing 40 piercing damage to them. For 2 turns, that enemy's non-mental skills will be stunned. Next turn 'Earth Rising Excavation Jutsu' will cost 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Earth Shelter
skills.description: This skill makes Kitsuchi invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Konan (S)
description: Konan (S) is a member of Akatsuki and a master of origami ninjutsu, earning her the title God's Angel in Amegakure. Able to turn her body into thick sheets of paper, she is capable of multiple forms of attack.

skills.name: Sword of Paper
skills.description: Using a sword made of paper, Konan deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy. If that enemy's health drops to 5 or less, they will be instantly killed. This skill will deal 10 additional damage to a stunned enemy.

skills.name: Origami Blanket
skills.description: Konan covers one enemy in paper, dealing 15 damage to them for 2 turns. Each turn, that enemy will have their harmful skills stunned and become invulnerable to helpful skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dance Of The Shikigami
skills.description: Konan transforms her body into countless sheets of paper and strikes her enemies, dealing 25 damage to one enemy and 25 damage to a different random enemy. Afterwards, Konan becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Onmyoji Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Konan (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Konan of the Rain (S)
description: Konan of the Rain (S) has returned to the Hidden Rain village. Now that Uzumaki Nagato is dead she is aligned with Uzumaki Naruto and his quest for peace.

skills.name: Paper Chakram
skills.description: Konan forms and fires a paper chakram towards an enemy, dealing 35 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, Konan's skills will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Paper Ocean: Chasm Trap
skills.description: Konan traps all enemies in a chasm of the ocean made of a million papers. For 3 turns, all non-affliction damage will be reduced to a maximum of 25. During this time, this skill will be replaced and each time it successfully reduces an enemy's non-affliction damage, Konan will gain 1 random charka.

skills.name: Explosive Papers Barrage
skills.description: Konan rushes toward an enemy and ambushes them with multiple explosive papers, stunning their skills for 3 turns and dealing 15 damage to them each turn.

skills.name: The Bridge to the Peace
skills.description: This skill makes Konan of the Rain (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Paper Ocean: Explosive Papers Detonate
skills.description: Konan detonates all the millions of explosive papers, crushing all enemies trapped by 'Paper Ocean: Chasm Trap', and dealing 20 damage to them and stunning their skills for 2 turns.

name: Kurotsuchi (S)
description: Kurotsuchi (S) is a shinobi of the Hidden Rock Village and the Partner of Akatsuchi. She is also the granddaughter of the third Tsuchikage.

skills.name: Lava Quicklime
skills.description: Kurotsuchi uses Lava Release to create a quicklime to attack one enemy, dealing 25 damage to them. For 1 turn, Kurotsuchi gains 50% unpierceable damage reduction and 'Water Trumpet' will stun non-mental skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Water Trumpet
skills.description: Using Water Release technique, Kurotsuchi deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, 'Lava Quicklime' will deal 5 additional damage.

skills.name: Earth Spears
skills.description: Kurotsuchi uses Earth Spears, dealing 20 damage to all enemies. For 1 turn, all enemies affected by this skill will be invulnerable to friendly skills and will receive 5 additional damage from Kurotsuchi.

skills.name: Evasiveness
skills.description: This skill makes Kurotsuchi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Kyuubi Naruto
description: Drawing upon the strength of the Kyuubi demon sealed inside him, the power of Naruto explodes, and he becomes a virtual army onto himself.

skills.name: Kyuubi Rasengan
skills.description: Kyuubi Naruto deals 40 damage to one enemy and stuns their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. Kyuubi Naruto takes 10 affliction damage*. During 'Kyuubi Rage', this skill will deal 50 damage. During 'Kyuubi Chakra', this skill will deal 30 damage.

skills.name: Kyuubi Rage
skills.description: Using the vile Kyuubi chakra surrounding him, Kyuubi Naruto deals 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, 'Kyuubi Rasengan' will be improved*. This skill will cancel 'Kyuubi Chakra' when used.

skills.name: Kyuubi Chakra
skills.description: Unknowingly using the Kyuubi Chakra, Naruto gains 10 points of damage reduction* and heals 15 health each turn for 3 turns. During this time, 'Kyuubi Rasengan' will be worsened.* This skill will cancel 'Kyuubi Rage' when used.

skills.name: Chakra Howl
skills.description: This skill makes Kyuubi Naruto invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Maito Gai
description: Gai is the sensei of Lee, Tenten and Neji. He and Lee both use the same fighting style, Strong Fist, which involves high-speed attacks and the opening of inner chakra gates.

skills.name: Strong Whirlwind
skills.description: Gai kicks with a strong whirlwind, dealing 35 damage to one enemy. During 'Sixth Gate Opening', this skill is improved and deals 65 piercing damage that ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Sixth Gate Opening
skills.description: Gai opens six chakra gates, taking 40% of his current health as affliction damage * and becoming invulnerable for 2 turns. The following 2 turns, 'Strong Whirlwind' will deal 65 piercing damage that  ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Counter Punch
skills.description: Gai singles out one enemy to counter attack. If that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will be countered and will receive 30 damage. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Gai Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Maito Gai invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Maito Gai (S)
description: Team 9's Professor is back! Gai improved his techniques and strength much more. And now he will use all possible techniques to defeat Akatsuki. Whether releasing Hachimon Tonkou or using extreme taijutsu techniques.

skills.name: Gai Nunchaku Style
skills.description: Gai deals 10 damage to one enemy for 3 turns. Whenever an enemy uses a new physical skill on him, they will take 15 damage. During this time, the target of this skill will receive 10 additional damage from 'Reactive Taijutsu Rampage'.

skills.name: Reactive Taijutsu Rampage
skills.description: Gai deals 25 damage to one enemy. This skill cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Gate Release
skills.description: Gai release one gate per turn, gaining 10% unpierceable damage reduction and increasing by 5 the initial damage of his skills each turn for 6 turns. During this time, he will take 5 affliction damage* and cannot be healed.This skill becomes 'Asakuujaku' permanently.

skills.name: Muscle Block
skills.description: This skill makes Maito Gai (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Asakuujaku
skills.description: Gai deals 15 piercing damage and 10 affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their skills for 1 turn. This skill cannot be countered or reflected.

name: Maki (S)
description: Maki is a kunoichi of the Hidden Sand Village and the student of Pakura. Maki is also a member of the Allied Shinobi Forces' Sealing Squad. Original Pics by: Pain_Alagoano

skills.name: Cloth Binding
skills.description: Maki deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their harmful skills. During 'Cloth Sealing', this skill will deal an additional 20 damage. During 'Weighted Net Scroll', this skill will deal an additional 10 damage.

skills.name: Cloth Sealing
skills.description: Maki uses a giant roll of cloth to seal one enemy, stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Weighted Net Scroll
skills.description: Maki grants herself 50% damage reduction for 1 turn. During this time, if an enemy uses a new harmful skill on her, they will have the damage of their skills reduced by 50% for 1 turn. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Cloth Shelter
skills.description: This skill makes Maki (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Mangekyou Sasuke (S)
description: Mangekyou Sasuke (S), Sasuke after defeating his older brother Itachi has gained the mangekyou sharingan. Sasuke is now a member of the Akatsuki, and also the leader of the newly created Team Taka, whose goal is to destroy the Hidden Leaf.

skills.name: Amaterasu Wave
skills.description: Using his Amaterasu in the battlefield, Sasuke deals 12 affliction damage to all enemies for 2 turns. While active, any enemy that does not use a new skill will make 'Amaterasu Wave' last 1 turn longer on them. This skill cannot be used on enemies already affected by it and it cannot be removed.

skills.name: Enton Amaterasu
skills.description: Sasuke uses his Amaterasu as a shield on himself for 4 turns, granting him 15 points of destructible defense. During this time, any enemy that uses a new non-mental skill on Sasuke will *receive 5 affliction damage permanently. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Dark Genjutsu
skills.description: Mangekyou Sasuke (S) deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy. That enemy's non-mental skills will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hawk Summoning
skills.description: This skill makes Mangekyou Sasuke (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Masked Man
description: Not much is known about the Masked Man, other than his uncontrollable hatred for the Leaf Village. After extracting the Kyuubi from Kushina, Masked Man is able to summon the Nine Tails Beast into the battlefield, while also being able to use his other unknown techniques.

skills.name: Strange Jutsu
skills.description: Masked Man isolates himself and one enemy from the battlefield, *making them both invulnerable to every characters except each other for 3 turns; This effect cannot be ignored. During this time, that enemy will take 15 damage each turn.

skills.name: Chain Assault
skills.description: Producing chains from his wrists, Masked Man deals 20 damage to one enemy, reducing their non-affliction damage by 10 for 1 turn. This skill deals 30 damage if they are affected by 'Strange Jutsu'.

skills.name: Summoning: Kyuubi
skills.description: Masked Man may summon Kyuubi if he has 50 health or less, granting himself 40 permanent points of destructible defense. While he has this destructible defense, this skill will be replaced by 'Summoned Kyuubi: Bijuudama'.

skills.name: Masked Man Block
skills.description: This skill makes Masked Man invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Summoned Kyuubi: Bijuudama
skills.description: Kyuubi gathers a massive sphere of chakra and fires it at all enemies dealing 35 piercing damage to them.

name: Mifune (S)
description: Mifune is a samurai and leader of the Land of Iron, and now in the war he is the commander of the fourth division. His unmatched swordsmanship makes him capable of attacking and counterattacking any enemy regardless of how fast their movements are.

unlock.detail: The General of Land of Iron

skills.name: Samurai Troops
skills.description: By commanding his samurai troops, Mifune deals 5 piercing damage to all enemies and makes them deal 5 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. Also for 1 turn, all of Mifune's team will deal 5 more damage from melee skills. This skill becomes 'Flash' with a bloodline cost.

skills.name: Iaito
skills.description: Reacting to one enemy's move, Mifune deals them 15 piercing damage to them and becoming invulnerable to physical skills for 1 turn. This skill becomes 'Flash' with a taijutsu cost.

skills.name: Raiton Pierce
skills.description: Mifuse uses a fast lightning chakra to stab to one enemy, dealing them 15 piercing damage to them and makes them invulnerable to new helpful skills. This skill becomes 'Flash' with a genjutsu cost.

skills.name: Samurai Guard
skills.description: This skill makes Mifune (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Flash
skills.description: With his more powerful cut, Mifune deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their non-mental skills. This skill costs a specific chakra depending on the skill that is replaced by it.

name: Mitarashi Anko
description: Once a student of Orochimaru and a bearer of the Cursed Seal of Heaven, Anko is now a special Jounin who oversees the second portion of the Chuunin exams.

skills.name: Dual Pin
skills.description: Anko deals 5 affliction damage to one enemy permanently. Until that enemy is killed, they will receive an additional 5 damage from all Anko's other skills. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Dragon Fire'.

skills.name: Twin Snakes
skills.description: Anko delivers a large dose of poison, dealing 15 affliction damage to one random enemy. For 1 turn, Anko becomes invulnerable to physical skills. The following turn, Anko's skills will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Hidden Shadow Snake Hand
skills.description: Anko calls forth snakes from under her jacket which slam into one enemy, dealing 20 damage and *15 affliction damage to them. Afterwards, Anko gains 5 permanent destructible defense.

skills.name: Quick Reflexes
skills.description: This skill makes Mitarashi Anko invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dragon Fire
skills.description: Anko scorches the battlefield with fire, dealing 10 affliction damage to one enemy and 5 affliction damage to all others for 2 turns. During this time, they will also receive an additional 5 affliction damage from all other affliction skills. This skill ends when Anko dies.

name: Mizukage (S)
description: Terumi Mei is the Fifth Mizukage, after the dreadful reign of Yagura Karatachi ended, she became Mizukage and worked tirelessly to reform internal policies and recreate diplomatic relations with other villages

skills.name: Lava Wall
skills.description: Terumi Mei uses a lava wall, dealing 25 affliction damage to one enemy and stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. This skill cannot be countered or reflected. During 'Prison Lava Wall', this skill will deal 35 affliction damage and cost 1 additional random chakra.

skills.name: Prison Lava Wall
skills.description: Terumi Mei creates a prison of lava, dealing 5 affliction damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, each turn a random enemy will become invulnerable to helpful skills. 'Lava Wall' and 'Skilled Mist' will be improved during this skill*.

skills.name: Skilled Mist
skills.description: Terumi Mei uses Skilled Mist to destroy all enemies' destructible defense and deal 15 affliction damage to them for 2 turns. This skill cannot be countered, reflected, or removed. During 'Prison Lava Wall', this skill will deal 5 additional affliction damage.

skills.name: Fast Evade
skills.description: This skill makes Mizukage (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Momochi Zabuza
description: Zabuza is a missing-nin from the Hidden Mist Village. He is a frightening opponent attacking his enemies out of the fog he creates.

skills.name: Silent Homicide Technique
skills.description: Using an advanced assasination technique, Zabuza deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy. During 'Hidden Mist Technique', this skill will be improved and will deal 45 piercing damage to one enemy which ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Great Waterfall Technique
skills.description: Zabuza knocks all enemies down with a giant wave of water, dealing 10 damage to them and stunning their physical and affliction skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hidden Mist Technique
skills.description: Zabuza creates a dense fog. For 2 turns, all enemies' physical and mental skills will cost 1 additional random chakra; This effect cannot be ignored. The following 2 turns, Zabuza gains 10 points of damage reduction and 'Silent Homicide Technique' will be improved. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Water Clone Zabuza
skills.description: This skill makes Momochi Zabuza invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Morino Ibiki (S)
description: Morino Ibiki (S) is a jounin and the designer of the chuunin exams. He is the leader of the Konoha interrogation squad.

skills.name: Payback
skills.description: Ibiki deals 5 affliction damage to one enemy permanently. During this time, if that enemy's health drops to 15 or less, they will be instantly killed. While active, Ibiki's other harmful skills will cost 1 less random chakra. This skill ends when Ibiki or the target dies and cannot be used while active.

skills.name: Summoning: Iron Maiden
skills.description: Ibiki summons a giant cat and traps one enemy inside of it, dealing 20 piercing damage to that enemy. For 2 turns, each turn that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will be dealt 20 piercing damage. Ibiki will also gain 20 destructible defense when this skill is used.

skills.name: Summoning: Torture Chamber
skills.description: Ibiki traps one enemy inside his torture chambers, dealing 20 piercing damage to that enemy. For 2 turns, each turn that enemy does not use a new skill, they will be dealt 20 piercing damage. Ibiki will also gain 20 destructible defense when this skill is used.

skills.name: Sliding Evasion
skills.description: This skill makes Morino Ibiki (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Nagato (S)
description: Nagato is the leader of Akatsuki and is also known as Pein. He is in control of the six paths of Pein and was a former student of Jiraiya. Nagato possess the rinnegan and may be the strongest ninja in the shinobi world.

skills.name: Demonic Statue Summoning
skills.description: Nagato (S) targets all enemies and deals 15 damage to them. Nagato will gain 10 permanent destructible defense. The following turn, 'Etheral Dragon' will deal an additional 10 damage to enemies affected by this skill.

skills.name: Etheral Dragon
skills.description: Using Etheral Dragon, Nagato deals 20 damage to one enemy. If that enemy's health drops to 30 or less, they will have their physical and mental skills stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Samsara of Heavenly Life
skills.description: Nagato (S) uses Samsara of Heavenly Life to heal all allies for 40 health. Any dead ally on Nagato's team will be revived back to 30 health and will become invulnerable for 1 turn. Nagato will lose 50% of his current health* for each ally revived by this skill.

skills.name: Bansho Block
skills.description: This skill makes Nagato (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Namikaze Minato
description: Known as Konoha's Yellow Flash, Minato is the leader of Team Minato. His style of combat is unique and he is a highly analytical and caring person.

skills.name: Flying Thunder God
skills.description: Using his teleportation abilities, Minato either attacks one enemy, dealing 20 damage to them or defends an ally making them invulnerable for 1 turn. Minato will also become invulnerable for 1 turn. The following 3 turns, this skill will cost 1 additional random chakra and will deal 15 additional damage.

skills.name: Space-Time Marking
skills.description: Minato marks an enemy, making them unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable for 2 turns. If 'Flying Thunder God' is used, that enemy will receive 10 additional damage and their mark will be extended by 1 turn. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Space-Time Kunai Scatter
skills.description: By scattering hiraishin kunais, Minato applies 'Space-Time Marking' on all enemies. For 2 turns, Minato gains 1 random chakra.This skill is invisible ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Seal Sensing
skills.description: This skill makes Namikaze Minato invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Nara Shikaku (S)
description: The father of Nara Shikamaru, and the head of the Nara clan, Shikaku is a cool-headed Jounin of Konoha who will go to any lengths to protect his friends and family. In battle, Shikaku is merciless, combining his impressive shadow imitation skills with his unparalleled intellect to grab victory for his team.

skills.name: Master Shadow Imitation
skills.description: Shikaku grabs an enemy with his shadow, forcing their body to do as he pleases. That enemy will take 20 damage and have their non-mental skills stunned for 2 turns. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Shadow Dispersion'.

skills.name: Black Spider Lily
skills.description: Shikaku extends his shadows out to his enemies. For 3 turns, Shikaku's skills will deal an additional 10 damage to them, and each time they use a new stun skill, then for 3 turns the next time Shikaku stuns that enemy, they will be stunned for 1 additional turn.

skills.name: Problem Analysis
skills.description: Shikaku targets himself or one ally for 1 turn, and the first new harmful non-affliction damage skill that is used on them will deal no damage and that ally will gain destructible defense equal to the original damage of that skill. This skill is invisible.
