skills.name: Human Barricade
skills.description: This skill makes Nara Shikaku (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shadow Dispersion
skills.description: Nara Shikaku targets all enemies not affected by 'Master Shadow Imitation', stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn and dealing 20 damage to them.

name: Nara Shikamaru
description: A Genin from Team 10, a member of the Nara clan, Shikamaru is considered to be the smartest Genin of all the Konoha 11. Using his bloodline, Shikamaru can manipulate the shadows in the battlefield to disable and attack his enemies.

skills.name: Meditate
skills.description: Shikamaru begins thinking up a strategy against one enemy, marking them for 5 turns. During this time, 'Shadow-Neck Bind' and 'Shadow Imitation' will last 1 additional turn on them. This skill cannot be countered or reflected and may not used on an enemy already affected by it.

skills.name: Shadow-Neck Bind
skills.description: Shikamaru chokes all enemies, making them unable to reduce damage and becoming invulnerable* while dealing 15 damage to them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shadow Imitation
skills.description: Shikamaru captures all enemies in shadows, stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shikamaru Hide
skills.description: This skill makes Nara Shikamaru invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Nara Shikamaru (S)
description: Once known to be one of the laziest ninja, Shikamaru has worked tireless to become not only stronger, but a leader too. More than ever before, Shikamaru excels at coming up with long winded and convoluted plans meant to defeat any enemies in his path.

skills.name: Shadow Sewing
skills.description: Shikamaru sends several tendrils of shadow to one enemy, dealing 35 damage to them and stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn. Afterwards, this skill will be replaced by 'Shadow Sewing - Hold' for 1 turn.

skills.name: Long-Range Tactics
skills.description: Shikamaru goes long. For 4 turns, each time Shikamaru uses a new harmful skill, he will become invulnerable for 1 turn. If Shikamaru receives new non-affliction damage, this skill will be ignored for 1 turn. The following 4 turns, this skill will be replaced by 'Final Explosion'.

skills.name: Expert Analysis
skills.description: By carefully analyzing one enemy, Shikamaru figures out their weakness. For 3 turns, any time that enemy uses a new skill that enemy will be unable to become invulnerable or reduce damage and all helpful counter and reflect effects on them will be ignored for 1 turn. This skill is invisible

skills.name: Panicked Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Nara Shikamaru (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shadow Sewing - Hold
skills.description: Shikamaru continues to maintain his technique, stunning the non-mental skills of the enemy affected by 'Shadow Sewing' or this skill for 1 turn and dealing 20 damage to them. After that, this skill remains active on the enemy.

skills.name: Final Explosion
skills.description: Using his shadow technique, his analysis and his range, Shikamaru traps one enemy in a pit, and blows them up. One enemy affected by 'Shadow Sewing' or 'Shadow Sewing - Hold' and 'Expert Analysis' while Shikamaru is invulnerable through 'Long-Range Tactics' will receive 100 damage.

name: Naraka Path Pein (S)
description: Naraka Path Pein (S) is one of the six paths of Pein. This path is able to interrogate it's enemies at will. Naraka Path Pein (S) can also give life as well as take it.

skills.name: Outer Path
skills.description: Naraka Path summons the Outer Path, dealing 10 affliction damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, 'Judgement' can be used.

skills.name: Judgement
skills.description: Naraka executes an enemy affected by 'Outer Path', stealing 35 health from them. For 1 turn, that enemy will ignore healing effects.

skills.name: Rejuvenation
skills.description: Naraka Path uses Rejuvination on himself or an ally, healing them for 25 health and removing all affliction skills from them. This skill can be used on dead allies. If used on a dead ally, 'Rejuvination' will have its cost increased by 1 genjutsu chakra and heal increased by 15 permanently.

skills.name: Chakra Rod Deflection
skills.description: This skill makes Naraka Path Pein (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Nidaime Hokage
description: Nidaime is the second Hokage and the grand uncle of Tsunade. He is very skilled with water jutsu, requiring no water source to perform them.

skills.name: Water Assault
skills.description: Tobirama encases one enemy in water, making them ignore all helpful effects for 1 turn and dealing 15 damage to them.

skills.name: Water Collision Destruction
skills.description: Summoning a giant wave of water, Tobirama deals 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. Each turn, all enemies will have all their affliction skills stunned. The following 3 turns, 'Water Assault' will deal 15 additional damage.

skills.name: Bringer of Darkness
skills.description: Tobirama plunges the battlefield into total darkness. For 1 turn, Tobirama and his allies will become invulnerable to physical and mental skills.

skills.name: Water Encampment Wall
skills.description: This skill makes Nidaime Hokage invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Nii Yugito (S)
description: A kunoichi from Kumogakure, Nii Yugito holds within her the two-tailed beast. She has full control over the bijuu Nibi, and is able to transform into it and use its powers to fight.

skills.name: Nibi Transformation
skills.description: Yugito gains 5 points of damage reduction and targets all enemies. Every time an enemy uses a new harmful skill, Yugito will deal 5 additional damage for 1 turn. While active, this skill can be used to heal 20 health and grant 50% unpierceable damage reduction for 1 turn. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Claw Swipe
skills.description: Yugito takes a huge swipe of her claw, dealing 15 damage to one enemy for 2 turns. During this time, that enemy's helpful skills will cost 1 additional random chakra. Requires 'Nibi Transformation'.

skills.name: Spectral Fireball
skills.description: Yugito fires a large fireball from her mouth, dealing 30 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy's non-affliction damage will be reduced to a maximum of 25. Requires 'Nibi Transformation'.

skills.name: Rage
skills.description: This skill makes Nii Yugito (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Nohara Rin
description: A chuunin medical nin assigned to Team Minato, Rin is a quiet and passive girl who focuses on keeping her team mates alive. Using her healing abilities, and her intelligence, Rin is able to heal her allies while trapping her enemies.

skills.name: Pit Trap
skills.description: Rin traps one enemy, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new skill, they will take another 20 piercing damage.

skills.name: Healing Touch
skills.description: Rin heals herself or an ally for 25 health and removes all harmful affliction skills from them.

skills.name: Medical Kit
skills.description: Rin gives her medical kit to herself or an ally, granting them 15 points of damage reduction and healing them 15 health for 3 turns.

skills.name: Flee
skills.description: This skill makes Nohara Rin invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Oboro
description: A Rain Genin in the Chuunin exams, Oboro specializes in distracting his opponents with illusions and attacking when unexpected.

skills.name: Underground Ambush
skills.description: Hiding in the ground, Oboro attacks one enemy from behind, dealing 20 damage and stunning their physical and mental skills for 1 turn. During 'Haze Clones', this skill is improved and targets all enemies instead.

skills.name: Exploding Kunai
skills.description: Oboro throws a kunai with an exploding tag on it dealing 15 damage to all enemies. During 'Haze Clones', this skill is improved and deals 20 damage.

skills.name: Haze Clones
skills.description: Oboro creates illusionary duplicates of himself. The following 3 turns, 'Exploding Kunai' and 'Underground Ambush' will be improved. During this time, Oboro gains 30 points of destructible defense and becomes invulnerable to mental skills.

skills.name: Fleet of Foot
skills.description: This skill makes Oboro invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Omoi (S)
description: One of the ninjas in the cloud village, and one of the biggest swordsmen in the village. Omoi is usually concerned, but at the same time, skilled and apprehensive. In addition to good fencing, Omoi is able to execute strikes with the lightning element.

unlock.detail: A Cautious Blade in the Cloud

skills.name: Crescent Moon Beheading
skills.description: By using his sword to strike the enemy and liberate his allies, Omoi deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and makes them unable to become invulnerable for 1 turn. Afterwards, all of Omoi's allies will have all harmful skills removed from them.

skills.name: Lightning Chakra Stab
skills.description: Omoi imbues lightning chakra in his sword to immobilize one enemy just in one stab, dealing them 20 piercing damage and stunning their helpful skills. For 1 turn that enemy is also invulnerable to new helpful skills.

skills.name: Crescent Moon Reverse Beheading
skills.description: Omoi uses his reactive kenjutsu to counterattack one enemy. If that enemy uses a new harmful damaging skill, they will be countered, will take 10 piercing damage and will have their physical skills stunned. The target of this skill is invisible.

skills.name: Guard Position
skills.description: This skill makes Omoi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Orochimaru
description: Orochimaru is one of the Legendary Sannin. He can increase his teams chakra for a price and summon powerful snakes to beat his enemies.

skills.name: Kusanagi
skills.description: Orochimaru pulls the legendary sword Kusanagi and stabs one enemy, dealing 30 damage to them and removing 1 bloodline or genjutsu chakra from that enemy.

skills.name: Cursed Seal Technique
skills.description: Orochimaru places a cursed seal on an ally or an enemy, dealing 15 affliction damage to them and granting them 1 random chakra. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Major Summoning: Manda
skills.description: By summoning Manda in the battlefield, Orochimaru deals 45 damage to one enemy. For the rest of the game, Orochimaru will gain 1 random chakra and this skill will be replaced 'Constrict and Bite'.

skills.name: Earth Clone Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Orochimaru invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Constrict and Bite
skills.description: Manda wraps around an enemy, stunning them for 1 turn. The following turn, Manda will eat them, dealing 30 damage to them.

name: Orochimaru (S)
description: Orochimaru is in the last year of his current body's useful life, so he rushes to take over Sasuke's body. His combat skills remain incredible. He is able to generate and control immense hordes of snakes and also regenerate easily.

skills.name: Extensive Kusanagi
skills.description: Orochimaru first stuns one enemy's non-mental skills for 1 turn, and then steals 10 health from them each turn for 3 turns. This skill cannot stack.

skills.name: Snake Horde
skills.description: Orochimaru deals 20 affliction damage to one enemy and makes their stun effects last 1 less turn for 1 turn. During this time, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, 'Wave of Swords' will be applied to them.

skills.name: Shadow Snake Ultimate
skills.description: Orochimaru targets one enemy, applying both 'Extensive Kusanagi' and 'Snake Horde' to them. After that, 'Triple Rashoumon' will also be applied to Orochimaru. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Fast Skin Replacement
skills.description: This skill makes Orochimaru (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Triple Rashoumon
skills.description: When Orochimaru uses 'Shadow Snake Ultimate', he gains 20 points of destructible defense that lasts for 3 turns and also ignores stun effects until that defense ends. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Wave of Swords
skills.description: The enemy affected by this skill will receive 5 affliction damage for 3 turns. During this time, that enemy will be unable to be healed.

name: Preta Path Pein (S)
description: Preta Path Pein (S) is one of the six paths of Pein. This path is able to nulify jutsus and is used mostly for defensive tactics.

skills.name: Energy Shield
skills.description: Preta Path (S) uses Energy Shield on one enemy removing 1 bloodline or Genjutsu chakra. That enemy will be dealt 25 piercing damage.

skills.name: Rinnegan Absorption
skills.description: Preta Path Pein (S) uses Rinnegan Absorption to protect himself. All damage dealt on Preta Path Pein (S) will be ignored and any enemy that uses a new damaging harmful skill on him will lose chakra equal the chakra cost of the skill used (except Random Chakra). This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Chakra Pin
skills.description: Using Chakra Pin Preta Path Pein (S) stuns one enemy's harmful skills. Preta Path Pein (S) will steal 1 bloodline or genjutsu chakra.

skills.name: Agile Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Preta Path Pein (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Raikage (S)
description: Ay is the fourth Raikage of Hidden Cloud Ninja and supreme leader of the Shinobi Alliance. Son of the Third Raikage, he is also Killer Bee's older brother.

skills.name: Lightning Release
skills.description: Using lightning, Raikage will permanently deal 10 additional damage until he uses a new harmful skill. While active, he gains 10 points of damage reduction. Each time this skill is used, it costs 1 additional random chakra, its bonus damage increases by 10, and grants 5 additional points of damage reduction.

skills.name: Liger Bomb
skills.description: Raikage lifts one enemy in the air and then brutaly smashes their head fist into ground, dealing 30 damage to them and lowering their non-affliction damage by 15 for 1 turn. The following turn, that enemy's skills will be stunned.

skills.name: Lightning Oppression Horizontal
skills.description: Raikage performs a backhanded horizontal chop againts one enemy, destroying all destructible defense and dealing 20 piercing damage.

skills.name: Lightning Speed
skills.description: This skill makes Raikage (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Rock Lee
description: A member of team Gai; Lee is a genin with no talent at all in ninjutsu or genjutsu, so he has focused his life all on taijutsu. With his powerful hand to hand techniques, Lee can crush any defense with his immense power.

skills.name: High Speed Taijutsu
skills.description: Lee deals 10 damage to one enemy for 3 turns. During this time, Lee will deal 10 additional damage with 'Front Lotus' and gain 5 points of damage reduction.* This skill stacks and will deal 10 additional damage during 'Fifth Gate Opening'.

skills.name: Front Lotus
skills.description: Opening the first gate, Lee uses a high-powered taijutsu to deal 35 damage to one enemy. This skill will deal 10 additional damage for each 'High Speed Taijutsu'. During 'Fifth Gate Opening', this skill will deal 15 additional damage.

skills.name: Fifth Gate Opening
skills.description: Lee removes all harmful effects from himself, and for 2 turns, he will be invulnerable to all harmful skills. The following 2 turns, this skill will be replaced by 'Final Lotus' and when Lee uses a new skill, he will receive 10 damage.* Lee cannot die from this skill.

skills.name: Lee Block
skills.description: This skill makes Rock Leeinvulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Final Lotus
skills.description: Lee uses his strongest ability, expending all his chakra and dealing 80 damage to one enemy'. Afterwards, 'Fifth Gate Opening' will end.

name: Rock Lee (S)
description: A member of team Gai; Lee is a genin with no talent at all in ninjutsu or genjutsu, so he has focused his life all on taijutsu. With his powerful hand to hand techniques, Lee can crush any defense with his immense power.

skills.name: Leaf Great Whirlwind
skills.description: Lee gains momentum, dealing 25 piercing damage to one enemy. Afterwards, Lee will take 5 affliction damage*, which cannot kill him. Requires 'Power of Youth'.

skills.name: Maximum Force Blast
skills.description: Mixing the power of his gates, his allies, and everything he fights for, Lee deals 35 piercing damage to one enemy. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Fifth Gate: Final Punch'. Requires 'Power of Youth'.

skills.name: Power of Youth
skills.description: Lee pushes himself to fight harder. If a skill that deals damage is used on him, Lee's skills will deal 5 additional damage. While active, this skill be replaced by 'Fiery Spirit'.

skills.name: Jumping Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Rock Lee (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Fifth Gate: Final Punch
skills.description: Lee opens the Fifth Gate of Closing, dealing 50 piercing damage to one enemy. Afterwards, Lee will take 5 affliction damage*. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Fiery Spirit
skills.description: Lee hypes himself up, gaining 1 taijutsu chakra and healing 10 health and an additional 10 health for each 25 health Lee has lost.

name: Sai (S)
description: A current member of the elite ANBU Root, Sai(s) is an unparalleled artist who uses chakra to bring his images to life.

skills.name: Great Beast Painting: Lions
skills.description: Sai creates a number of ink lions to attack one enemy dealing 30 damage to them, and for 1 turn, Sai will gain 15 points of destructible defense.

skills.name: Great Beast Painting: Snake
skills.description: Sai creates a snake made of ink to trap one enemy. stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. During this time, that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Adaptive Painting
skills.description: For 3 turns, any ally that is stunned will become invulnerable for 1 turn; Any ally that has chakra removed/stolen will gain 1 random ; For each enemy non-affliction skill that damages Sai or his allies will increase Sai's damage by 10 for 1 turn. The following 3 turns, 'Great Beast Painting: Snake' will be replaced.

skills.name: Ink Clone
skills.description: This skill makes Sai (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Great Beast Painting: Bird
skills.description: Sai creates a giant ink bird that crashes into one enemy, dealing 25 damage to them and stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn.

name: Sakon
description: Sakon usually carries a strange head around on his back. This head turns out to be his brother Ukon, who can also exit Sakon and enter other bodies in order to destroy them.

skills.name: Gattling Punch
skills.description: Using one body, Sakon and Ukon rapidly punch one enemy, dealing 40 damage to them.

skills.name: Parasite Demon Technique
skills.description: Sakon deals 15 affliction damage to one enemy permanently. During this time, Sakon gains 15 points of damage reduction and heals 5 health each turn. This skill cannot be used on the same target. This skill will end if used on a different enemy or if the affected enemy dies.

skills.name: Rest
skills.description: Ukon rests within the body of Sakon, healing him for 30 health. This skill will end 'Parasite Demon Technique' if it's currently active.

skills.name: Summoning: Rashoumon
skills.description: This skill makes Sakon  invulnerable  for 1 turn.

name: Samehada Fusion Kisame (S)
description: After merging with the sentient blade Samehada, Kisame transforms into a monstrous shark-like being. In this form, he reigns supreme underwater, draining chakra upon contact and relentlessly hunting his prey within a vast, moving prison of water.

skills.name: Water Prison Shark Dance
skills.description: For 3 turns, all enemies and all allies will have the cost of their harmful skills increased by 1 random chakra, while Kisame's harmful skills will cost 1 less random chakra. During this time, any target that uses a new harmful skill will ignore 'Water Prison Shark Dance' for 1 turn. This skill ends when Kisame dies.

skills.name: Non-Stop Hunting
skills.description: Kisame relentlessly hunts an enemy from underwater. For 2 turns, Kisame will deal 20 piercing damage to that enemy and remove 1 random chakra from them each turn.

skills.name: Great Water Shark Missile
skills.description: Kisame launches a massive shark-shaped water missile, dealing 25 damage to all enemies and removing 1 random chakra from a random enemy. Afterwards, Kisame gains 15 points of destructible defense. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Shark Skin
skills.description: This skill makes Samehada Fusion Kisame (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Sandaime Hokage
description: Sandaime Hokage, known as the God of Shinobi, was the strongest Kage to ever live. He is able to concentrate on one opponent while his summon, Enma, confronts others. When all else fails he can summon the death god.

skills.name: Fire Dragon Flame Missile
skills.description: Sandaime Hokage deals 30 affliction damage to one enemy. This enemy also takes 10 affliction damage the following turn.

skills.name: Dead Demon Consuming Seal
skills.description: The death god sucks the life out of one enemy who takes 40 affliction damage, is stunned and cannot reduce damage or become invulnerable every turn.* Sandaime himself takes 20 affliction damage and is stunned every turn. This skill cannot be removed or ignored and ends when Sandaime dies.

skills.name: Summoning: Enma
skills.description: By summoning Enma, Sandaime and all allies will gain 15 points of damage reduction and they cannot be killed for 2 turns. If targetable, Sandaime will also deal 15 damage to all enemies for 2 turns.

skills.name: Earth Release Wall
skills.description: This skill makes Sandaime Hokage invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Sarutobi Asuma
description: Sarutobi Asuma is the leader of Team 10. He uses trench knives extended by his chakra to fight and protect his teammates.

skills.name: Flying Swallow
skills.description: Using blades with wind chakra, Asuma and his allies gain 10 points of damage reduction and all enemies take 10 damage for 3 turns. *While active, each turn this skill will increase its damage and points of damage redution by 5.

skills.name: Finishing Blow
skills.description: Asuma deals 35 damage to one enemy. During the second turn of 'Flying Swallow', this skill will fully stun for 1 turn. During the third turn of 'Flying Swallow', this skill will deal 5 additional damage and will remove 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Self Sacrifice
skills.description: Sarutobi Asuma protects one ally from harm. For 1 turn, that ally will become invulnerable to harmful skills.

skills.name: Wind Chakra Blades Block
skills.description: This skill makes Sarutobi Asuma invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Sarutobi Asuma (S)
description: Somehow continuing to avoid lung cancer, Asuma has remained the leader of Team 10 through the years. With the secret techniques of the fire temple, Asuma is able to attack and defend while waiting for the opportune moment to slice some heads off.

skills.name: Thousand-Armed Murder
skills.description: Asuma gains 50 destructible defense and instantly deals 25 damage to one enemy. During this time, he can use this skill again for 1 random chakra to deal 25 damage to one enemy. When this skill ends, Asuma will be unable to use this skill for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ash Pile Burning
skills.description: Asuma exhales a cloud of combustible ash on all enemies, increasing the cooldown of their skills by 1 turn. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Ash Pile Burning - Ignite'.

skills.name: Decapitate
skills.description: Showing no mercy, Asuma targets one enemy, and if that enemy's health is 25 or less, he will instantly kill that enemy. This skill ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Asuma Evasion
skills.description: This skill makes Sarutobi Asuma (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ash Pile Burning - Ignite
skills.description: Asuma lights up the ash on the battlefield, dealing 10 affliction damage to all enemies for each stack of 'Ash Pile Cloud' on them. This skill will end 'Ash Pile Cloud' and it cannot be countered or reflected and ignores invulnerability.

name: Sarutobi Konohamaru (S)
description: Determined to follow in Naruto's footsteps, Konohamaru refuses to back down even against overwhelming opponents. Combining his shadow clones, clever distractions, and the powerful Rasengan, he fights to prove himself as a proud shinobi of the Hidden Leaf Village.

skills.name: Unexpected Rasengan
skills.description: Seizing an opening in his opponent's defenses, Konohamaru strikes with a powerful Rasengan. Konohamaru targets one enemy for 1 turn. The following turn, that enemy will take 25 damage and an additional 15 damage if they used a new skill that turn. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Ash Pile Diversion
skills.description: Konohamaru obscures his opponents' vision, blinding all enemies' harmful skills for 2 turns (a blinded harmful skill will target a random enemy instead of a specific enemy). If 'Unexpected Rasengan' is used on an enemy affected by this skill, 'Unexpected Rasengan' will instantly deal 40 damage to that enemy instead.

skills.name: Shuriken Shadow Clone Barrage
skills.description: Konohamaru launches a coordinated assault at his opponents, dealing 15 damage to all enemies for 2 turns. Also for 2 turns*, any enemy that gets affected by a new helpful skill from a member of their team will take 15 damage.

skills.name: Backflip Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Konohamaru invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Sasori of the Red Sand (S)
description: Sasori is a senior Akatsuki member and a legendary puppet master. He is even rumored to have defeated an entire nation with puppets alone. ORIGINAL DESIGN: Pavera

skills.name: Thousand Hands
skills.description: Using this skill, Sasori deals 10 damage to an enemy for 2 turns and gains 5 points of destructible defense each turn. If 'Poison Gas' is used on the target in the following turn, it will last 1 additional turn on them.

skills.name: Poison Gas
skills.description: Sasori deals 5 affliction damage to all enemies for 5 turns. During this time, Sasori gains 5 points of destructible defense and any enemy that uses a new harmful skill will be dealt 5 affliction damage. This skill lasts 1 additional turn on an enemy affected by 'Thousand Hands'. This skill cannot be countered and ends when Sasori is killed.

skills.name: Iron Sand
skills.description: Sasori summons the Third Kazekage's puppet for 3 turns. Each turn, Sasori gains 10 permanent destructible defense and any enemy that uses a new harmful skill on Sasori will take 5 piercing damage. During this time, this skill becomes 'Satetsu Kaiho' and 'Thousand Hands' becomes 'Satetsu Kesshu'.

skills.name: Puppet Protection
skills.description: This skill makes Sasori invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Satetsu Kaiho
skills.description: Sasori gathers a great volume of iron sand. This skill deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy. For 2 turns, that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable. Afterwards, Sasori gains 15 points of destructible defense for 1 turn.

skills.name: Satetsu Kesshu
skills.description: Sasori creates a giant sphere of branching spikes. This skill deals 25 piercing damage to all enemies. If an enemy's health drops to 10 or lower, they will be killed. This skill cannot be countered or reflected.

name: Senju Hashirama
description: A member of the Senju clan, and one of the greatest warriors during the Warring States Period who went on to create Konoha. Even before becoming the Hokage, Hashirama proved his power and ability with his unmatched Wood Release jutsus.

skills.name: Wood Release: Wood Dragon
skills.description: For 2 turns, Hashirama will become invulnerable to all chakra skills* and for 2 turns, Hashirama will steal 1 random chakra from one enemy. The following 2 turns, this skill can be used again for 1 random chakra to steal all helpful skills from one enemy.

skills.name: Wood Release: Wood Human
skills.description: For 2 turns, Hashirama will become invulnerable to all physical skills* and for 2 turns, Hashirama will deal 20 damage to one enemy. The following 2 turns, this skill can be used again for 1 random chakra to deal 20 damage to one enemy.

skills.name: Wood Release: True Thousand Hands
skills.description: Hashirama summons a giant buddha that grants 35 destructible defense to Hashirama and his allies and for 3 turns, if used, 'Wood Release: Wood Dragon!' and 'Wood Release: Wood Human!' will initially last 1 additional turn and cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Sage Knowledge
skills.description: This skill makes Senju Hashirama invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Sennin Jiraiya (S)
description: Sennin Jiraiya (S) uses sage chakra to improve his speed, strength, and skills. The only downfall is that it alters his appearance similar to that of a toad and makes him unappealing to women, which makes it a last resort for the pervy sage.

skills.name: Bath of Burning Oil
skills.description: Using a mixture of wind, oil, and fire, Jiraiya deals 20 piercing damage and 15 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, counter skills used by that enemy will last 1 turn less. The following turn, 'Chou Oodama Rasengan' will cost 1 ninjutsu and 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Kebari Senbon
skills.description: Jiraiya turns his hair into needles, dealing 15 piercing damage to all enemies. For 1 turn, Jiraiya becomes invulnerable to harmful non-mental damage skills. The following turn, 'Chou Oodama Rasengan' will cost 1 taijutsu and 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Chou Oodama Rasengan
skills.description: Creating a massive rasengan, Jiraiya makes one enemy unable to reduce damage or become ivnulnerable, then deals 45 damage to them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Arm Block
skills.description: This skill makes Sennin Jiraiya (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Sennin Kabuto (S)
description: Having surpassed Orochimaru and perfected Sage Transformation through relentless experimentation, Kabuto Yakushi has become a living nexus of stolen power. His body endlessly adapts, assimilating DNA, techniques, and chakra with surgical precision.

skills.name: DNA Assimilation
skills.description: For the rest of the game, this skill will be replaced every turn by a random skill from any of Orochimaru's Finest Shinobi (Jiroubou, Sakon, Tayuya, Kidoumaru, Kimimaro). This skill cannot be removed or ignored.

skills.name: Inorganic Reanimation
skills.description: Kabuto targets all enemies, dealing 15 piercing damage to them, cancelling their delayed skills, and increasing the cost of their skills by 1 random chakra for 1 turn. If this successfully cancels a delayed skill, the enemy who used it will have their non-mental skills stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sage Art: White Rage
skills.description: For 1 turn, all enemies will have their cooldowns increased by 1 and be paralyzed. During this time, if they use a new harmful skill, it will be delayed for 1 turn. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Sage Art: Mystical Palm'.

skills.name: Cursed Seal Life-Giving
skills.description: Kabuto equalizes the health of himself and one ally. Afterwards, that ally heals 15 health has their active cooldowns reduced by 2. For 3 turns, this skill will be replaced by 'White Snake Bite'.

skills.name: Sage Art: Mystical Palm
skills.description: This skill deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and cancels any delayed skill of theirs. If this successfully cancels a delayed skill, the enemy who used it will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: White Snake Bite
skills.description:
Kabuto equalizes the health of himself and one enemy, then steals 25 health from them.
➤ Health Equalized: Add the health of both characters together, then divide by 2 and set their health to the result.

name: Sennin Naruto (S)
description: Sennin Naruto (S) has trained on Mount Myoboku with Fukasaku and Shima. Naruto has become one of the most powerful individuals in the ninja world.

skills.name: Frog Kata Kick
skills.description: Sennin Naruto (S) uses Frog Kata Kick on 1 enemy. That enemy will take 25 damage and have their physical and chakra skills stunned for 1 turn. The following turn this skill becomes 'Rasenshuriken'.

skills.name: Sage Revitalization
skills.description: Using Sage Revitalization Sennin Naruto (S) replenishes his sage chakra. Sennin Naruto (S) removes all harmful skills from him and heals for 25 health.

skills.name: Natural Energy Assault
skills.description: Sennin Naruto (S) uses 'Natural Energy Assault' on all enemies. For 1 turn all enemies will be unable to use stun skills or removing/stealing chakra skills. This is a stun effect. This skill becomes 'Rasengan Barrage' for 2 turns.

skills.name: Kunai Deflection
skills.description: This skill makes Sennin Naruto (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Rasenshuriken
skills.description: Sennin Naruto (S) uses his final attack on 1 enemy. Sennin Naruto (S) destroys their destructible defense and deals 50 piercing damage to that enemy. This skill ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Rasengan Barrage
skills.description: Sennin Naruto (S) uses 'Rasengan Barrage'. The following turn one enemy will be dealt 30 damage. During this time, the first enemy to use a new skill on Sennin Naruto will be countered. This is skill is invisible. Becomes 'Natural Energy Assault' when used.

name: Shee (S)
description: Shee (S) is a jounin of the Hidden Cloud Village and a sensor. Shee is one of the Raikage's most reliable shinobi.

skills.name: Sensor Awareness
skills.description: Shee uses his sensor, dealing 25 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, if a new harmful skill is used on Shee, he will become invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ally Heal
skills.description: Using Ally Heal, Shee heals himself or an ally for 25 health.

skills.name: Lightning Illusion Flash
skills.description: Shee blinds one enemy with a lightning-based illusion, dealing 35 damage to them and making them invulnerable to helpful skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Defensive Reaction
skills.description: This skill makes Shee (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shigure
description: A Genin from the Village of Rain, Shigure specializes in using his chakra to control needles hidden in his umbrellas.

skills.name: Umbrella Toss
skills.description: Shigure tosses his umbrellas into the air, gaining 5 points of damage reduction for 3 turns. During this time, any enemy that uses a new skill on Shigure or his allies will be dealt 5 piercing damage; Triggers once per enemy a turn. The following 3 turns, 'Sprinkling Needles' may be used. This skill ends when Shigure dies.

skills.name: Sprinkling Needles
skills.description: Needles rain down from Shigure's umbrellas, dealing 10 piercing damage to all enemies for 3 turns. The following 2 turns, 'Needle Barrage' may be used on enemies affected by this skill. This skill cannot be countered and it requires 'Umbrella Toss' to be used.

skills.name: Needle Barrage
skills.description: Shigure specifically directs needles at one enemy, dealing 30 damage to them. This skill can only target enemies that are affected by 'Sprinkling Needles'.

skills.name: Umbrella Block
skills.description: This skill makes Shigure invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shimura Danzo (S)
description: Shimura Danzo (S) is the leader of the hidden root organization in Konoha and one of the village elders. Danzo operates in the shadows dedicated to Konoha no matter the cost.

skills.name: Izanagi
skills.description: Danzo consumes 2 "Izanagi's Sharingan" to activate Izanagi, ignoring all damage dealt to him permanently. If Danzo is affected by 2 new harmful skills, this skill will end and Danzo will be unable to use it for 1 turn. While 'Izanagi' is activated, this skill will be replaced by 'Stolen Kotoamatsukami'.

skills.name: Self-Cursing Seal
skills.description: Danzo places a seal mark on an enemy's body, dealing 10 affliction damage to them for 5 turns. If this skill is removed, that enemy will have their harmful skills stunned for 1 turn. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Summoning: Baku
skills.description: Danzo summons Baku in the battlefield, dealing 25 piercing damage to one enemy. For 2 turns, that enemy's non-affliction skills will deal 50% less damage.

skills.name: Tree Birth Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Shimura Danzo (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Izanagi's Sharingan
skills.description: Danzo starts the game with 10 Sharingans. Each time Danzo uses 'Izanagi', he will consume 2 Sharingan to ignore all damage dealt to him until 2 new harmful skill are used on him. If Danzo runs out of Sharingans, 'Izanagi' will be replaced by 'Reverse Four Symbols Seal' permanently.

skills.name: Stolen Kotoamatsukami
skills.description: The next time one enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will be countered. The following 2 turns, that enemy will have their harmful skills stunned and this skill will be replaced by the countered skill and will have no cost. This skill cannot be countered, reflected and is invisible.

skills.name: Reverse Four Symbols Seal
skills.description: Danzo releases 4 symbol from his blood and forms a large black sphere around him, sealing all enemies and dealing 20 affliction damage to them. Afterwards, Danzo takes 10 affliction damage.

name: Shinobi Alliance Bee (S)
description: After his encounter with Kisame, in which the sentient weapon took a liking to his chakra, Killer Bee became the owner of the legendary Shark-Skin Blade, Samehada. With it at his side, Bee can use his arsenal of swords more efficiently, combining them with Samehada's ability to absorb chakra.

skills.name: Sting Pierce
skills.description: Bee deals 15 piercing damage to one enemy, marking them for 3 turns. For 1 turn, Bee will nullify the first harmful physical or chakra skill used on him. This skill cannot be used on an already marked enemy.

skills.name: Samehada Monstruous Drain
skills.description: Bee targets all enemies marked by 'Sting Pierce', stealing 15 health and 1 bloodline or ninjutsu chakra.

skills.name: Hachibi Chakra Cloak
skills.description: Bee releases his jinchuuriki chakra, gaining 20 points of destructible defense. During this time, he will heal 10 health each turn. When destroyed, this skill will end and, for 1 turn, Bee's entire team will deal 5 additional non-affliction damage. While active, this skill will be replaced by 'Fatal Sting'.

skills.name: Bee Block
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Bee (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Fatal Sting
skills.description: Bee deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy and reduces their non-affliction damage to a maximum of 10 for 1 turn. If that enemy is marked by 'Sting Pierce', they will receive 15 additional damage.

name: Shinobi Alliance Chouji (S)
description: After nearly three years, Chouji has developed in both strength and size, mastering the Akimichi clan techniques. No longer does Chouji need the Akimichi pills to tap into his true strength, instead, he merely needs to control his chakra and become a force to reckon with.

unlock.detail: The Kind Heart Warrior At War

skills.name: Butterfly Bullet Bombing
skills.description: Chouji slams his fist into an enemy's face, first ignoring all harmful effects other than chakra cost changes for 1 turn and then dealing 30 damage to one enemy. This skill cannot be countered or reflected and Chouji's skills will cost 2 additional random chakra afterwards.

skills.name: Human Bullet Tank
skills.description: Chouji rolls over one enemy for 2 turns, dealing 15 damage to them. During this time, Chouji will counter all new physical and chakra skills used on him.* This skill will increase the cost of Chouji's skills by 1 random chakra each turn.

skills.name: Butterfly Control
skills.description: Using his new found control, Chouji taps into even more power. This skill will be replaced by 'Super-Punch'. Each turn, the existing cost of Chouji's skills will be decreased by 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Butterfly Block
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Chouji (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Super-Punch
skills.description: Chouji punches an enemy down with a fistful of chakra, removing all Harmfull effects on him and then dealing 30 damage to one enemy, this skill cannot be countered or reflected and chouji skills cost 2 additional random chakras afterwards.

name: Shinobi Alliance Gaara (S)
description: Despite his youth and inexperience, the young Kazekage is made Commander-in-Chief of the Shinobi Alliance at the outbreak of the Fourth Shinobi World War. Fearlessly carrying this great responsibility, Gaara is ready to prove himself to the world, empowered by the loving spirit of his mother hidden within his sand.

skills.name: Sand Binding Prison
skills.description: Gaara deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their non-mental skills for 1 turn. During 'Desert Layered Imperial Funeral Seal', this skill will deal 10 additional damage. During 'Mother's Absolute Defense', this skill's stunning effect will last 1 additional turn.

skills.name: Desert Layered Imperial Funeral Seal
skills.description: Gaara deals 15 piercing damage to all enemies. For 2 turns, any enemy that uses a new harmful skill will be dealt 5 piercing damage. This skill ends if 'Mother's Absolute Defense' is used.

skills.name: Mother's Absolute Defense
skills.description: Gaara grants his team 15 permanent destructible defense. For 2 turns, if Gaara or an ally is targeted by a new harmful skill, they will gain 5 permanent destructible defense. This skill ends if 'Desert Layered Imperial Funeral Seal' is used.

skills.name: Sand Wall
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Gaara (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shinobi Alliance Hinata (S)
description: Hinata will also take part in the war. Together with her allies, she will destroy any enemy that tries to attack using her new technique, Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists, along with her Byakugan.

skills.name: Sixty-Four Palms
skills.description: Hinata delivers a series of attacks to one enemy, dealing 25 piercing damage to them and stunning their chakra skills for 1 turn. While improved, this skill will stun non-mental skills for 1 turn instead.

skills.name: Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists
skills.description: Hinata assaults one enemy with her twin lion fists, dealing 30 piercing and removing 1 taijutsu or ninjutsu chakra from them. The following 2 turns, this skill will be replaced by 'Chakra Lion Attack'. While improved, this skill will deal 35 piercing damage and remove 1 random chakra instead.

skills.name: Byakugan: Enhanced Vision
skills.description: For 4 turns, Hinata's non-damage effects cannot be ignored and her skills will be improved. During this time, Hinata will use her Byakugan to reveal any invisible skill used by the enemy team.

skills.name: Byakugan: Focus
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Hinata (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chakra Lion Attack
skills.description: This skill deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy and removes 1 taijutsu or ninjutsu chakra. While improved, this skill will remove 1 random chakra instead.

name: Shinobi Alliance Ino (S)
description: Not one to be left behind, Ino has trained non-stop to improve her abilities and teamwork. With her improved techniques, Ino can not only control her enemies, but her allies too all while seeing everything on the battlefield.

skills.name: Mind Body Switch Interference
skills.description: Ino interferes one enemy for 1 turn. The following turn, that enemy will receive 15 piercing damage and if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will be countered. If successful, this skill will be replaced by the countered skill, which will cost random chakra. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Enhanced Proxy Surveillance
skills.description: For 4 turns all damage reduction and destructible defense effects all enemies use will be reduced by 15, percentage damage reduction will be reduced by 50% and Ino will know when and where any skill is used. This skill can't be countered, reflected and is invisible.

skills.name: Mind Clone Switch
skills.description: Ino enters the mind of both of her allies, making their bodies fight on regardless of their state. For 3 turns, both of Ino's allies will ignore all harmful effects other than damage and chakra cost changes. This skill is invisible and will end if Ino dies.

skills.name: Ino Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Ino (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shinobi Alliance Kakashi (S)
description: Kakashi, as one of the squad leaders, goes to war alongside all the ninjas. Now, he uses everything at his disposal to win. Besides himself, Kakashi can rely on his allies.

unlock.detail: The Leader of the Third Division

skills.name: Kubikiribouchou: Heavy Attack
skills.description: Using Zabuza's sword, Kakashi destroys one enemy's destructible defense and deals 15 piercing damage to them. Afterwards, Kakashi will also steal 5 health from that enemy. The following turn, 'Lightning-Infused Kunai' will cost 1 ninjutsu and 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Lightning-Infused Kunai
skills.description: Kakashi deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy, ignoring counters and reflects. If this skill successfully kills the target, it will have its cooldown reset, its chakra cost changed to 2 random chakra, and its damage increased by 10 for 1 turn.

skills.name: Lightning Transmission Cable
skills.description: For 3 turns, Kakashi gains 15 points of damage reduction and any enemy that uses a new non-mental skill on him will take 10 piercing damage. During this time, all enemies will be marked and, if they use a new harmful damaging skill, Kakashi's other skills will permanently steal 5 health from them, dealt as a new source of damage. This effect stacks.

skills.name: Earth Release: Earth-Style Wall
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Kakashi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shinobi Alliance Kankuro (S)
description: During the Fourth Shinobi World War, Kankurou is put in charge of the Surprise Attack Division, leading his squad as a guerrilla unit. Heading into the war, Kankurou greatly expanded his arsenal, adding the puppets of Sasori and his parents, and will fight using all his weapons in perfect tandem with each other.

skills.name: Kankuro: Puppet Mastery
skills.description: Kankuro prepares his puppets, gaining 25 unpierceable damager reduction. If Kankuro is targeted by a new harmful non-affliction damaging skill, he will lose 5 points of damage reduction from this skill. If used while active, it will be re-aplied.

skills.name: Puppet Manipulation: Sasori
skills.description: Kankuro targets all enemies, dealing damage to them equal the amount of damage reduction points that 'Kankuro: Puppet Mastery' currently has. If 'Kankuro: Puppet Mastery' has 15 points of damage reduction or less, this skill will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Puppet Manipulation: Father and Mother
skills.description: Kankuro protects himself or an ally, granting them 10 destructible defense for each 5 points of damage reduction that 'Kankuro: Puppet Mastery' currently has. If 'Kankuro: Puppet Mastery' has 15 points of damage reduction or less, this skill will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Kankuro Sealing Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Kankuro (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shinobi Alliance Kiba (S)
description: Now in the war, Kiba is one of the most powerful close-range combatants. Utilizing the vast arsenal of the Inuzuka clan, Kiba can combat even colossal enemies with Akamaru and their tornado fang.

unlock.detail: The Boy and His Dog At War

skills.name: Tornado Fang
skills.description: Kiba deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and makes them deal 10 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. During 'Three Headed Wolf', this skill will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Three Headed Wolf
skills.description: Kiba removes all harmful physical and mental skills from his team and, for 3 turns, targets all enemies. During this time, enemies that use a new harmful skill will take 5 piercing damage and permanently receive 5 additional damage from physical skills. This skill is replaced by 'Tail Rotating Fang'.

skills.name: Man Animal Tatics
skills.description: Kiba and one ally will deal 5 additional damage with non-affliction skills for 2 turns. During this time, every time a new enemy harmful skill is used on them, their skills will cost 1 less random chakra for 1 turn.

skills.name: Kiba Block
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi War Kiba (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Tail Rotating Fang
skills.description: Kiba deals 45 piercing damage to one enemy and becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. Permanently, both Kiba and that enemy will deal 5 less non-affliction damage.

name: Shinobi Alliance Lee (S)
description: Now a chuunin, Lee has trained endlessly with Gai, and not only learned new abilities, but has learned what it truly means to fight. In battle, Lee now fights for his friends and allies, growing stronger as they fall around him.

unlock.detail: The Power of Youth At War

skills.name: Konoha Rising Wind
skills.description: Lee tries to hinder an enemy, dealing 15 damage to them and lowering all their non-affliction damage by 15 for 2 turns. This skill will deal an additional 10 damage, and the damage reduction effect will last 1 additional turn for each ally that is dead.

skills.name: Konoha Great Whirlwind
skills.description: Lee gains momentum, dealing 25 damage to one enemy and gaining 10 points of damage reduction for 1 turn. The following turn this skill will deal an additional 10 damage and grant 10 more damage reduction. This skill will deal an additional 10 damage for every ally that has been killed.

skills.name: One-Man Front Lotus
skills.description: Using a modified version of Front Lotus, Lee dives down on an opponent, dealing 20 damage to them. This skill will deal an additional 20 damage for each ally that is dead, and an additional 20 damage for each 30 health that Lee has lost.

skills.name: Lee Heavy Block
skills.description: This skill makes Rock Lee (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shinobi Alliance Mei (S)
description: As the Fifth Mizukage, Mei Terumi joins the Allied Shinobi Forces during the Fourth Shinobi World War. Combining her mastery of Water Release with her corrosive kekkei genkai, she controls the battlefield while protecting the alliance.

skills.name: Water Dragon Bomb
skills.description: Mei deals 25 damage to one enemy and stuns their skills for 1 turn. Afterwards, all other enemies will have the cost of their harmful skills increased by 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Acid Mud
skills.description: Mei deals 10 affliction damage to all enemies for 1 turn, permanently lowering all their non-affliction damage by 5 until they use a new non-affliction damage skill. This skill's non-damage effects will be re-applied if a new stunning skill is used on an affected enemy. Each stack is removed once. Ends when Mei dies.

skills.name: Silent Mist
skills.description: For 1 turn, if one enemy uses a new skill, they will be stunned for 1 turn in the primary class of that skill. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Mei Flee
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Mei (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shinobi Alliance Naruto (S)
description: Having gained complete control of all of the kyuubi's chakra, Naruto will be sure to rampage over every battlefield he comes across.

skills.name: Rasengan Riot
skills.description: By forming multiple Rasengan over his head, Naruto deals 30 damage to one enemy. A random teammate of that enemy will also be dealt 20 damage. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Planetary Rasengan'.

skills.name: Rasenkyugan
skills.description: Naruto grabs multiple enemies and smashes them into a giant Rasengan, dealing 15 piercing damage to all enemies for 1 turn. This skill will deal an additional 5 damage when it's used. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Mini-Bijuudama'.

skills.name: Summoning: Mayhem
skills.description: Naruto summons Mayhem in the battlefield. For 1 turn, the first harmful skill used on Naruto will be countered. The countered enemy will receive 15 additional damage from 'Shinobi Alliance Naruto (S)'. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Mini-Rasenshuriken'. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Supersonic Speed
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Naruto (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Planetary Rasengan
skills.description: Naruto forms a big Rasengan surrounded by other Rasengans, targeting one enemy and dealing 35 damage to them. If this skill kills that enemy, Naruto will deal 10 additional damage for 2 turns and will be unable to be killed during this time.

skills.name: Mini-Bijuudama
skills.description: By compressing chakra, Naruto creates a miniature of Bijuudama and deals 35 affliction damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy's skills will deal 10 less non-affliction damage and the cost of their skills will be increased by 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Mini-Rasenshuriken
skills.description: Naruto targets one enemy, destroying their destructible defense and dealing 15 piercing damage to them. This skill cannot be countered or reflected.

name: Shinobi Alliance Neji (S)
description: During the Fourth Great Ninja War, Neji fights alongside the Allied Shinobi Forces, using his mastery of the Byakugan and Gentle Fist to protect his comrades. Despite his chakra reserves gradually wearing thin, Neji remains determined to defend those he cares about.

skills.name: Heavenly Palm Rotation
skills.description: By refining his mastery of the Gentle Fist, Neji performs an enhanced rotation, dealing 20 damage to all enemies and becoming invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Airborne Palm Crush
skills.description: Neji unleashes a powerful wave of chakra that strikes an enemy from a distance. The enemy takes 30 damage and has 1 random chakra removed from them.

skills.name: Gentle Fist Art: One Blow Body
skills.description: Neji releases a powerful burst of chakra from every tenketsu in his body, removing every harmful skill from himself. His skills will cost 1 less random chakra for 1 turn.

skills.name: Eight Trigrams: Vanishing Step
skills.description: This skill makes Neji invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive: The Price of Perseverance
skills.description: As the battle drags on, Neji pushes his chakra network beyond its limits. Everytime he uses a new skill, the base cooldowns of all his skills are increased by 1 turn (stacks). Once he uses 6 skills in the game, 'Heavenly Palm Rotation' and 'Airborne Palm Crush' will lose their non-damage effects and 'Eight Trigrams: Vanishing Step' is permanently replaced by 'A Fate of His Own'.

skills.name: A Fate of His Own
skills.description: Neji defies his own destiny and places himself between an ally and deadly attacks. For the rest of the game, every harmful skill used on that ally will be reflected to Neji. This skill can only be used once.

name: Shinobi Alliance Sai (S)
description: Sai became capable of using a wider variety of techniques after improving his skills with his animal paintings. Besides that, Sai carries with him his powerful Sealing Technique.

skills.name: Tiger Vision Staring Bullet
skills.description: By using this sealing technique, Sai stuns one enemy's harmful skills permanently and deals 25 damage to them each turn. If that enemy uses a new skill, this skill will end and Sai gains 1 genjutsu chakra. This skill ends if Sai is killed.

skills.name: Great Beast Painting: Kamikaze Birds
skills.description: Sai makes one enemy receive 5 additional damage from non-affliction skills* and deals them 10 piercing damage to them each turn permanently. If that enemy uses a new skill, they will take 20 piercing damage and then this skill will end. This skil ends if Sai is killed.

skills.name: Great Beast Painting: Ink Warriors
skills.description: Sai grants one ally and himself 20 points of destructible defense. If that ally's destructible defense is destroyed, 'Great Beast Painting: Kamikaze Birds' will have no cost for 1 turn. If Sai destructible defense is destroyed, 'Tiger Vision Staring Bullet' will cost 1 random chakra for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sai Kunai Parry
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Sai (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shinobi Alliance Sakura (S)
description: With her extensive training under Tsunade for the last two and a half years, Sakura has gained a greater understanding of healing and the human body. While Sakura's physical strength and healing prowess have both increased, her greatest ability is a powerful chakra storing seal taught to her by Tsunade.

unlock.detail: The Medic Ninja of the Third Divison

skills.name: Empowered Devasting Punch
skills.description: Amplifying her strength, Sakura deals 20 damage to one enemy and 10 damage to all others. While 'Strength of a Hundred Seal' is active, this skill will deal 35 damage to one enemy, and 15 to all others.

skills.name: Superior Healing
skills.description: With her superior healing skills, Sakura heals half of one ally's missing health, rounded down, and removes all enemy affliction effects from them. While 'Strength of a Hundred Seal' is active, this skill will cost 1 random and have no cooldown.

skills.name: Strength of a Hundred Seal
skills.description: Sakura gains 3 Seals. During this time, each time Sakura uses a skill other than her invulnerability, she will use up 1 Seal. While 'Strength of a Hundred Seal' is active, Sakura can use this skill again for no cost to restore 25 health and remove all harmful effects on her.

skills.name: Summoning: Katsuyu
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Sakura (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shinobi Alliance Shikamaru (S)
description: Shikamaru, now in the war. He remains a good and talented ninja, using his shadows more effectively, in addition to using the help of his allies very well, and forcing his enemies to help him too.

skills.name: Continuous Shadow Sewing
skills.description: Shikamaru deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their non-chakra skills for 1 turn. If that enemy doesn't use any new skill, they will take 15 additional piercing damage. During 'Tatical Range Increase', this skill will deal 15 additional damage.

skills.name: Tatical Range Increase
skills.description: For 1 turn, Shikamaru will ignore all damage dealt and will target all enemies. During this time, the enemies that use a new skill will be able to be target of 'Tatical Shadow Bind' for 1 turn. This skill becomes 'Tatical Shadow Bind' for 1 turn and is invisible.

skills.name: Ally Shadow Control
skills.description: Shikamaru target one ally for 3 turns, making their skills have 1 cooldown decreased, and if Shikamaru uses a new skill that ally will become invulnerable to damage skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hide and Thinking
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Shikamaru (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Tatical Shadow Bind
skills.description: Shikamaru deals 30 damage to all enemies affected by 'Tatical Range Increase', and for 2 turns stuns their physical and chakra skills.

name: Shinobi Alliance Shino (S)
description: Shino evolves, enhancing his intellect and his Aburame clan abilities. Shino remains calm and, at the same time, cold. His parasites can now destroy any layer, enemy, or defense, and he can also use them as a defense at any moment.

skills.name: Insect Assault
skills.description: Shino deals 10 affliction damage to one enemy for 3 turns. During 'Bug Barrier', this skill can be used on Shino, or an ally, to heal 10 health for 3 turns. This skill cannot be used on an enemy already affected by it.

skills.name: Insect Coffin
skills.description: Shino surrounds one enemy with insects, dealing 15 affliction damage to them for 3 turns. During this time, that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable and if Shino or an ally uses a damaging skill, or new action, on that enemy, they will heal 15 health. This skill cannot be used on an enemy already affected by it.

skills.name: Bug Barrier
skills.description: Shino creates a massive barrier of bugs to defend his team. For 1 turn, Shino and his allies will heal 15 health and will gain 15 destructible defense. Afterwards, they will heal 5 health permanently in the following turns. This skill ends if Shino dies, and it will be re-applied if used while active.

skills.name: Hidden Insects
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Shino (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shinobi Alliance Temari (S)
description: At the outset of the Fourth Shinobi World War, Temari is placed in the Fourth Division. Although Gaara is officially in command of the division and Shikamaru is in Gaara's proxy, Temari is the one who leads the division on the battlefield, including personally commanding the division's Wind Release combat unit.

skills.name: Third Moon Unleash
skills.description: Temari unleashes her fan with all three moons revealed. For 4 turns, Temari's skilLs will cost 1 less random chakra. During this time, any enemy that uses a new skill on Temari will receive 5 additional damage from her permanently.

skills.name: Temari Air Slash
skills.description: Temari sweeps her fan to create a slicing current of wind. For 1 turn, Temari becomes invulnerable to non-mental skills, deals 15 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their non-mental skills. The following turn, that enemy will be dealt 15 damage.

skills.name: Summoning: Kamatari
skills.description: Summoning Kamatari, Temari deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy. After used, if the target of this skill is killed, Temari gains 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Fan Heavy Block
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Temari (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shinobi Alliance Tenten (S)
description: During the Fourth Shinobi World War, Tenten joins the Shinobi Alliance and takes possession of the Bashousen, one of the treasured tools of the Sage of the Six Paths. By channeling large amounts of chakra through the fan, she can unleash elemental devastation or adapt its power to protect her allies.

skills.name: Bashousen: Coil of Fire
skills.description: Using the Sage of the Six Paths' legendary leaf fan, Tenten blasts her enemies with a sea of raging fire, dealing 15 damage and 15 affliction damage* to them. The following 3 turns, they will take 5 affliction damage.

skills.name: Bashousen: Coil of Wind
skills.description: Using the Bashousen to throw a gust of wind, the following turn all non-mental skills used on Tenten or her team will be reflected back to the enemy. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Bashousen: Strike
skills.description: If used on an enemy, deals 15 affliction damage. If used on herself, or an ally, grants 15 points of destructible defense. If used after 'Bashousen: Coil of Fire', this will also deal 5 affliction damage permanently. If used after 'Bashousen: Coil of Wind', this will also reflect non-mental skills for 1 turn; Invisible.

skills.name: Reflective Paper Bombs
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Tenten (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shinobi War Tobi (S)
description: During the Fourth Great Ninja War, Tobi conceals his identity behind a white mask, wielding both the Sharingan and Rinnegan. Using the Demonic Statue of the Outer Path, he commands the resurrected jinchuuriki, while his Kamui allows him to evade attacks by rendering his body intangible.

skills.name: Demonic Chakra Chains
skills.description: By releasing the Demonic Statue's chakra chains, Tobi steals 15 health from one enemy. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new skill, 1 bloodline chakra will be stored in 'Demonic Statue of the Outer Path'. The following turn, if Tobi uses 'Demonic Statue of the Outer Path', 'Demonic Chakra Chains' will also be applied to all enemies and Tobi will become invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Demonic Statue of the Outer Path
skills.description: Tobi summons the Demonic Statue, unleashing its destructive power. Tobi gains all chakra stored in this skill, consuming the stored chakra. If targetable, all enemies take 25 damage.

skills.name: Six Paths Connection
skills.description: Tobi grants an ally the Sharingan and Rinnegan, connecting them through their visual powers. The Sharingan permanently increases that ally's non-affliction damage by 5. The Rinnegan connects the ally to Tobi, causing either character to become invulnerable for 1 turn whenever the other uses an invulnerability skill. This skill ends when Tobi dies and can only be used once.

skills.name: Kamui: Intangibility
skills.description: Tobi uses Kamui to phase his body into another dimension, avoiding incoming attacks. Every other turn, Tobi ignores all damage dealt to him for 1 turn. This skill cannot be used while active.

name: Shiore Orochimaru
description: Originally a genin from the Hidden Grass Village attending the Chuunin Exams, Shiore was killed by Orochimaru shortly before the exams began. Orochimaru then took over Shiore's body and used it as a disguise in order to infiltrate the Chuunin Exams and scout out the potential of Uchiha Sasuke as a future vessel.

skills.name: Five Elements Seal
skills.description: Shiore seals one enemy, dealing 10 affliction damage to them for 3 turns. During this time, that enemy will deal 10 less non-affliction damage and their harmful skills will cost 1 additional random chakra.

skills.name: Giant Snake Bind
skills.description: Shiore summons a giant snake and binds one enemy, dealing 20 damage to them for 2 turns. The first turn, that enemy will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Curse Seal
skills.description: Shiore places a curse seal on an enemy, stealing 5 health from them for 3 turns. While active, that enemy will be unable to become invulnerable*. During this time, if that enemy is killed, Shiore gains 1 random chakra*.

skills.name: Snake Body Replacement
skills.description: This skill makes Shiore Orochimaru invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shizune
description: Shizune is the aid of Tsunade. A competent combatant using poisons and needles, she is also a highly skilled medic who is able to heal her allies.

skills.name: Prepared Needle Shot
skills.description: Shizune shoots hidden needles at one enemy dealing 15 damage to them.

skills.name: Poison Mist
skills.description: Shizune breaths a poison cloud on one enemy who takes 10 affliction damage for 3 turns. During this time, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will receive 10 additional damage from non-affliction skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Healing Resuscitation Regeneration
skills.description: Using this advanced healing technique, Shizune heals one ally for 35 health and removes all enemy affliction skills from them.

skills.name: Shizune Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Shizune invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shizune (S)
description: Having spent the past few years as the right-hand woman and de facto secretary to the Fifth Hokage, Shizune has matured and become more experienced. Still a top-class medical-nin, Shizune has also become proficient at sealing jutsu, defensive chakra control, and strategically utilizing her summon Katsuyu.

skills.name: Full Team Recovery
skills.description: Shizune instantly heals herself and her allies for 15 health. During 'Chakra Reinforcement', this skill will heal Shizune and her allies for 20 health.

skills.name: Katsuyu Interception
skills.description: Shizune calls upon Katsuyu to protect herself or an ally. For 1 turn, the first harmful skill used on the protected ally will be countered. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Chakra Reinforcement
skills.description: For 3 turns, Shizune will have 10 points of damage reduction. During this time, 'Full Team Recovery' will be improved. The following 3 turns, this skill will be replaced by 'Four-Corner Sealing Barrier'.

skills.name: Sliding Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Shizune (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Four-Corner Sealing Barrier
skills.description: Shizune seals one enemy inside a four-corner barrier, dealing 25 damage to them. Afterwards, Shizune will become invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shodai Hokage
description: The First Hokage and the founder of the Hidden Village of Konoha, Shodai Hokage has the ability to create and manipulate trees. This ability to give life shows the extent of his power.

skills.name: Tree Strangulation
skills.description: Hashirama catches and crushes one enemy in giant tree branches, dealing 25 piercing damage to that enemy and stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. During 'Birth of the Trees', this skill will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Branch Manipulation
skills.description: Hashirama sends out his trees in all directions, dealing 10 affliction damage to all enemies and granting 5 points of permanent destructible defense to himself and his allies. During 'Birth of the Trees', this skill will have no cooldown.

skills.name: Birth of the Trees
skills.description: Hashirama summons a giant field of trees. For 3 turns, any enemy that uses a new harmful skill will have the cost of their harmful skills increased by 2 random chakra for 1 turn. For 3 turns, Hashirama and his allies are granted 10 points of destructible defense.

skills.name: Deflection
skills.description: This skill makes Shodai Hokage invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Shukaku Gaara
description: Having lived inside him the whole time, Shukaku is one of the nine tailed beasts and is very eager to escape and cause chaos to the world. While Shukaku slowly takes over Gaara, his own power increases, allowing him to demolish his foes with powerful sand attacks.

skills.name: Sand Claw
skills.description: Gaara attacks with a claw of concentrated sand, dealing 35 damage to one enemy and gaining 5 points of destructible defense.

skills.name: Constricting Sand Prison
skills.description: Gaara traps an enemy with sand, dealing 10 damage to them each turn. During this time, the first skill that enemy uses will be countered and this skill will end. If successful, the countered enemy will receive 5 additional damage from non-affliction skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sand Transformation
skills.description: Each turn, for 3 turns, Gaara will gain 15 destructible defense. When this skill ends, Gaara will transform into the Shukaku for 3 turns, reducing the cost of 'Sand Claw' by 1 random and replacing 'Constricting Sand Prison' and 'Sand Transformation'.

skills.name: Thick Sand Coat
skills.description: This skill makes Shukaku Gaara invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Drilling Air Bullet
skills.description: Sending forth a powerful ball of wind, Gaara deals 45 piercing damage to one enemy.

skills.name: True Awakening
skills.description: Gaara truly lets Shukaku awaken from inside him, letting it take over. The Following turn, 'Sand Claw' and 'Drilling Air Bullet' will deal double damage and this skill will have no cost.

name: Susanoo Itachi (S)
description: After using Amaterasu and Tsukuyomi, Itachi awakened his triumph, Susanoo, and became even stronger, both defensively with his Yata Mirror and offensively with his Totsuka Sword capable of sealing an opponent.

unlock.detail: There won't be a next time

skills.name: Susanoo Activation
skills.description: Uchiha Itachi activates Susanoo, and he takes 20 affliction damage*. Each turn he gains 5 permanent stacking destructible defense and his skills become usable for the rest of the game. This skill cannot be used while it's active.

skills.name: Totsuka Sword
skills.description: Itachi uses the legendary blade of Susanoo, dealing 25 piercing damage to one enemy and removing 1 genjutsu or bloodline chakra from them. This skill requires 'Susanoo Activation'.'

skills.name: Yata Mirror
skills.description: Using the legendary shield of Susanoo, Itachi (S) ignores all harmful effects used on him for 1 turn. Any enemy that uses a new skill on him will have the cost of their skills increased by 1 random chakra for 1 turn. This skill is invisible and requires 'Susanoo Activation'.

skills.name: Susanoo Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Susanoo Itachi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Susanoo Sasuke (S)
description: Sasuke takes control of the powerful Susano'o, achieving a high level of strength with an unimaginable impenetrable defense. He can also still use other techniques of his Mangekyo Sharingan.

skills.name: Sasuke Susano'o
skills.description: Using his Susanoo, Sasuke gains 50 points of destructible defense permanent and may use his skills. During this time, this skill is replaced and Sasuke will ignore any effects that destroy destructible defense. When this defense is destroyed, Sasuke will be stunned for 2 turns.

skills.name: Susano'o Arrow
skills.description: Using his Susano'o bow, Sasuke destroys all destructible defense of one enemy and deals 20 piercing damage and an additional 5 damage for each 10 points of destructible defense that 'Sasuke Susano'o' currently has. This skill requires 'Sasuke Susano'o'.

skills.name: Spreading Amaterasu
skills.description: Susanoo Sasuke deals 2 affliction damage to one enemy permanently. This skill will double its damage everytime that enemy uses a new skill. This skill cannot be removed and it requires 'Sasuke Susano'o'. This skill will have its cooldown reset if the enemy target is killed.

skills.name: Mangekyo Insight
skills.description: This skill makes Susanoo Sasuke (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sasuke Mangekyo Sharingan
skills.description: Sasuke activates his Mangekyou Sharingan and gains 25% unpierceable damage reduction until 'Sasuke Susano'o' destructible defense is destroyed. When this skill is used, the cooldown of 'Spreading Amaterasu' is reset.

name: Tayuya
description: Tayuyas only weapon is a flute with which she can cast Genjutsu or control three summoned demons, The Doki.

skills.name: Summoning: Doki
skills.description: Tayuya summons the Doki Demons. The Doki Demons will deal 15 piercing damage to all enemies for 2 turns. The following 2 turns, Tayuya will have 10 points of damage reduction. For 1 turn, 'Doki Ghosts' will be improved.

skills.name: Doki Ghosts
skills.description: The Doki Ghosts deal 15 affliction damage to one enemy. If used one turn after 'Summoning: Doki', this skill will also remove 1 random chakra. If used one turn after 'Demonic Flute Illusion', this skill will also fully stun for 1 turn.

skills.name: Demonic Flute Illusion
skills.description: Playing a genjutsu melody on her flute, Tayuya stuns the physical and chakra skills of all enemies for 1 turn. The following turn, 'Doki Ghosts' will be improved. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Tayuya Insight
skills.description: This skill makes Tayuya invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Temari
description: The elder sister of Gaara and Kankuro, Temari is a somewhat cruel and blunt ninja that fights using the wind at her side. With her fan, Temari can create powerful gusts of wind that she can manipulate at her desire.

skills.name: Cutting Whirlwind
skills.description: Temari creates a razor sharp wind, dealing 20 piercing damage to one enemy and 10 piercing damage to all others enemies. For 1 turn, Temari becomes invulnerable to non-mental skills.

skills.name: Summoning Quick Beheading Dance
skills.description: Temari summons the wind weasel Kamatari in the battlefield, dealing 35 damage to all enemies. If used one turn after 'Cutting Whirlwind', this skill will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Dust Wind
skills.description: Temari kicks up dust, making her team invulnerable for 1 turn. If targatable, all enemies will deal 20 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. If used one turn after 'Cutting Whirlwind', this skill will decrease damage for 2 turns instead.

skills.name: Fan Defence Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Temari invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Temari (S)
description: Temari (S) has grown over the years. She is now a Jounin as well as the sister of Kankuro and Gaara. Temari is also the Hidden Sand Village's ambassador to the Hidden Leaf Village.

skills.name: Fan Increase Moon
skills.description: Temari opens her fan and reveals a moon. Temari gains 5 points of damage reduction and increase her damage by 5 permanently. This skill stacks and can only be used 3 times.

skills.name: Wind Scythe
skills.description: Using Wind Scythe Temari (S) deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy.

skills.name: Immense Cutting Whirlwind
skills.description: Temari creates an immense whirlwind in the battlefield, dealing 20 damage to all enemies and lowering their non-affliction damage by 10 for 1 turn.

skills.name: Fan Barrier
skills.description: This skill makes Temari (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Tenten
description: A member of team Gai, Tenten is a tomboyish weapon specialist who believes a kunoichi can be as strong as a male ninja. In battle, Tenten surrounds the battlefield in weapons, using them for damage and for disabling her

skills.name: Twin Rising Dragons
skills.description: Tenten creates numerous weapons from her scroll, dealing 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns. The following 2 turns, this skill can be used again to deal 20 damage to one enemy and 10 damage to all other enemies. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Twin Rising Dragons Trap
skills.description: Tenten uses multiple projectiles on all enemies, dealing 15 piercing damage to them and an additional 5 damage for every time they were damaged by 'Twin Rising Dragons', removing all stacks afterwards. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Twin Rising Dragons Full Release
skills.description: Tenten becomes invulnerable to non-mental skills for 1 turn and improves her skills for the next 3 times they are used. 'Twin Rising Dragons' will deal 5 additional damage, and 'Twin Rising Dragons Trap' will also stun all physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. This skill does not stack.

skills.name: Spiked Boulder Shield
skills.description: This skill makes Tenten invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Tenten (S)
description: After nearly three years Tenten(s) is now a chuunin. In this time she has improved the diversity and strength of her ranged arsenal.

skills.name: Weapon Upgrade
skills.description: By upgrading her weapons, Tenten gains 10 points of destructible defense for 1 turn. The following turn, 'Kunai Grenade' and 'Heavenly Chain Disaster' will cost 1 less random chakra. This skill will be replaced by 'Explosive Kunais Wave' for 1 turn.

skills.name: Kunai Grenade
skills.description: Tenten throws an explosive filled with kunais at the enemy team, dealing 15 damage to one enemy and 10 damage to all other enemies. Any enemy that falls to 35 health or below will also receive 5 affliction damage*.

skills.name: Heavenly Chain Disaster
skills.description: Tenten rains blindingly fast projectiles upon the battlefield, dealing 30 piercing damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Leaping Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Tenten (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Explosive Kunais Wave
