skills.description: Tenten throws a wave of kunais with explosive tag on the enemy team, dealing 10 affliction damage to them. The following 3 turns, these enemies will be dealt 5 affliction damage each turn.

name: Tobi (S)
description: Tobi is the leader of Akatsuki, as well as an Uchiha. He possesses dimensional skills, being able to suck his targets into his dimension or use the Uchihas' forbidden techniques.

skills.name: Kamui
skills.description: If used on an ally: That ally will become invulnerable for 1 turn. If used on an enemy: deals 20 piercing damage to them and Tobi becomes invulnerable to that enemy for 2 turns. If they are invulnerable, deals 10 additional damage. Ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Kamui Snare
skills.description: Tobi deals 10 piercing damage to an enemy, making them invulnerable to helpful skills and nullifying the non-damage effects of their next harmful skill for 1 turn. During 'Tobi Sharingan', this skill will deal 15 piercing damage and will nullify non-damage effects for 2 turns.

skills.name: Tobi Sharingan
skills.description: For 4 turns, Tobi gains 10 points of unpierceable damage reduction. During this time, 'Kamui' deals 15 additional damage, and removes all harmful effects when used on an ally. This skill will be replaced. When used, 100% of Tobi's current health is stored.

skills.name: Uchiha Perception
skills.description: This skill makes Tobi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hidden Izanagi
skills.description: Tobi uses Hidden Izanagi. After 2 turns Tobi's health will return to the health value stored by 'Tobi Sharingan'. This skill is invisible and can only be used once. This skill will be activated even if Tobi is killed.

name: Touji Mizuki
description: An instructor for Konoha, Mizuki is a chuunin, and old friend of Iruka that over time grew jealous and petty. While Mizuki doesn't have any special abilities, he knows to instead be patient, and wait until the right time to strike.

skills.name: Kunai Assault
skills.description: Mizuki throws a number of kunai at one enemy, dealing 15 piercing damage to them for 2 turns.

skills.name: Execution Shuriken
skills.description: Mizuki throws one of his giant shurikens at one enemy, dealing 20 piercing damage to them, and an additional 10 damage for each 20 health they have lost. Mizuki only carries 2 of these giant shurikens at any time and can only use this skill twice in a game

skills.name: Genjutsu Ambush Tactics
skills.description: The following turn, Mizuki will become invulnerable, 'Execution Shuriken' will deal 30 additional damage and 'Kunai Assault' will deal 30 piercing damage instantly. This skill will end if Mizuki receives new harmful damage. This skill is invisible the first turn.

skills.name: Mizuki Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Touji Mizuki invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: True Art Deidara (S)
description: A fanatical explosive artist who believes true art exists only in a single, beautiful moment of destruction. Deidara specializes in long-term setup and devastating payoffs, planting microscopic bombs that turn the battlefield into a ticking masterpiece.

skills.name: Clay Dolls
skills.description: Deidara gains 15 points of destructible defense. While he has this defense up, each turn he will target a random enemy, dealing 10 damage to them and making them receive 5 additional non-affliction damage from Deidara's other skills.

skills.name: C2: Dragon
skills.description: For 3 turns, Deidara gains 20 points of destructible defense and targets all enemies. Any enemy that uses a new harmful skill will take 10 piercing damage. While active, this skill will be replaced by 'Dragon Missile'.

skills.name: C4: Karura
skills.description: Deidara releases a cloud of microscopic bomb towards on enemy, dealing 3 affliction damage to them permanently. This skill will double its damage each turn.

skills.name: C4: Trap
skills.description: This skill makes True Art Deidara (S) invulnerable for 1 turn. After Deidara uses 5 new skills, 'C4: Trap' will be replaced by 'C0: Final Explosion'.

skills.name: Dragon Missile
skills.description: Deidara deals 25 damage to one enemy. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: C0: Final Explosion
skills.description: Deidara sacrifices himself, dealing 40 piercing damage to all enemies. Afterwards, Deidara is instantly killed. This skill may only be used when Deidara uses 5 new skills.

name: True Form Sasori
description: Pushed to his limit, Sasori reveals the secret of his eternally young body: he has turned himself into a puppet with a living "core" that now makes up the entirety of his being. Using his own body as a weapon, Sasori also pulls out Chikamatsu's legendary Hundred Puppets, rumored to be able to bring down an entire nation.

skills.name: Puppet Flamethrower
skills.description: Sasori deals 10 affliction damage to one enemy. The following turn, that enemy will be dealt 5 affliction damage permanently. If used on an enemy affected by 'Water Stream Shooters', this skill will have a different effect, dealing 20 affliction damage and stunning harmful skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Water Stream Shooters
skills.description: Sasori deals 10 affliction damage to one enemy. The following turn, that enemy will be dealt 5 affliction damage permanently. If used on an enemy affected by 'Puppet Flamethrower', this skill will have a different effect, dealing 30 affliction damage and stunning helpful skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Red Secret Technique: 100 Puppets
skills.description: Sasori uses the Red Secret Technique, summoning one hundred puppets and gaining 50 points of destructible defense. Permanently, all enemies will be receive 15 piercing damage each turn. This skill will end if Sasori successfully receives damage or lose all of his destructible defense.

skills.name: Magnificent Pose
skills.description: This skill makes True Form Sasori invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Tsuchi Kin
description: One of the three sound genin; Kin is a confident ninja that likes to toy with her enemies before finishing them off. Using a set of needles and bells, Kin has a number of different effects she can create to attack her enemies.

skills.name: Illusion Bell Needles
skills.description: One enemy receives 15 damage. If used one turn after 'Needle and Bell Trap', that enemy will receive 15 additional damage. If used one turn after 'Unnerving Bells', that enemy will receive 25 additional damage.

skills.name: Needle and Bell Trap
skills.description: One enemy will be stunned for 1 turn. If used one turn after 'Illusion Bell Needles', that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerbale for 2 turns.

skills.name: Unnerving Bells
skills.description: One enemy loses 1 random chakra. If used one turn after 'Illusion Bell Needles', that enemy will receive 5 additional non-affliction damage from melee skills permanently.

skills.name: Sharp Analysis
skills.description: This skill makes Tsuchi Kin invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Tsuchikage (S)
description: The Third Tsuchikage of the Hidden Rock Village, Oonoki is an intensely proud and headstrong man, despite his advanced age. An expert in a variety of jutsu, and notably able to fly, Oonoki is renowned for his unique nature transformation, the Dust Release kekkei tota, with which he can outright vaporize his enemies.

skills.name: Detachment of Primitive World
skills.description: Ohnoki isolates an enemy with his dust release, dealing 10 affliction damage to them. For 1 turn, that enemy will be invulnerable to helpful skills and their harmful skills will be stunned. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Dust Implode'.

skills.name: Super-Weighted Boulder Technique
skills.description: Onhoki touches an enemy and makes them much heavier. For 2 turns, the cost of their harmful skills will be increased by 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Rock Fist
skills.description: Increasing his striking power with Rock Fist, Ohnoki deals 30 damage to one enemy. Afterwards, Ohnoki gains 15 permanent destructible defense.

skills.name: Effortless Flight
skills.description: This skill makes Tsuchikage (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dust Implode
skills.description: Ohnoki incinerates an enemey trapped by 'Detachment of Primitive World' into mere particles, removing all helpful skills from that enemy and dealing 40 damage to them. This skill cannot be ignored or countered.

name: Tsunade
description: Tsunade is the Godaime Hokage and a Legendary Sannin. Her skill with medical ninjutsu allows her to do significant damage and heal herself and teammates.

skills.name: Painful Sky Leg
skills.description: Tsunade performs a drop kick with her insane strength, dealing 35 damage to one enemy and stunning their skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Revitalizing Heal
skills.description: If used on an ally: That ally will heal 30 health for 1 turn.  If used on Tsunade: She will apply 'Creation Rebirth' on herself instead, removing all affliction skills from her, healing 35 health and becoming immune to affliction damage for 1 turn.

skills.name: Major Summoning: Katsuyu
skills.description: Tsunade summons the slug queen Katsuyu, healing her team for 20 health instantly. Katsuyu also spits acid on all enemies, dealing 20 affliction damage to them. For the rest of the game, Tsunade and her allies will heal 5 health and this skill will be replaced by 'Tongue Tooth Sticky Acid'.

skills.name: Elbow Block
skills.description: This skill makes Tsunade invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Creation Rebirth
skills.description: Tsunade uses her stored chakra to remove all harmful affliction skills from herself, heal 35 health, and become immune to affliction damage for 1 turn. This skill is automatically activated when 'Revitalizing Heal' is used on Tsunade.

skills.name: Tongue Tooth Sticky Acid
skills.description: Katsuyu releases an acidic paste from the mouth, dealing 15 affliction damage to all enemies and healing 15 health for Tsunade and her allies.

name: Tsunade (S)
description: No longer just a Sannin, Tsunade is the new Kage of Konoha, and has taken a large amount of responsibility on her shoulders. Knowing that holding back is no longer an option, Tsunade taps into her seal to gain an impressive power over her foes.

skills.name: Heavenly Spear Kick
skills.description: Tsunade spears one enemy with her foot, destroying all their destructible defense and dealing 20 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, that enemy's physical skills will deal 15 less non-affliction damage. While empowered, this skill will deal 40 piercing damage instead.

skills.name: Enhanced Healing Palm
skills.description: Tsunade pours chakra into one ally, healing them for 30 health. Additionally, that character will heal an additional 10 health for 2 turns. If empowered, this skill will heal 40 health and the secondary effect will last an additional 1 turn.

skills.name: Tsunade: Strength of a Hundred Seal
skills.description: Tsunade taps into her seal. If Tsunade has 75 health or less, she will instantly heal 15 health. The next time Tsunade uses a skill, it will be empowered. If this skill is used while empowered, it will heal Tsunade 50 health and grant her 2 random chakra.

skills.name: Tsunade Protection
skills.description: This skill makes Tsunade (S) invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill is not affected by 'Tsunade: Strength of a Hundred Seal'.

name: Tsurugi Misumi
description: A sound village genin that infiltrated Konoha as a spy, Misumi likes taking the initiative, preferring to be the first to strike in combat. With his unique abilities, Misumi can flex his muscles and bones, twisting them to wrap around his enemies, or even defend his allies.

skills.name: Flexible Twisting Joints
skills.description: Using his distractingly loose joints, Misumi targets an ally or an enemy. If used on an enemy he will deal 15 damage that ignores invulnerability to them. If used on an ally, that ally will gain 15 points of damage reduction for 1 turn.

skills.name: Soft Physique Modification
skills.description: Misumi wraps around one enemy. For 2 turns all new harmful skills used on Misumi will be reflected to that enemy instead. During this time, that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable.

skills.name: Tighten Joints
skills.description: Misumi tightens his joints gaining 15 destructible defense. If 'Soft Physique Modification' is active, the enemy that it is active on will also receive 20 damage and will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Misumi Block
skills.description: This skill makes Tsurugi Misumi invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Uchiha Itachi
description: The only other surviving Uchiha, Itachi is a master of doujutsu, an S-Rank missing nin, and a member of Akatsuki, having been partnered with Hoshigaki Kisame. Despite being powerful, Itachi is slowly going blind, making his abilities weaker, but when Itachi activates his Sharingan he becomes an unstoppable force of pure power.

skills.name: Mangekyo Sharingan
skills.description: Itachi becomes invulnerable, enhancing 'Amaterasu' and 'Tsukuyomi', increasing their cooldowns by 2, and doubling their costs. During this time, Itachi will receive 15 affliction damage a turn, which cannot be ignored, and will ignore healing effects. This skill can be used again for free to cancel it.

skills.name: Amaterasu
skills.description: Itachi burns one enemy with his flames, dealing 15 affliction damage to them and, each following turn, they will receive 10 affliction damage a turn. This skill does not stack. During 'Mangekyou Sharingan', this skill will deal 30 initial affliction damage and target all enemies. Ends if Itachi dies.

skills.name: Tsukuyomi
skills.description: Itachi mentally tortures one enemy for 3 days and nights in a matter of seconds, dealing 20 damage to them and stunning them for 1 turn. If used during 'Mangekyou Sharingan', this skill will last 3 turns.

skills.name: Sharingan Insight
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Itachi invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Uchiha Itachi (S)
description: Uchiha Itachi is a member of Akatsuki, and the brother of Uchiha Sasuke. He has mastered the sharingan completely.

skills.name: Amaterasu Field
skills.description: Itachi creates a field around his team using Amaterasu. For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a new skill on Itachi or his allies will be dealt 5 affliction damage permanently*. This skill is invisible and is replaced by 'Mangekyou Overexertion' for 1 turn.

skills.name: Crow Genjutsu
skills.description: Itachi places a genjutsu on one enemy. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill they will be countered. If successful, the countered enemy's skills will cost 1 additional random chakra until they use a new skill. This skill is invisible and is replaced by 'Mangekyou Overexertion' for 1 turn.

skills.name: Mastered Mangekyou Sharingan
skills.description: Itachi uses his mastered Mangekyou Sharingan to deceive an enemy. For 1 turn, the first new skill used by that enemy will be reflected to a random different enemy. This skill is invisible,  ignores invulnerability and is replaced by 'Mangekyou Overexertion' for 1 turn.

skills.name: Clone Genjutsu
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Itachi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Mangekyou Overexertion
skills.description: By pushing his Mangekyou Sharingan beyond its natural limits, Itachi deals 20 damage to one enemy. If this skill is available through: 'Amaterasu Field', the enemy will take 5 additional damage from 'Amaterasu Field' permanently; 'Crow Genjutsu', Itachi is healed for 15 health; 'Mastered Mangekyou Sharingan', Itachi removes all harmful skills from himself.

name: Uchiha Madara
description: The once leader of the Uchiha clan during the founding of Konoha who unfortunately disagreed with Konoha's kage on how to achieve peace. Madara was one of the few ninjas capable of matching Hashirama's power, with the use of his Mangekyou and Susanoo.

skills.name: Eternal Mangekyou
skills.description: Madara uses his Eternal Mangekyou Sharingan. For 4 turns, all non-affliction damage used against him will be reduced to a maximum of 25. During this time, Madara can use this skill again for no cost to ignore all harmful effects except damage for 1 turn.

skills.name: Great Fire Annihilation
skills.description: Madara immolates the entire battlefield, dealing 10 affliction damage to one enemy and 5 to all others for 3 turns. During this time, if an enemy uses a new helpful skill, they will receive 10 affliction damage. While 'Eternal Mangekyou' is active, this skill is improved and will have no cooldown.

skills.name: Madara: Susanoo
skills.description: Madara encases himself in his Susanoo, gaining 70 destructible defense. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Armored Susanoo Assault'. Using this skill will reset the stacks of 'Armored Susanoo Assault'.

skills.name: Emergency Susanoo Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Madara invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Armored Susanoo Assault
skills.description: Madara's Susanoo armors up and attacks one enemy with its sword, dealing 30 damage to them and an additional 5 damage for each turn that 'Madara: Susanoo' has been active. This skill cannot be countered.

name: Uchiha Obito
description: A minor member of the Uchiha clan and a chuunin, Obito is a member of Team Minato. While Obito does not possess any singular powerful ability, he can use all of what he knows with his developing sharingan to put up a fight.

skills.name: Piercing Stab
skills.description: Finding an opening in his enemy's defense, Obito quickly stabs them, dealing 15 damage to the enemy. During 'Obito Sharingan', this skill deals 25 piercing damage while ignoring invulnerability.

skills.name: Obito Goukakyuu no Jutsu
skills.description: Obito breathes searing fire on one enemy dealing 15 affliction damage to them for 2 turns. During 'Obito Sharigan', this skill will deal 30 affliction damage instantly while ignoring invulnerability.

skills.name: Obito Sharingan
skills.description: Obito activates his sharingan, gaining 15 points of damage reduction for 4 turns. During this time, if any of Obito's allies use a new skill, the cost of their harmful skills will be decreased by 1 random chakra for 1 turn. This skill cannot trigger twice in a row on the same ally. This skill ends if Obito dies.

skills.name: Sparkling Parry
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Obito invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Uchiha Sasuke
description: A Genin from Team 7, Sasuke is the lone survivor of the Uchiha clan and has sworn vengeance against his brother. Using his sharingan, Sasuke is able to anticipate incoming attacks and is capable of advanced offensive moves.

skills.name: Lion Combo
skills.description: Copying a taijutsu combo that Lee used on him, Sasuke deals 30 damage to one enemy. This skill will deal an additional 15 damage to an enemy affected by 'Sharingan'.

skills.name: Chidori
skills.description: Using a lightning element attack jutsu, Sasuke deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill will deal an additional 15 damage to an enemy affected by 'Sharingan'. This skill requires 'Sharingan' to be active on Sasuke.

skills.name: Sharingan
skills.description: Sasuke targets one enemy. For 4 turns, Sasuke will gain 5 points of damage reduction and 'Chidori' may be used. During this time, that enemy will receive an additional 15 damage from 'Lion Combo' and 'Chidori'.

skills.name: Swift Block
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Sasuke invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive: Cursed Seal Awakening
skills.description: When Sasuke reaches 50 health for the first time, Cursed Seal will awaken, granting Sasuke 10 points of unpierceable damage reduction permanently. During this time, 'Sharingan' will also make the enemy unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable.

name: Uchiha Sasuke (S)
description: Uchiha Sasuke (S) has spent the last 2 years training under Orochimaru. He is now an expert swordsman and has immensely developed his lightning element techniques. His demeanor has also grown very cold and he is one of the most dangerous individuals in the ninja world.

skills.name: Chidori Nagashi
skills.description: Sasuke activates 'Chidori Nagashi', gaining 1 Lightning stack permanently every turn. Sasuke may use his skills to consume all Lightning stacks, dealing 10 additional damage per stack. Each turn, the first enemy that uses a new skill on Sasuke will take 10 piercing damage and consume 1 Lightning stack; cannot be triggered if Sasuke has no Lightning stacks.

skills.name: Lightning Shockwave
skills.description: Sasuke deals 15 piercing damage to one enemy and 5 piercing damage to all others. For 1 turn, Sasuke will ignore affliction damage.

skills.name: Lightning Blade
skills.description: Sasuke deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy will deal 10 less non-affliction damage and their active cooldowns will be paralyzed.

skills.name: Protective Summoning
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Sasuke (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive: Cursed Seal Protection
skills.description: When Sasuke reaches 50 health or less, all harmful affliction skills will be removed from him and Sasuke will gain 30 points of destructible defense for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, 'Lightning Shockwave' and 'Lightning Blade' will be replaced by their alternate versions.

skills.name: Great Dragon Flame Jutsu
skills.description: Sasuke deals 25 affliction damage to one enemy and 15 affliction damage to all others. For 1 turn, Sasuke will ignore affliction damage.

skills.name: Flying Corrupt Chidori
skills.description: Sasuke deals 35 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy will deal 20 less non-affliction damage and their active cooldowns will be paralyzed.

name: Uchiha Shisui (S)
description: A member of the prestigious Uchiha clan, and the best friend of Uchiha Itachi; Shisui is a highly trained ninja that is utterly devoted to Konoha. Shisui is one of the few known ninjas capable of using one the most powerful genjutsu: Koto Amatsukami.

skills.name: Shisui: Susanoo
skills.description: Shisui activates his still immature Susanoo, gaining 45 destructible defense. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Tsukumo'. Using this skill will reset the stacks of 'Tsukumo'.

skills.name: Body Flicker
skills.description: For 2 turns, if a new harmful skill is used on Shisui, he will become invulnerable to all other skills for the rest of that turn and will deal 15 damage to the enemy that used the harmful skill. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Kotoamatsukami
skills.description: Shisui activates one of the most powerful genjutsu and targets one enemy. For 1 turn, the first harmful skill used by that enemy will also be applied on a random member of that enemy's team. The following turn, the target will be dealt 25 piercing damage. This skill is invisible and ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Shisui Intercept
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Shisui (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Tsukumo
skills.description: Shisui activates his Susanoo's power, sending out a barrage of chakra needles dealing 15 damage to all enemies and reducing their non-affliction damage by 5. For each turn that 'Shisui: Susanoo' is activated, the damage reducing effect will last 1 additional turn.

name: Umino Iruka
description: Iruka is one of the instructors at the Konoha ninja academy. He is a well rounded ninja with diverse abilities and skills.

skills.name: Shuriken Throw
skills.description: Iruka throws a couple shurikens at one enemy who takes 20 piercing damage. This skill will deal an additional 10 damage for each 30 health Iruka has lost.

skills.name: Shield Ally
skills.description: Iruka uses his own body to shield one ally. For 1 turn, that ally will ignore all damage dealt to them. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Sealed Bombs Square Formation
skills.description: Iruka creates a trap with a set of exploding seals. The following 2 turns, one enemy will take 75% more damage from melee skills. During this time, if that enemy use a new skill, they will take 20 piercing damage and this skill will end.

skills.name: Kunai Parry
skills.description: This skill makes Umino Iruka invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Utakata (S)
description: A missing-nin from the Hidden Mist Village, Utakata is the jinchuuriki host of the Six-Tailed Beast, Saiken, and a kind person, though fairly distant most of the time. In battle, Utakata uses the powers of the Six-Tails to create chakra-based soap bubbles in which he can trap his enemies and slowly asphyxiate them.

skills.name: Soap Bubble
skills.description: Utakata deals 10 piercing damage to one enemy and applies 'Bubble Prision' on them. 'Bubble Prision' deals 5 unremovable affliction damage to one enemy, and the first time that enemy uses a new harmful skill, it will cause 'Soap Bubble' to cost 1 random chakra until the next use of it.

skills.name: Drowning Bubble Jutsu
skills.description: Utakata targets all enemies affected by 'Bubble Prision' and stuns their non-mental skills for 1 turn. These enemies will also receive 5 additional damage from 'Bubble Prision' and will lose 1 random chakra for each stack of 'Bubble Prision' on them. Cannot be countered, reflected and ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Rokubi Transformation
skills.description: Utakata heals 10 health for each time 'Soap Bubble' was used. Afterwards, he becomes invulnerable to Physical and Chakra skills for 2 turns. This skill removes all stacks from 'Soap Bubble'.

skills.name: Bubble Dome
skills.description: This skill makes Utakata (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Bubble Prision
skills.description: This skill deals 5 unremovable affliction damage to a target permanently. The first time that enemy uses a new harmful skill, it will cause 'Soap Bubble' to cost 1 random chakra until the next use of it.

name: Uzuki Yugao
description: A member of Konoha's Anbu faction, Yugao was the lover of Gekkou Hayate before his untimely death, and is a hard-working, dedicated, and tender person. Yugao fights using powerful genjutsu-enhanced swordsmanship, and is also proficient in the use of sealing techniques to disable her enemies.

skills.name: Hazy Moon Night
skills.description: Yugao covers herself in a haze, and strikes one enemy, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, if Yugao or an ally uses a new skill on the target of 'Hazy Moon Night', they will become invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill triggers once per ally.

skills.name: Crescent Moon Strike
skills.description: Yugao performs a graceful sword slash, dealing 15 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill will deal 15 additional damage if 'Hazy Moon Night' was used on the previous turn.

skills.name: Sealing Technique
skills.description: Yugao negates one enemy's abilities, dealing 10 affliction damage to them. For 2 turns, that enemy will be invulnerable to helpful skills and their harmful skills will be stunned. During this time, they will receive 5 additional damage from non-affliction skills.

skills.name: Yugao Hide
skills.description: This skill makes Uzuki Yugao invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Uzumaki Kushina
description: The mother of Uzumaki Naruto, wife to Minato and once the jinchuuriki to the nine-tailed fox. Kushina specializes in unique sealing and barrier techniques that can hinder and disable even the strongest of enemies.

skills.name: Four Symbols Seal
skills.description: Kushina attempts to seal an enemy away, destroying their destructible defense, dealing 15 piercing damage to them, stunning their skills for 1 turn and permanently lowering the non-affliction damage they deal and receive by 5.

skills.name: Life Link
skills.description: For 4 turns if either Kushina or one enemy dies, the other will die as well. The following 4 turns, this skill will be replaced by 'Life Transfer'. This skill ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered, reflected, ignored, removed or interact with other skills.

skills.name: Adamantine Sealing Chains
skills.description: Kushina uses an immensely powerful seal, surrounding one enemy with chains, first removing all helpful skills on them and then stunning them and making them invulnerable to all further skills for 2 turns. This skill ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Adamantine Covering Chains
skills.description: This skill makes Uzumaki Kushina invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Life Transfer
skills.description: Kushina heals an ally for 25 points and deals 25 damage to herself.

name: Uzumaki Naruto
description: A Genin from Team 7, Naruto is an orphan with the goal to one day become Hokage. Using his signature move, Shadow Clones, Naruto is able to perform powerful moves such as the Uzumaki Naruto Combo and the Rasengan.

skills.name: Uzumaki Naruto Combo
skills.description: Naruto's version of the Lion Combo. This skill deals 20 damage to one enemy. During 'Shadow Clones', this skill will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Rasengan
skills.description: Naruto hits one enemy with a ball of chakra, dealing 45 damage to them and stunning their skills for 1 turn. This skill requires 'Shadow Clones'.

skills.name: Shadow Clones
skills.description: Naruto creates multiple shadow clones hiding his true self. Naruto gains 15 points of damage reduction for 5 turns. During this time, 'Uzumaki Naruto Combo' will deal an additional 10 damage and 'Rasengan' may be used.

skills.name: Sexy Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Uzumaki Naruto invulnerable for 1 turn. During 'Kyuubi's Chakra Awakening', this skill will be replaced by 'Kyuubi's Presence' and will be classed as Mental.

skills.name: Passive: Kyuubi's Chakra Awakening
skills.description: When Naruto reaches 50 health for the first time, Kyuubi's chakra will awaken, healing Naruto for 5 health every turn permanently. During this time, 'Shadow Clones' is improved and will grant 10 points of unpierceable damage reduction.

name: Uzumaki Naruto (S)
description: After nearly three years of secluded training with Jiraiya, Naruto(s) has returned to Konoha with a greatly improved arsenal of ninja skills.

skills.name: Oodama Rasengan
skills.description: Naruto uses a greater version of Rasengan, dealing 40 piercing damage to one enemy, ignoring invulnerability. During 'Kyuubi Boost', this skill will stun their non-mental skills for 1 turn. Afterwards, Naruto takes 5 affliction damage*. During 'Passive: Three Tails Release', this skill will be replaced.

skills.name: Shadow Clones: Rasengan
skills.description: The following turn, Naruto will deal 20 piercing damage to one enemy. During this time, Naruto will ignore all harmful effects. During 'Passive: Three Tails Release', this skill will be replaced. The target of this skill is invisible.

skills.name: Kyuubi Boost
skills.description: Naruto loses 10 health* and gains 1 ninjutsu chakra. For 3 turns, he will have 10 points of damage reduction. The following 3 turns, he will ignore stun effects and this skill will be replaced by 'Kyuubi Empowered Rasengan'. Cannot be used during 'Passive: Three Tails Transformation'.

skills.name: Shadow Clone Save
skills.description: This skill makes Uzumaki Naruto (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Kyuubi Empowered Rasengan
skills.description: Naruto uses a Rasengan empowered by the Kyuubi chakra, dealing 25 damage to one enemy and stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive: Three Tails Release
skills.description: Each time Naruto uses 'Oodama Rasengan' or 'Kyuubi Empowered Rasengan', he will gain 1 Kyuubi Rage stack. At 4 Kyuubi Rage stacks, Kyuubi chakra will be released for 3 turns, removing all harmful skills, granting 50% unpierceable damage reduction, ignoring stun effects, and improving his skills.

skills.name: Three-Tail: Claw Smash
skills.description: Naruto dashes forward and strikes one enemy with a powerful smash, dealing 40 piercing damage and stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn. Afterwards, Naruto takes 5 affliction damage. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Three-Tail: Chakra Shockwave
skills.description: The following turn, Naruto will deal 20 affliction damage to all enemies. During this time, Naruto will ignore all harmful effects. This skill is invisible.

name: White Snake Kabuto (S)
description: Following Orochimaru's death at the hands of Sasuke, Kabuto got access to his master's DNA, implanting it in his body and eventually gaining many freakish, snake-like features. In his new form, Kabuto allies himself with Tobi to wage war on the shinobi world, controlling the Edo Tensei forces from the shadows.

skills.name: Snake Coil
skills.description: Kabuto uses his snake to coil around an enemy's body, dealing 10 affliction damage to them permanently. During this time, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, Kabuto will heal 10 health. This skill stacks but will end if used on a different enemy or if Kabuto is killed.

skills.name: Edo Tensei Technique
skills.description: Kabuto deals 25 affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their harmful skills for 1 turn. If that enemy is killed in this turn, they will become an Edo Tensei and will replace one of Kabuto's allies if they die or if they are currently dead, returning them to 35 health. This effect triggers once per game.

skills.name: Edo Tensei Summoning: Akatsuki
skills.description: Kabuto gains 50 points of destructible defense and replaces his skills with their alternate versions until it is destroyed. Using this skill will end 'Snake Coil'.

skills.name: White Snake Awakening
skills.description: This skill makes White Snake Kabuto (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Edo Tensei: Clay Clone
skills.description: Kabuto targets one enemy for 1 turn. If that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will be countered and will be dealt 20 piercing damage. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Edo Tensei: Totsuka Blade
skills.description: Kabuto deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and removes 1 bloodline or genjutsu from them.

skills.name: Edo Tensei: Flame Mask
skills.description: Kabuto deals 20 affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their helpful skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Edo Tensei: Human Path
skills.description: Kabuto steals 20 health from one enemy and stuns their harmful skills for 1 turn.

name: White Zetsu (S)
description: A countless army born from Hashirama's cells—harmless in appearance, deadly in numbers. Character submited by: Akats.

skills.name: White Zetsu Host
skills.description: White Zetsu cannot become invulnerable permanently. Each turn he gains 3 clone stacks, and if stunned will gain 15 points of unpierceable damage reduction the following turn. At 3 clone stacks, he gains 15 points of damage reduction. At 6, he gains 15 destructible defense. At 9, he ignores affliction damage. Each skill he uses consumes 6 clone stacks.

skills.name: Clones Assault
skills.description: At 3/6/9 clones, this skill costs 1 additional random chakra and deals 25/45/65 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Mass Reproduction
skills.description: White Zetsu Clones will mass produce all over the battlefield for 4 turns, dealing 10 damage to one random enemy while one random ally will gain 10 points of damage reduction. During this time, this skill becomes 'Parasitic Grab'.

skills.name: White Assimilation: Poison Mist
skills.description: White Zetsu will target all enemies on the battlefield for 2 turns. All enemies will become invulnerable to friendly skills and take 5 additional damage from White Zetsu's skills.

skills.name: Parasitic Grab
skills.description: White Zetsu will make one enemy unable to target anyone else but White Zetsu for 1 turn. They will take 50% more damage from White Zetsu's skills for 2 turns.

name: Yahiko (S)
description: The leader of the original Akatsuki and one of the three Rain Orphans mentored by Jiraiya, Yahiko was a dear friend of Nagato and Konan and a highly idealistic person. Striving for world peace, Yahiko established the Akatsuki, leading them through the war-torn reality of their time with a 'kill or be killed' philosophy.

skills.name: Wild Rip Wave
skills.description: Yahiko throws a wave, dealing 25 damage to all enemies. For 1 turn, Yahiko's team will heal 5 health and ignore affliction damage.

skills.name: Water Pillar
skills.description: Yahiko targets one ally permanently. The first harmful skill used on that ally will be reflected to Yahiko. If successful, that ally will heal 20 health and gain 15 points of destructible defense. This skill is invisible and cannot be used on an already affected ally. This skill ends when Yahiko is killed.

skills.name: Final Command
skills.description: This skill can only be used when Yahiko has 25 health or less. Yahiko chooses one ally to execute him, killing himself instantly. Afterwards, that ally enters a bloodthirsty rage. For 2 turns, they will deal 15 additional damage, ignore stun effects, and gain 1 random chakra each turn.

skills.name: Squad Leader
skills.description: For 1 turn, all new harmful skills used on Yahiko's allies will be reflected back to him. During this time, Yahiko gains 15 points of unpierceable damage reduction and becomes immune to affliction damage.

name: Yakushi Kabuto
description: Kabuto was once found on the battlefield, was taught medical ninjutsu, and now assists Orochimaru. He uses his medical skill for both offence and defense.

skills.name: Mystical Palm Technique
skills.description: Kabuto custs one enemy through their flesh like a scalpel, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, that enemy's harmful skills will cost 1 additional random chakra, and they will receive 10 additional damage from melee skills. This additional damage effect may only trigger once per turn.

skills.name: Temple of Nirvana
skills.description: Kabuto creates a large scale genjutsu. For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a new skill will have their physical and chakra skills stunned and will receive 10 additional damage from melee skills for 1 turn. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Secret Healing Wound Destruction
skills.description: Kabuto removes all enemy affliction skills from himself, gains 20 points of damage reduction for 1 turn and heals 35 health. This skill will heal 5 less health each time it is used.

skills.name: Dead Soul Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Yakushi Kabuto invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Yakushi Kabuto (S)
description: After two years, Kabuto remains Orochimaru's subordinate and Sasori's spy. His medical skills continue to improve, in addition to being able to use his current chakra to attack, Kabuto can use the chakra to heal himself instantly.

skills.name: Charged Mystical Palm
skills.description: If used on an enemy: Kabuto heals 5 health, deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their stunning skills for 1 turn.  If used on himself or an ally: They will heal 20 health, remove all affliction skills from themselves, and ignore stun effects for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dead Soul Jutsu
skills.description: Kabuto deals 25 damage to one enemy. For 2 turns, all other enemies will have their healing skills stunned. Permanently, 'Charged Mystical Palm' will increase its damage and heal by 10. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Orochimaru Cells Takeover
skills.description: Kabuto target himself for 2 turns. During this time, if his health reaches 0, it will be set to 35 and he will gain 2 random chakras and then this skill will end. This skill is invisible until triggered.

skills.name: Kabuto Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Yakushi Kabuto (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Yamanaka Fu (S)
description: Yamanaka Fu (S) is a member of the Yamanaka clan and a member of Anbu Root. Fu is a skilled genjutsu user and the partner of Torune.

skills.name: Tanto Slash
skills.description: Fu slashes with his tanto, dealing 25 damage to one enemy. This skill will deal 15 additional damage to an enemy countered by 'Mind Puppet Switch'.

skills.name: Quickened Mind Body Switch
skills.description: Fu disrupts one enemy, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, that enemy will be invulnerable to helpful skills. The following turn, 'Tanto Slash' will deal 15 additional damage to that enemy.

skills.name: Mind Puppet Switch
skills.description: Fu sets up a trap using a puppet. For 1 turn, the first enemy that uses a new harmful physical or chakra skill against Fu or one ally will be countered and will have all their skills replaced by 'Mind Puppet Switch - Attack' for 2 turns, and this skill will end.

skills.name: Aggresive Retreat
skills.description: This skill makes Yamanaka Fu (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Mind Puppet Switch - Attack
skills.description: This skill deals 15 damage to one enemy.

name: Yamanaka Ino
description: A Genin from Team 10, Ino is a member of the Yamanaka clan, and a very confident and vain girl. Ino is able to use a variety of abilities to take over and control her enemies, making it difficult to tell friend from foe.

skills.name: Mind Body Disturbance
skills.description: Using this skill Ino stuns one enemy's non-mental skills for 1 turn. During this time, that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable. One random different enemy will receive 20 damage that ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Change of Heart
skills.description: Ino takes over the mind of an enemy. For 3 turns, that enemy will be stunned and cannot reduce damage or become invulnerable. The following 2 turns, this skill will be replaced by 'Art of the Valentine'.

skills.name: Chakra Hair Strand Trap
skills.description: Ino creates a trap for an enemy. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, then for 2 turns, 'Change of Heart' will last 1 additional turn on that enemy and 'Mind Body Disturbance' will make that enemy unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable for 2 turns instead. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Ino Block
skills.description: This skill makes Yamanaka Ino invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Art of the Valentine
skills.description: Ino deals 25 damage to one enemy. If used on an enemy affected by 'Change of Heart', this skill will deal 30 damage instead.

name: Yamanaka Ino (S)
description: In the past couple years Ino(s) has become a chuunin and improved her ability with her family's mind control techniques. During this time she also began learning rudimentary medical techniques.

skills.name: Mind Body Switch
skills.description: Ino forces her mind into one enemy, dealing 25 piercing damage to them and ending any delayed skill that enemy currently has. Afterwards, that enemy will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Proxy Surveillance
skills.description: Ino predicts one enemy's move. For 1 turn, if this character uses a new harmful skill, it will be delayed by 2 turns. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Rudimentary Healing
skills.description: Using her healing skills, Ino heals an ally for 20 health. If Ino has used any of her other skills on the previous turn, this skill will heal 10 additional health instead.

skills.name: Hide
skills.description: This skill makes Yamanaka Ino (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Yamanaka Inoichi (S)
description: Yamanaka Inoichi (S) is the father of Ino and the leader of the Yamanaka clan. He is a jounin and a member of the Konoha interrogation squad.

skills.name: Mastered Mind Disturbance
skills.description: Inoichi invades an enemy's mind, dealing 10 piercing damage to them and stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn. If used one turn after 'Mind Shatter', this skill will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Mind Shatter
skills.description: Inoichi deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy's physical skills will cost 1 additional taijutsu chakra, their chakra skills will cost 1 additional ninjutsu chakra, their mental skills will cost 1 additional genjutsu chakra, and their affliction skills will cost 1 additional bloodline chakra.

skills.name: Mental Invasion
skills.description: For 1 turn, if one enemy uses a new harmful skill, that skill will heal instead of dealing damage, and its non-damage effects will be nullified. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Sensing Water Sphere
skills.description: This skill makes Yamanaka Inoichi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Yamashiro Aoba (S)
description: Aoba is one of the special jounins of the Hidden Leaf Village. By summoning crows, he is able to distract enemies, protect allies, and all while disguising himself among them to create openings for stealth attacks. In addition, Aoba is also able to penetrate the minds of his enemies to obtain information.

skills.name: Crow Assault
skills.description: Aoba deals 5 damage to all enemies for 4 turns. All Aoba team will also gain 5 damage reduction points for 4 turns.

skills.name: Crow Convergence
skills.description: Aoba targets one enemy, making them unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable and dealing 30 damage to them for 1 turn. For 3 turns, that enemy will take 5 additional mental damage.

skills.name: Chakra Imbued Kunai
skills.description: Aoba targets one enemy for 2 turns. If a new skill that has counter, reflect, or invulnerability is used on that enemy, they will ignore helpful effects for 1 turn. While active, that enemy will receive 10 additional damage from Aoba's skills. This skill is invisible and ends when triggered.

skills.name: Crow Smoke Screen
skills.description: This skill makes Yamashiro Aoba (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Yamato (S)
description: Yamato(s) is a member of ANBU whose real name is unknown. Given the code name Yamato(s) by Tsunade for this mission, he is tasked to lead Team 7 while Kakashi recovers.

skills.name: Sanctuary Enlightenment Enclosing Palm
skills.description: Yamato uses an ancient technique that seals one enemy's power, dealing 30 piercing damage to them. Afterwards, that enemy will ignore all helpful effects for 1 turn.

skills.name: Four Column Prison
skills.description: Yamato creates a barrier of wood around one enemy or ally. If used on an enemy, that enemy will have their non-mental skills stunned and will become invulnerable to helpful skills for 2 turns. If used on an ally, that ally will gain 40 destructible defense. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Wood Clone
skills.description: Yamato protects one ally or himself with a clone of wood for 1 turn, countering the first physical or chakra skill used against them. The countered enemy will take 20 damage* and the protected ally will gain 20 destructible defense. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Wood Locking Wall
skills.description: This skill makes Yamato (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Yondaime Hokage
description: The fourth Hokage was known as the yellow flash, regarded by all as the fastest shinobi to ever live. He is also the father of Uzumaki Naruto and the one who sealed the Kyuubi in his son.

skills.name: Hiraishin Rasengan
skills.description: Yondaime deals 40 damage to one enemy, which ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected. The following turn, this skill will cost 1 ninjutsu chakra and will deal 35 damage instead.

skills.name: Space Time Barrier
skills.description: Using his space-time abilities, Yondaime Hokage targets one ally or himself. For 1 turn, all new non-mental skills used on that ally will be reflected onto the enemy. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Partial Dead Demon Consuming Seal
skills.description: Yondaime seals part of one enemy away, dealing 25 affliction damage to them and stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. If that enemy's health drops to 10 or lower, they will be instantly killed. Yondaime will also receive 15 affliction damage.

skills.name: Kunai Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Yondaime Hokage invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Young Kakashi
description: A jounin at the age of 13 and the son of the legendary White Fang, Kakashi is a member of Team Minato. Using his early ninjutsu, and borrowed sharingan, Kakashi can fight any adult on an equal level.

skills.name: White Fang Slash
skills.description: Using his sword, Young Kakashi deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy will deal 5 less non-affliction damage. The following turn, Young Kakashi's skills will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Amateur Raikiri
skills.description: Using a weaker form of his signature jutsu, Young Kakashi deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy will deal 5 less non-affliction damage. The following turn, Young Kakashi's skills will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Implanted Sharingan
skills.description: For 1 turn, if one enemy uses a skill that removes or steals chakra, Kakashi will gain 1 random chakra; if they use a skill that stuns, Kakashi's skills will stun for 1 turn; if they use a skill that deals damage, Kakashi will deal 10 additional damage for 1 turn. This skill is invisible and ends when triggered.

skills.name: Sword Parry
skills.description: This skill makes Young Kakashi invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Young Konan (S)
description: The Rain Orphans were three children who lost their parents due to the Hidden Rain Village's involvement in the Second Shinobi World War. Konan is a sweet girl who always cares more about her teammates than herself.

skills.name: Winding Paper Shuriken
skills.description: Konan throws paper shuriken with lethal speed, dealing 20 damage to one enemy, and they will ignore all helpful effects for 1 turn.

skills.name: Origami Rose
skills.description: Konan creates an origami rose, dealing 40 damage to one enemy and stunning their skills for 1 turn. During 'Paper Origami', this skill will cost 1 genjutsu and 1 random chakra instead.

skills.name: Paper Origami
skills.description: Konan charges her papers at one enemy, dealing 10 damage to them for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, Konan will gain 5 points of damage reduction and ignore stuns effects. During this time, 'Origami Rose' will be improved.

skills.name: Marvelous Frog Disguise
skills.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Young Kushina
description: Kushina is a survivor of the Hidden Whirlpool Village's famed Uzumaki clan, and an immigrant into the Hidden Leaf Village after her own village's downfall. Due to her tomboyish and violent nature, and her bright red colored hair, Kushina is known as the "Red-Hot Habanero" as she constantly gets into trouble.

skills.name: Red-Hot Habanero
skills.description: Kushina uses her strength to protect an ally. The following 3 turns, if Kushina uses 'Fierce Punch' or 'Dropping Kick', the protected ally will heal 15 health. During this time, she will ignore stun effects.

skills.name: Fierce Punch
skills.description: Kushina lands a fierce punch on an enemy, dealing 20 damage to them. The following turn, 'Dropping Kick' will deal 20 additional damage.

skills.name: Dropping Kick
skills.description: Kushina drops down with a powerful kick, dealing 10 damage to one enemy and stunning their skills for 1 turn. The following turn, 'Fierce Punch' will deal 10 additional damage and will stun an enemy for 1 turn.

skills.name: Skilled Landing
skills.description: This skill makes Young Kushina invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Young Nagato (S)
description: The Rain Orphans were three children who lost their parents due to the Hidden Rain Village's involvement in the Second Shinobi World War. Nagato is a quiet boy who is not only afraid of the world, but also afraid of himself.

skills.name: Rinnegan Dominion
skills.description: Nagato awakens his Rinnegan, gaining 20 points of destructible defense. For 1 turn, 'Wind Style: Air Bullets' and 'Amateur Shinra Tensei' will be improved. Each time this skill is used, its duration and cooldown will increase by 1.

skills.name: Wind Style: Air Bullets
skills.description: Nagato shoots multiple bullets of air at one enemy, dealing 25 damage and stunning their skills for 1 turn. During 'Rinnegan Dominion', this skill will deal 100% more damage.

skills.name: Amateur Shinra Tensei
skills.description: By activating Shinra Tensei, Nagato protects one ally. For 1 turn, that ally becomes invulnerable. Afterwards, they will heal 10 health and all harmful skills will be removed from them. During 'Rinnegan Dominion', this skill will cost 1 random chakra instead.

skills.name: Majestic Frog Disguise
skills.description: This skill makes Young Nagato (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Young Yahiko (S)
description: The Rain Orphans were three children who lost their parents due to the Hidden Rain Village's involvement in the Second Shinobi World War. Yahiko is a stoic boy who leads his team in the fight for survival during the war.

skills.name: Water Style: Wild Water Wave
skills.description: Yahiko spews water in a waterfall-like fashion, dealing 30 piercing damage to one enemy and 20 chakra damage to all others.

skills.name: Lateral Kick
skills.description: Yahiko assaults one enemy with a lateral kick, dealing 20 damage to them and stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn. The following turn, 'Water Style: Wild Water Wave' will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Descending Fist
skills.description: Yahiko assaults one enemy with a descending fist, dealing 20 piercing damage to them and removing 1 taijutsu or bloodline chakra. The following turn, 'Water Style: Wild Water Wave' will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Magnificent Frog Disguise
skills.description: This skill makes Young Yahiko (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Yuhi Kurenai
description: Yuhi Kurenai is a jounin and team leader of Hinata, Shino and Kiba. She is a genjutsu master who is able to both disable and attack her enemies with illusions.

skills.name: Cherry Blossom Suffocation
skills.description: Kurenai suffocates all enemies with illusionary cherry blossoms, dealing 10 damage to them for 3 turns. During this time, if 'Plant-Form Attack' is used on an enemy affected by this skill, they will have their physical and chakra skills stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Plant Form Attack
skills.description: Kurenai hinders an enemy with her genjutsu, making them unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable while dealing 20 damage to them for 1 turn. If that enemy is affected by 'Cherry Blossom Suffocation', they will have their physical and chakra skills stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Demonic Illusion: Tree Binding Death
skills.description: For 1 turn, the first physical or chakra skill used on herself, or an ally, will be countered. If successful, then for 2 turns, the countered enemy will have their physical and chakra skills stunned and will receive double damage from mental skills.

skills.name: Vanishing Illusion
skills.description: This skill makes Yuhi Kurenai invulnerable for 1 turn.

name: Zetsu (S)
description: Zetsu (S) is intent to follow Tobi's orders. With his abilities he will be trouble for anyone that comes across him.

skills.name: Spore Technique
skills.description: Zetsu plants spore clones into an ally, granting them 10 permanent destructible defense and making them ignore all harmful non-damage effects until this destructible defense is destroyed. When it's destroyed, that ally will gain 1 random chakra. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Wood Release Roots
skills.description: Zetsu manipulates wood roots and attacks an enemy from below, dealing 30 piercing damage and stunning that enemy's physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Parasite Clone Trap
skills.description: Zetsu targets one enemy, reducing their non-affliction damage by 10 permanently. If that enemy uses a new harmful skill, that skill will be copied and 'Parasite Clone Trap' will end. This skill will be replaced by the copied skill for 1 turn which will cost random chakra. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Zetsu Split
skills.description: This skill makes Zetsu (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.
